如是我聞：: 一時， 佛在舍衛國祇樹給孤獨園， 與大比丘眾千二百五十人俱。
At one time the Buddha was at Śrāvastī in Jeta's Grove, the park [given by] Anāthapiṇḍada, accompanied by a great community of thousand two hundred and fifty monks.

如是我聞：: 爾時， 世尊告諸比丘： 「我與汝等說微妙法， 義味清淨，
At that time the Blessed One said to the monks: "I will teach you the sublime Dharma, whose meaning has the flavour of purity with which the holy life is endowed, namely the three groups of states.

如是我聞：: 梵行具足， 謂三聚法。 汝等諦聽！ 思惟念之！
Listen, pay attention to and be mindful of what I will teach you."

如是我聞：: 當為汝說。 」時， 諸比丘受教而聽。
Then the monks listened to receive the teaching.

如是我聞：: 佛告比丘： 「三法聚者， 一法趣惡趣。 一法趣善趣。 一法趣涅槃。
The Buddha said to the monks: "One groups states in three: One state leads toward a bad destiny, one state leads toward a good destiny, and one state that leads toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 云何一法趣于惡趣？
1) "What one state leads toward a bad destiny?

如是我聞：: 謂無仁慈， 懷毒害心，
That is, it is being without benevolence and cherishing harmfulness in the heart.

如是我聞：: 是謂一法將向惡趣。
This is reckoned one state that leads toward a bad destiny.

如是我聞：: 云何一法趣于善趣？
What one state leads toward a good destiny?
謂不以惡心加於眾生，	That is, it is not imposing on living beings with evilness in the heart.
是為一法將向善趣。	This is one state that leads toward a good destiny.
云何一法趣于涅槃？	What one state leads toward Nirvāṇa?

如是我聞：: 謂能精勤， 修身念處，
That is, it is being able to make a diligent effort to cultivate mindfulness of the body.

如是我聞：: 是為一法將向涅槃。
This is reckoned one state that leads toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 「復有二法趣向惡趣， 復有二法趣向善趣， 復有二法趣向涅槃。
2) "Again two states lead toward a bad destiny, again two states lead toward a good destiny, and again two states lead toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 云何二法趣向惡趣？
What two states lead toward a bad destiny?
一謂毀戒， 二謂破見。	That is, the first is breaches of morality, the second is wrong views.
云何二法趣向善趣？	What two states lead toward a good destiny?

如是我聞：: 一謂戒具， 二謂見具。
That is, the first is being endowed with morality, the second is being endowed with [right] view.

如是我聞：: 云何二法趣向涅槃？
What two states lead toward Nirvāṇa?
一謂為止， 二謂為觀。	That is, the first is tranquility, the second is insight.
「復有三法趣向惡趣， 三法向善趣， 三法向涅槃。	[sic] 3) Again three states lead toward a bad destiny, three states lead toward a good destiny, and three states lead toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 云何三法向惡趣？
What three states lead toward a bad destiny?
謂三不善根： 貪不善根、恚不善根、癡不善根。	That is, they are the three unwholesome roots: the unwholesome root of lust, the unwholesome root of hatred, and the unwholesome root of delusion.
云何三法向善趣？	What three states lead toward a good destiny?

如是我聞：: 謂三善根： 無貪善根、無恚善根、無癡善根。
That is, they are the three wholesome roots: the wholesome root of absence of lust, the wholesome root of absence of hatred, and the wholesome root of absence of delusion.

如是我聞：: 云何三法趣向涅槃？
What three states lead toward Nirvāṇa?
謂三三昧： 空三昧、無相三昧、無作三昧。	That is, they are the three concentrations: concentration on emptiness, concentration on signlessness, and concentration on desirelessness.
「又有四法趣向惡趣， 四法向善趣， 四法向涅槃。	4) Again four states lead toward a bad destiny, four states lead toward a good destiny, and four states lead toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 云何四法向惡趣？
What four states lead toward a bad destiny?
謂愛語、恚語、怖語、癡語。	That is, they are speaking with craving, speaking with hatred, speaking [what causes] fear, and speaking with delusion.
云何四法向善趣？	What four states lead toward a good destiny?

如是我聞：: 謂不愛語、不恚語、不怖語、不癡語。
That is, they are speaking without craving, speaking without hatred, speaking [what causes] no fear, and speaking without delusion.

如是我聞：: 云何四法向涅槃？
What four states lead toward Nirvāṇa?
謂四念處： 身念處、受念處、意念處、法念處。	That is, they are the four establishments of mindfulness: the establishment of mindfulness on the body, the establishment of mindfulness on feelings, the establishment of mindfulness on the mind, and the establishment of mindfulness on phenomena.
「復有五法向惡趣， 五法向善趣， 五法向涅槃。	5) Again five states lead toward a bad destiny, five states lead toward a good destiny, and five states lead toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 云何五法向惡趣？
What five states lead toward a bad destiny?
謂破五戒： 殺、盜、婬、妄語、飲酒。	That is, they are breaking the five precepts: killing, stealing, adultery, false speech, and drinking liquor.
云何五法向善趣？	What five states lead toward a good destiny?

如是我聞：: 謂持五戒： 不殺、不盜、不婬、不欺、不飲酒。
That is, they are upholding the five precepts: not killing, not stealing, not engaging in adultery, not deceiving, and not drinking liquor.

如是我聞：: 云何五法趣向涅槃？
What five states lead toward Nirvāṇa?
謂五根： 信根、精進根、念根、定根、慧根。	That is, they are the five faculties: the faculty of faith, the faculty of energy, the faculty of mindfulness, the faculty of concentration, and the faculty of wisdom.
「又有六法向惡趣， 六法向善趣， 六法向涅槃。	6) Again six states lead toward a bad destiny, six states lead toward a good destiny, and six states lead toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 云何六法向惡趣？
What six states lead toward a bad destiny?
謂六不敬： 不敬佛、不敬法、不敬僧、不敬戒、不敬定、不敬父母。	That is, they are the six [forms of] disrespect: being disrespectful toward the Buddha, being disrespectful toward the Dharma, being disrespectful toward the community, being disrespectful toward morality, being disrespectful toward concentration, and being disrespectful toward one's father and mother.

如是我聞：: 云何六法向善趣？
What six states lead toward a good destiny?
謂六敬法： 敬佛、敬法、敬僧、敬戒、敬定、敬父母。	That is, they are the six forms of respect: being respectful toward the Buddha, being respectful toward the Dharma, being respectful toward the community, being respectful toward morality, being respectful toward concentration, and being respectful toward one's father and mother.
云何六法向涅槃？	What six states lead toward Nirvāṇa?

如是我聞：: 謂六思念： 念佛、念法、念僧、念戒、念施、念天。
That is, they are the six recollections: recollection of the Buddha, recollection of the Dharma, recollection of the community, recollection of morality, recollection of generosity, and recollection of devas.

如是我聞：: 「又有七法向惡趣， 七法向善趣， 七法向涅槃。
7) "Again seven states lead toward a bad destiny, seven states lead toward a good destiny, and seven states lead toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 云何七法向惡趣？
What seven states lead toward a bad destiny?
謂殺生、不與取、婬、妄語、兩舌、惡口、綺語。	That is, they are killing, taking what is not given, adultery, false speech, divisive speech, harsh speech, and frivolous speech.
云何七法向善趣？	What seven states lead toward a good destiny?

如是我聞：: 謂不殺生、不盜、不婬、不欺、不兩舌、不惡口、不綺語。
That is, they are not killing, not stealing, not engaging in adultery, not deceiving, not speaking divisively, not speaking harshly, and not speaking frivolously.

如是我聞：: 云何七法向涅槃？
What seven states lead toward Nirvāṇa?
謂七覺意： 念覺意、擇法覺意、精進覺意、猗覺意、定覺意、喜覺意、捨覺意。	That is, they are the seven factors of awakening: the awakening factor of mindfulness, the awakening factor of investigation of phenomena, the awakening factor of energy, the awakening factor of tranquillity, the awakening factor of concentration, the awakening factor of joy, and the awakening factor of equanimity.
「又有八法向惡趣， 八法向善趣， 八法向涅槃。	8) Again eight states lead toward a bad destiny, eight states lead toward a good destiny, and eight states lead toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 云何八法向惡趣？
What eight states lead toward a bad destiny?
謂八邪行： 邪見、邪志、邪語、邪業、邪命、邪方便、邪念、邪定。	That is, they are the eight wrong practices: wrong view, wrong intention, wrong speech, wrong action, wrong livelihood, wrong effort, wrong mindfulness, and wrong concentration.
云何八法向善趣？	What eight states lead toward a good destiny?

如是我聞：: 謂世正見： 正志、正語、正業、正命、正方便、正念、正定。
That is, they are worldly right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration.

如是我聞：: 云何八法向涅槃？
What eight states lead toward Nirvāṇa?
謂八賢聖道： 正見、正志、正語、正業、正命、正方便、正念、正定。	That is, they are the noble eightfold path: right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration.
「又有九法向惡趣， 九法向善趣， 九法向涅槃。	9) Again nine states lead toward a bad destiny, nine states lead toward a good destiny, and nine states lead toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 云何九法向惡趣？
What nine states lead toward a bad destiny?
謂九惱： 有人已侵惱我， 今侵惱我， 當侵惱我； 我所愛者，	That is, they are the nine vexations: a person has encroached upon and vexed me, now encroaches upon and vexes me, or will encroach upon and vex me; he has encroached upon and vexed those who are dear to me, is encroaching upon and vexing them now, or will encroach upon and vex them; he had loving regard for those whom I dislike, has loving regard for them now, or will have loving regard for them now.
已侵惱， 今侵惱， 當侵惱； 我所憎者， 已愛敬， 今愛敬， 當愛敬。 云何九法向善趣？	What nine states lead toward a good destiny?

如是我聞：: 謂九無惱： 彼已侵我， 我惱何益？
That is, they are the nine absences of vexation: 'He has encroached upon me' - what benefit would it be for me to be vexed by this?

如是我聞：: 已不生惱， 今不生惱， 當不生惱；
This vexation did not arise, vexation does not arise now, and vexation will not arise.

如是我聞：: 我所愛者， 彼已侵惱， 我惱何益？
'He has encroached upon and vexed those who are dear to me' - what benefit would it be for me to be vexed by this?

如是我聞：: 已不生惱， 今不生惱， 當不生惱；
This vexation did not arise, vexation does not arise now, and vexation will not arise.

如是我聞：: 我所憎者， 彼已愛敬， 我惱何益？
'He has loving regard for those whom I dislike' - what benefit would it be for me to be vexed by this?

如是我聞：: 已不生惱， 當不生惱， 今不生惱。
This vexation did not arise, vexation does not arise, and vexation does not arise now."

如是我聞：: 云何九法向涅槃？
What nine states lead toward Nirvāṇa?
謂九善法， 一喜， 二愛， 三悅， 四樂， 五定， 六實知， 七除捨，	That is, they are the nine states of joy: the first is joy, the second is affection, the third is delight, the fourth is happiness, the fifth is concentration, the sixth is knowledge as it really is, the seventh is giving up, the eighth is dispassion, and the ninth is liberation.

如是我聞：: 八無欲， 九解脫。 「又有十法向惡趣， 十法向善趣， 十法向涅槃。
10) "Again ten states lead toward a bad destiny, ten states lead toward a good destiny, and ten states lead toward Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 云何十法向惡趣？
What ten states lead toward a bad destiny?
謂十不善： 身殺、盜、婬， 口兩舌、惡罵、妄言、綺語， 意貪取、嫉妬、邪見。	That is, they are the ten [courses of] unwholesomeness: the bodily [courses] of killing, stealing, and adultery; the verbal [courses] of divisive speech, abuse, false speech, and frivolous speech; and the mental [courses] of desirous grasping, envy, and wrong view.

如是我聞：: 云何十法向善趣？
What ten states lead toward a good destiny?
謂十善行： 身不殺、盜、婬， 口不兩舌、惡罵、妄言、綺語， 意不貪取、嫉妬、邪見。	That is, they are the ten courses of wholesomeness: the bodily [courses] of not killing, stealing, or engaging in adultery; the verbal [courses] of no divisive speech, abuse, false speech, or frivolous speech; and the mental [courses] of no desirous grasping, envy, or wrong view.
云何十法向涅槃？	What ten states lead toward Nirvāṇa?

如是我聞：: 謂十直道： 正見、正志、正語、正業、正命、正方便、正念、正定、正解脫、正智。
That is, they are the ten [fold] straight path: right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right concentration, right liberation, and right knowledge."

如是我聞：: 諸比丘！ 如是十法， 得至涅槃，
Monks, in this way these ten states lead to reaching Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 是名三聚微妙正法，
This is called the sublime true Dharma of the Three Groups.
我為如來、為眾弟子所應作者， 無不周備，	Being the Tathāgata, I have done for the assembly of disciples what is appropriate, without deficiencies.
憂念汝等， 故演經道；	Because of thoughts of concern for you, I have expounded this discourse on the path.
汝等亦宜自憂其身， 當處閑居、樹下思惟，	It is becoming for you to have also concern for yourself, you should dwell in secluded places, meditate at the root of trees.
勿為懈怠，	Do not be negligent.
今不勉力， 後悔無益。	If you do not exert yourself now, later it will be of no benefit to harbour regrets.

如是我聞：: 」諸比丘聞佛所說， 歡喜奉行。
The monks who had heard what the Buddha had said were delighted and received it respectfully.

Of bodily form, which is of a nature to arise and cease, he does not understand as it really is that bodily form is of a nature to arise and cease. At that time there was a Brahman who had in Jeta-vana a large rice-field, that was already ripe.

如是我聞：: 已熟，
At any moment (lit.

如是我聞：: 在朝暮當收穫。
morning and evening), it was ready to be reaped.

如是我聞：: 梵志晨起， 往到田上， 遙見禾穟，
The Brahman got up one morning, went up to the field and had a look far away at the ears of the paddy.

如是我聞：: 心內歡喜，
He was delighted at heart.

如是我聞：: 自謂得願，
He said to himself that he had his wish fulfilled.

如是我聞：: 視禾不能捨去。
He looked at the corn, was much enamoured of it and would not leave [the sight of] it.

如是我聞：: 佛是時從諸比丘， 入城求食，
The Buddha, at that time, followed by the mendicants, entered the town and begged alms.

如是我聞：: 遙見梵志喜樂如是，
He saw from a distance that the Brahman was thus happy.

如是我聞：: 便謂諸比丘： 「汝曹見是梵志不？

如是我聞：: 」皆對言：

如是我聞：: 「見。 」佛默然入城，
The Buddha silently entered the town.

如是我聞：: 食後各還精舍。
After eating food, everyone returned to the pleasure-garden.

如是我聞：: 即日夜， 天雨大雹，

如是我聞：: 皆殺田中禾。
All the crop in the field was destroyed.

如是我聞：: 梵志有一女， 亦以夜死。
The Brahman had a daughter, who also died that night.

如是我聞：: 梵志以是故， 愁憒憂煩，

如是我聞：: 啼哭無能止者。
He began to cry and nobody could stop him.

Next day the Assembly of the mendicants took their begging bowls, entered the city and begged alms.

如是我聞：: 便聞梵志有是災害， 啼哭甚悲，
They then heard that such and such a calamity had fallen upon the Brahman, who cried and was very sad.

如是我聞：: 非沙門、梵志、及國人所能解其憂者。
No śramaṇa or Brahman could deliver him from sorrow.

如是我聞：: 比丘食竟， 還到佛所，
The mendicants finished the eating of food and came back to the place where the Buddha stayed.

如是我聞：: 作禮白： 「梵志意狀如是。
They paid their homage to the Buddha, and explained to Him the mental condition [as explained above] of the Brahman.

如是我聞：: 」言適竟， 梵志啼哭， 來到佛所，
Immediately after their speech, the Brahman came crying to the place where the Buddha was.

如是我聞：: 勞佛竟， 便坐佛邊。
He inquired of the health of the Buddha and sat by his side.

如是我聞：: 佛知其本憂所念， 即謂梵志言： 「世有五事， 不可得避，

如是我聞：: 亦無脫者。 何等為五？

如是我聞：: 當耗減法，
(i) There are things which must wane or diminish.

當亡棄法，	(ii) There are things which must come to ruin.
欲使不亡棄， 是不可得；	Even if one wishes that they may not be ruined, it is impossible.
當病瘦法，	(iii) There are things which must be diseased.
欲使不病瘦， 是不可得；	Even if one wishes that they may not be diseased, it is impossible.
當老朽法，	(iv) There are things which must grow old.
欲使不老朽， 是不可得；	Even if one wishes that they may not grow old, it is impossible.

欲使不死去， 是不可得。	Even if one wishes that they may not perish, it is impossible.
「凡人無道、無慧計， 見耗減、亡棄、老、病、死法來，	An ordinary man who knows no Path and has no wisdom sees things waning, coming to ruin, getting diseased, growing old, and perishing.

世與耗俱生，	The world is born along with this waning of things.

面目委色，	My face and eyes have lost their lustrous appearance.

世人我卿亦然， 遠憂愁念正行， 是世憂當何益？	(4) Truly doth he know that they do not deserve to be pursued----- These men of the world who, like you and me, are all alike; From sorrow and grief, he studiously doth keep himself off, [For], of what avail can all this, of the world, be?
」 佛復為梵志極說經法， 次說布施、持戒， 現天徑欲善，	Further the Buddha spoke to the Brahman on several sūtra-dharmas, such as talk on charities, good conduct,heavens, advantages and disadvantages and lack of solidity of worldly pleasures.

如是我聞：: 爾時， 心王菩薩聞佛說法， 出三界外不可思議，
At that time Simwang Bodhisattva heard the Buddha's explanation of the dharma, which transcended the three realms of existence and was inconceivable.

如是我聞：: 從座而起， 叉手合掌， 以偈問曰： 「如來所說義， 出世無有相。

如是我聞：: 可有一切生， 皆得盡有漏？ 斷結空心我， 是則無有生。
Eradicating the bonds and emptying both mind and self, This then will be [the state of] nonproduction.

如是我聞：: 云何無有生， 而得無生忍？
But how will one gain the acceptance of the nonproduction [of dharmas], If there is nothing that is produced?

如是我聞：: 」爾時， 佛告心王菩薩言： 「善男子！
At that time, the Buddha proclaimed to Simwang Bodhisattva: "Oh son of good family!

如是我聞：: 無生法忍法本無生， 諸行無生非無生行，
The acceptance of the nonproduction of dharmas [means to realize that] dharmas are originally unproduced and that all practices produce nothing.

如是我聞：: 得無生忍即為虛妄。
As there is no way to practice this nonproduction, achieving the acceptance of nonproduction is in fact a deception."

如是我聞：: 」心王菩薩言：
Simwang Bodhisattva asked, "Lord!

如是我聞：: 「尊者！ 得無生忍即為虛妄？ 無得無忍應非虛妄！

如是我聞：: 」佛言：
The Buddha replied, "Not so.

如是我聞：: 「不也。 何以故？

如是我聞：: 無得無忍是則有得，
If nonachievement and nonacceptance exist, then so would achievement.

如是我聞：: 並為虛妄。
So both [achievement and acceptance] are deceptions."

如是我聞：: 」心王菩薩言：
Simwang Bodhisattva asked, "Lord!

如是我聞：: 「尊者！ 云何無忍無生心而非虛妄？
How is it that the mind may be free from either acceptance or production and yet not be deceived?"

如是我聞：: 」佛言： 「無忍無生心者， 心無形段，
The Buddha replied, "The mind that is free from both acceptance and production—that mind has neither form nor shape.

如是我聞：: 猶如火性，

the nature of fire], which, though latent in wood, cannot be found there.

Oh son of good family!

如是我聞：: 即無生行也。

And why is this?

如是我聞：: 菩提性中無得、無失， 無覺、無知， 無分別相，
The bodhi-nature has neither gain nor loss, neither attention nor cognition, for it is free from all differentiated characteristics.

如是我聞：: 無分別中即清淨性。
The pure nature actually exists in such nondiscrimination.

如是我聞：: 性無間雜， 無有言說， 非有、非無， 非知、非不知；
This nature is free from any extraneous admixture [such as the dichotomies of production and extinction or subject and object]: it is free from words and speech; it neither exists nor does not exist; it is neither aware nor nescient.

如是我聞：: 諸可法行亦復如是。
So too is this case for all the dharmas [training methods] that can be cultivated.
何以故？	Why is this?
一切法行， 不見處所， 決定性故。	All dharmas and practices have no loci that can be found, because their natures are fixed.
本無有得、不得，	Originally, they are free from any semblance of attainment or nonattainment.
云何得阿耨多羅三藐三菩提？ 」佛言：	So how can one attain anuttarasamyaksaṃbodhil The Buddha replied, "So it is, so it is.

如是我聞：: 「如是， 如是。 如汝所言， 一切心行， 不過無相體寂無生，
As you have said, all of the activities of mind are nothing but signlessness; their essences are calm and unproduced.

如是我聞：: 可有諸識亦復如是。
It is the same as well with each and every consciousness.

如是我聞：: 何以故？
Why is this?

如是我聞：: 眼、眼觸悉皆空寂，
The eye and visual contact are both void and calm.

如是我聞：: 識亦空寂， 無有動、不動相，
[Visual] consciousness is also void and calm: it is free from any characteristic of agitation or motionlessness.

如是我聞：: 內無三受， 三受寂滅；
Since it is free internally of the three feelings [vedanā; pain, pleasure, and neutral feeling], the three feelings are calm and extinct.

如是我聞：: 耳、鼻、舌、身、心意意識， 及以末那、阿梨耶識亦復如是， 皆亦不生寂滅之心及無生心。
So too is this the case for auditory, olfactory, gustatory, tactile, and mental [consciousnesses], as well as mind-consciousness, mano[vijñāna], and alaya consciousness: as all of them are also unproduced, they are the mind that is calm and extinct and the mind that produces nothing.

如是我聞：: 若生寂滅心、若生無生心， 是有生行， 非無生行。
But if one gives rise to the mind that is calm and extinct and the mind that produces nothing, this then would be practice that produces something, not the practice of nonproduction.

如是我聞：: 菩薩內生三受、三行、三戒，
Bodhisattva! Thus internally are generated three feelings, three karmic actions, and three moral restraints [of physical, verbal, and mental actions].
若已寂滅， 生心不生。 心常寂滅， 無功、無用，	If these are already calm and extinct, the producing mind will not be produced and the mind will be constantly calm and extinct, without efficacy or function.
不證寂滅相， 亦不住於無證，	He does not evince any characteristic of calm extinction; but he also does not insist on not corroborating [such a characteristic].
可處無住總持無相，	What is worth lingering in is the state of nonabiding, wherein is encoded (ch'ongji, dhārayati) signlessness.
則無三受、三行、三戒， 悉皆寂滅清淨無住，	Then, there will be none of these three, such as the three feelings, and so forth, for all will be calm and extinct, pure and nonabiding.
不入三昧、不住坐禪，	He need not access samādhi; he need not persist in sitting in dhyāna.
無生、無行。	This is nonproduction and freedom from practice.

如是我聞：: 」心王菩薩言： 「禪能攝動， 定諸幻亂。
Simwang Bodhisattva asked, "Dhyāna can suppress all agitation and allay all illusory distractions.

如是我聞：: 云何不禪？
Why this negation of dhyāna?"

如是我聞：: 」佛言：
The Buddha replied, "Bodhisattva!

如是我聞：: 「菩薩禪即是動，
Dhyāna in fact is agitation.

如是我聞：: 不動、不禪是無生禪。
Being neither agitated nor concentrated is the dhyana that produces nothing.

如是我聞：: 禪性無生， 離生禪相；
The nature of dhyana is to produce nothing; it has no characteristics of the dhyana that does produce something.

如是我聞：: 禪性無住， 離住禪動。
The nature of dhyāna is to linger nowhere; it leaves far behind the agitation caused by trying to linger in dhyāna.

如是我聞：: 若知禪性無有動靜， 即得無生；
Know that the nature of dhyāna is free from both agitation and calmness and you will immediately attain the [acceptance of the] nonproduction [of dharmas] and the prajñā that produces nothing.

如是我聞：: 無生般若亦不依住，
But also do not rely on, or linger over, these.

如是我聞：: 心亦不動； 以是智故，
Because of this knowledge, the mind also will not be agitated.

如是我聞：: 故得無生般若波羅蜜。
For this reason, you will attain the prajñāpāramitā that produces nothing."

如是我聞：: 」心王菩薩言：
Simwang Bodhisattva said, "Lord!

如是我聞：: 「尊者！ 無生般若於一切處無住， 於一切處無離，
The prajñā that produces nothing does not abide anywhere, and yet there is no place where it is not.

如是我聞：: 心無住處， 無處住心，
The mind has no abiding place and there is no place where the mind can abide.

如是我聞：: 無住無心， 心無生住。
When there is no abiding and no mind (musim), the mind will then abide in nonproduction.

如是我聞：: 如此住心， 即無生住。
The mind that so abides is in fact abiding in nonproduction.

如是我聞：: 尊者！
Lord!
心無生住不可思議！	The mind's practice of nonproduction is inconceivable.
不思議中可不可說！	As it is inconceivable, it is both effable and ineffable.

如是我聞：: 」佛言： 「如是， 如是。
The Buddha said, "So it is, so it is."

如是我聞：: 」心王菩薩聞如是言， 歎未曾有， 而說偈言： 「滿足大智尊， 廣說無生法，
Simwang Bodhisattva heard these words and, praising its miraculousness, recited these gāthās: That Lord who is replete in great knowledge, Has explained extensively the dharma of nonproduction.

如是我聞：: 聞所未曾聞， 未說而今說。
I have heard what has never been heard before, Now has been explained what had yet to be explained.

如是我聞：: 猶如淨甘露， 時時乃一出， 難遇難思議，
Like the pure sweet dew, That appears but once in a long while, [So too is this dharma] difficult to encounter and difficult to imagine.

如是我聞：: 聞者亦復難。 無上良福田、  最上勝妙藥，
Difficult too is it to hear it, It is the unsurpassed, excellent field of merit (puṇyakṣetra), The supremely efficacious, sublime medicine.

如是我聞：: 為度眾生故， 而今為宣說。
It is in order to ferry across sentient beings, That it has now been proclaimed.

如是我聞：: 」爾時， 眾中聞說此已， 皆得無生無生般若。
At that time, all those in the congregation heard these words and attained the [acceptance of] the nonproduction [of dharmas] as well as the prajñā that produces nothing.

如是我聞：: 復次舍利子！ 云何菩薩摩訶薩修行進趣菩薩禪定波羅蜜多之行？
Further, Śāriputra, what is the Bodhisattva's practice of the dhyāna pāramitā, which the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva cultivates and by which he progresses?
舍利子！ 菩薩摩訶薩應先遠離染欲過失諸不善法，	Śāriputra, the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva should first be far removed from the evil of defiled desire and from all unvirtuous dharmas.
於彼尋伺發生喜樂，	Here he brings forth rapture and pleasure.
是名入解初禪定行。	This is called entering into the first dhyāna.
舍利子！ 菩薩摩訶薩次當遠離尋伺， 於內引生清淨潔白心一境性，	Śāriputra, the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva next should be far from inquiry and reflection, and inwardly concentrate clearly and one-pointedness of mind.
於彼等持發生喜樂，	Here samādhi brings forth rapture and pleasure.
是名入解二禪定行。	This is called entering into the second dhyāna.
舍利子！ 菩薩摩訶薩次當捨離貪愛、行念正知，	Śāriputra, the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva next should be separate from craving and practice recollection and correct knowing.
唯妙樂受身雖正知，	His body feels only wonderful pleasure and he knows correctly.
如彼聖人觀察捨念離喜妙樂行故，	As the noble persons said, He contemplates detachment and recollection and is separate from rapture."

如是我聞：: 是名入解三禪定行。
And so the practice is called entering the third dhyāna.

如是我聞：: 舍利子！ 菩薩摩訶薩次當如是先斷苦樂適悅煩惱， 無苦無樂捨念清淨，
Śāriputra, the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva next should in this manner first cut off suffering and pleasure, joy and detachment, without suffering and without pleasure, his detachment and recollection are pure.

如是我聞：: 是名入解四禪定行。
This is called entering into the practice of the fourth dhyāna.

如是我聞：: 彼如實得圓滿清淨純一無雜正等引心， 無餘支分及隨煩惱，
He is truly attains a perfect purity and uniformity without mixture." His rightly concentrated mind is without excess members' and secondary kilesas.

如是我聞：: 不離等持而能作彼禪定事業，
He does not remove himself from samādhi, but is able to do the actions of dhyāna.

如是我聞：: 而復圓滿五種神通及彼智業。
And further, he perfects the five kinds of supernor-mal faculties and their actions of knowledge.

如是我聞：: 云何名為五種神通？
What are known as the five kinds of supernormal faculties?

如是我聞：: 一者天眼、二者天耳、三者他心、四者宿住、五者神境，
The first is the divine eye, the second is the divine ear, the third is [the knowledge of] the minds of others, the fourth is [the knowledge of] past lives, and the fifth is the base of ṛddhi.

如是我聞：: 此說名為五種神通。
This explains what is called the five kinds of supernormal faculties.

如是我聞：: 又復云何菩薩於彼天眼乃至神境而能圓滿最上正行神通智業？
And moreover, what does one say of the Bodhisattva, with regard to these, the divine eye, and so forth, down to the base of ṛddhi? He is able to perfect the supreme right practice of the actions of knowledge of supernormal faculties.

如是我聞：: 舍利子！ 此菩薩如實安住正等引心圓滿清淨， 純一無雜及隨煩惱，
Śāriputra, this Bodhisattva-mahāsattva truly abides securely in a rightly concentrated mind, with perfect purity and uniformity without mixture or secondary kleśas.

如是我聞：: 於諸有情心無所欲， 而能發起神境等通，
With regard to sentient beings, his mind has nothing which is desired, and he is able to produce the faculties of the base of ṛddhi.

如是我聞：: 此說名為神通智業。
This explains what are called the actions of knowledge of supernormal faculties.

如是我聞：: 又天眼清淨出過於人， 而能觀察諸有情等， 初生退沒好醜等相、善趣惡趣勝妙下劣， 乃至知諸有情業行差別，
Moreover, the purity of the divine eye surpasses that of men, and is able to behold all sentient beings, their birth, their passing away, their aspects of beauty, their ugliness, their good destiny, their evil destiny, their superiority, their inferiority, and also knows the different kinds of karma-practices of all sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 身語意中具足惡行， 起彼邪見誹謗聖賢，
Because of their evil practices of body, speech and mind, they give rise to their wrong views and slander the No-buddha.

如是我聞：: 而復積集邪見業因， 身謝命終墮於惡趣那落迦中。
Liable ones, and further accumulating the karma and causes of wrong views, when the body dies and life ends, they descend into hell of an evil destiny.

如是我聞：: 又復知彼諸有情等身語意中具足善行， 起彼正見稱讚聖賢， 而復積集正見業因， 身謝命終生於善趣或生天界。
And moreover, he knows all those sentient beings endowed with virtuous practices of body, speech and mind, giving rise to their right views and praising the Noble Ones, and further, accumulating the karma and causes of right views, when the body dies and life ends, they are born in a good destiny and may be born in heavenly worlds.

如是我聞：: 舍利子！ 以清淨天眼出過於人， 於諸有情積集惡業悉能了知。
Śāriputra, with the pure divine eye surpassing that of men, he can see in every detail the evil karma accumulated by sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 舍利子！ 此菩薩摩訶薩清淨天眼， 於諸有情而為最勝，
Śāriputra, this pure divine eye of the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva is considered superior compared to that of sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 色相明了悉無障礙，
It perceives forms and marks in every detail without obstruction.

如是我聞：: 一切天、龍、夜叉、乾闥婆、阿脩羅， 有學無學大阿羅漢、辟支佛眾， 悉勝於彼， 最上最勝、最極明了、無有過上。
It is superior in every respect to that of all the devas, the nāgas, yakṣas, gandharvas, asuras, śaikṣas and aśaikṣas, great arhats and the host of Pratyekabuddhas, supreme, most superior, best in clear perception, having none which surpasses it.

如是我聞：: 又此天眼， 於彼一切出離道中最勝出離。 而諸菩薩有是天眼，
Moreover, this divine eye, among all the paths of salvation, is the most superior salvation, and all Bodhisattvas possess this divine eye.

如是我聞：: 於十方世界無量有情， 若麁若細、若勝若劣、若遠若近， 而此天眼諸有色相，
This divine eye knows in every detail, without any opposing obstruction, the measureless sentient beings of the worlds of the ten directions, whether gross or subtle, superior or inferior, far or near, and all that has form and marks.

如是我聞：: 於彼了知悉無對礙。 又此天眼見色究竟， 除無色界， 所有十方世界無量有情， 若生若滅， 及彼業因一切根因，
Moreover, this heavenly eye sees the limit of form, and excepting the formless worlds, is able to know in every detail the measureless sentient beings which are in the worlds of the ten directions, their manner of ceasing, and their karma-causes and all their root-causes, and whether they increase or decrease, whether they are superior or inferior.

如是我聞：: 若增若減若勝若劣， 悉能了知。 又彼所有十方世界諸佛剎土功德莊嚴， 一切悉見。
Moreover, he sees in every detail all the Buddha-lands which are in the worlds of the ten directions, and their merits and adornments.

如是我聞：: 清淨戒蘊安住成就勝妙果報， 亦皆了知。
He also knows them all to purify the śīla-skandha* and securely abides in the development of samādhi and wonderful fruition.

如是我聞：: 又彼清淨天眼出過於人， 諸佛世尊及菩薩眾一切悉見， 及彼正士正念正知、通達境界威儀道行， 及解脫法得總持門， 安住智慧善巧方便，
Moreover, his pure divine eye, surpassing that of men, sees in every detail all the Buddhas, the World-honored Ones, and the host of Bodhisattvas, and the right recollection and right knowledge of these worthy persons, penetrating the object-spheres, dignified in the practice of the Way, reaching to the Dharma of liberation and attaining the methods of dhāraṇī, abiding securely in prajñā and skillful upāyas.

如是我聞：: 而能入解一切圓滿。
He is able to enter into the perfection of all these.

如是我聞：: 彼眼無礙諸色無見， 彼眼無著諸色無染，
His eye is without obstruction [with regard to] forms, and is without views. His eye is without attachment to all forms and is without distain.

如是我聞：: 彼眼解脫謂離諸見，
The liberation of his eye is described as free from all views.

如是我聞：: 彼眼清淨自體光潔，
The purity of his eye is intrinsically radiant.

如是我聞：: 眼無依止離諸境界， 眼無所取離諸煩惱，
His eye, without attachment, is free from the object-spheres. His eye, without craving, is free from the kleśas.

如是我聞：: 眼無翳障離諸疑惑， 眼不起念離對礙法，
His eye, having no film, is free from doubts. His eye, not giving rise to recollection, is free from the dharmas of opposing obstructions.

如是我聞：: 眼得光明照燭諸法，
His eye attains light and illuminates all dharmas.

如是我聞：: 眼隨智慧離識境界，
His eye is in accordance with prajñā and is free from the object-spheres of vijñāna.

如是我聞：: 彼眼無著離難調伏及彼癡冥一切煩惱。
His eye, without attachment, is free from what is hard to conquer, and its delusion and all kleśas.

如是我聞：: 眼能決擇諸根幻化，
His eye can conjure up the facilities of penetration.

如是我聞：: 又復眼相彼無能勝，
Moreover, the mark of his eye cannot be excelled.

如是我聞：: 於諸有情平等觀矚。
With regard to sentient beings, it contemplates with equality.

如是我聞：: 彼眼清淨離雜思惟，
The purity of his eye is free from confused thinking.

如是我聞：: 彼眼無垢體性光瑩。
His eye, being stainless, is intrinsically radiant.

如是我聞：: 又彼天眼隨其心意而能現前成熟佛眼，
Moreover, his eye, in accordance with his mental will, is able to bring to fruition, present in front of him, the Buddha-eye.

如是我聞：: 眼無貪瞋離諸違順。
His eye, without lust and hatred, is free from resistance and acquiescence.

如是我聞：: 又彼天眼於義境界修行法式如實相應，
Moreover, his eye, with regard to the object-spheres of meaning, cultivates the [proper] forms of Dharma which are truly appropriate.

如是我聞：: 又於有情安住大悲。
Moreover, with regard to sentient beings, he abides in great compassion.

如是我聞：: 又彼天眼來求丐者而無不與，
Moreover, his divine eye does not fail to give to those who come seeking alms.

如是我聞：: 見破戒者亦無瞋怒，
Seeing those who break the precepts, it also has no hostility.

如是我聞：: 於墮落者而常守護， 於懈怠者而常勤策，
With regard to those who fall, it is always protective. It always stimulates those who are lax.

如是我聞：: 為散亂者現禪定分， 為惡慧者示正慧眼，
For those who are confused, it manifests the members of dhyāna, for those of corrupted prajñā, it shows the eye of right prajñā.

如是我聞：: 為邪道者開悟正道， 劣勝解者導以最上佛之知見。
For those of a wrong path, it opens up the comprehension of the right path, those of inferior understanding he guides with the supreme knowledge and views of the Buddha.

如是我聞：: 又彼天眼， 於一切智智最上神通， 於菩提道專注一境決定現前。
Moreover, his divine eye, with regard to the knowledge of all-knowledge, the supreme supernormal faculties, and the path of bodhi, gives sole attention9 to a single object and fixes its presence in front.

如是我聞：: 舍利子！ 此名菩薩摩訶薩而能圓滿彼天眼通及智事業。
Śāriputra, this is called the faculty of the divine eye and the actions of knowledge, which the Bodhisattva-mahāsattva is able to perfect.

如是我聞：: 一時佛在拘尸那國力士生地阿利羅跋提河邊娑羅雙樹間。
At one time, the Buddha was staying at Kusinagara in the land of the Mallas, close to the river Ajitavati, where the twin sal trees stood.

如是我聞：: 爾時世尊與大比丘八十億百千人俱，
At that time, the great bhiksus [monks] as many as 80 billion hundred thousand were with the Blessed One.

如是我聞：: 前後圍遶。
They surrounded him front and back.

如是我聞：: 二月十五日臨涅槃時， 以佛神力出大音聲， 其聲遍滿乃至有頂，
On the 15th of the second month, as the Buddha was about to enter Nirvana, he, with his divine power, spoke in a great voice, which filled the whole world and reached the highest of the heavens.

如是我聞：: 隨其類音普告眾生： 「今日如來、應、正遍知，
It said to all beings in a way each could understand: "Today, the Tathagata [i.e.

如是我聞：: 憐愍眾生， 覆護眾生， 等視眾生如羅睺羅，
Buddha] the Alms-deserving and Perfectly Awakened One, pities, protects and, with an undivided mind, sees beings as he does his [son] Rahula.

如是我聞：: 為作歸依屋舍室宅。
So, he is the refuge and house of the world.

如是我聞：: 大覺世尊將欲涅槃，
The greatly Awakened Blessed One is about to enter Nirvana.

如是我聞：: 一切眾生若有所疑， 今悉可問，
Beings who have doubts may all now put questions to him."

如是我聞：: 為最後問。 」爾時世尊於晨朝時， 從其面門放種種光， 其明雜色， 青、黃、赤、白、頗梨、馬瑙，
At that time, early in the morning, the World-Honoured One emitted from his mouth rays of light of various hues, namely: blue, yellow, red, white, crystal, and agate.

如是我聞：: 光遍照此三千大千佛之世界，
The rays of light shone all over the 3,000 great-thousand Buddha lands.

如是我聞：: 乃至十方亦復如是。
Also, the ten directions were alike shone upon.

如是我聞：: 其中所有六趣眾生遇斯光者， 罪垢煩惱一切消除。
All the sins and worries of beings of the six realms, as they were illuminated, were expiated.

如是我聞：: 是諸眾生見聞是已， 心大憂愁，
People saw and heard this, and worry greatly beset them.

如是我聞：: 同時舉聲悲啼號哭： 「嗚呼慈父，
They all sorrowfully cried and wept: "Oh, the kindest father!

如是我聞：: 痛哉苦哉。
Oh, woe is the day! Oh, the sorrow!"

如是我聞：: 」舉手拍頭搥胸叫喚，
They raised their hands, beat their heads and breasts, and cried aloud.

如是我聞：: 其中或有身體戰慄、涕泣、哽咽。
Of them, some trembled, wept, and sobbed.

如是我聞：: 爾時大地諸山大海， 皆悉震動，
At that time, the great earth, the mountains, and great seas all shook.

如是我聞：: 時諸眾生共相謂言： 「且各裁抑， 莫大愁苦。

如是我聞：: 佛知其意， 便為說是三昧。

如是我聞：: 名坻羅惟逮等正覺、無上士、道法御、天人師、佛、世尊。

Why?

如是我聞：: 善承事其師， 持是三昧， 至一劫、若百劫、若百千劫，

如是我聞：: 莫得有懈倦。 守善師不離，

如是我聞：: 若飲食資用， 衣被、床臥、珍寶以上勿有愛惜。

如是我聞：: 設無者當行乞食給師，

如是我聞：: 承事善師當如奴事大家，

如是我聞：: 當好書是三昧著素上， 當得佛印印之， 當善供養。

如是我聞：: 何謂佛印？

如是我聞：: 所謂不當行、無所貪、無所求、無所想、無所著、無所願、無所向生、無所取、無所顧、無所住、無所礙、無所結、無所有、盡於欲、無所生、無所滅、無所壞、無所敗，

如是我聞：: 道要、道本是印。
This seal is the essence and the root of bodhi.

如是我聞：: 阿羅漢、辟支佛所不能及，
It is beyond Arhats and Pratyekabuddhas, not to mention fools.

如是我聞：: 何況愚癡者？ 是印是為佛印。 」佛言： 「我今說是三昧時， 千八百億諸天、阿須輪、鬼神、龍、人民，

如是我聞：: 得須陀洹道； 八百比丘得阿羅漢； 五百比丘尼得阿羅漢； 萬菩薩得是三昧， 得無從生法於中立；

如是我聞：: 住樂音樹下。 與大苾芻眾⼋千⼈俱, 菩薩摩訶薩三萬六千， 及國王、大臣、婆羅門、居⼠、天龍藥叉，

如是我聞：: ⼈非⼈等， 無量大 眾， 恭敬圍繞， ⽽為說法。
This immeasurable assembly gathered respectfully around the Buddha as he preached the Dharma.

如是我聞：: 爾時， 曼殊室利法王⼦， 承佛威神， 從座⽽起， 偏袒⼀ 肩，
At that time, Manjusri, Prince of the Dharma, through the marvelous power of the Buddha, rose up from his seat, exposed his shoulder, and knelt on his right knee.

Bowing deeply, with palms joined, he addressed the Buddha: World Honored One, may I beseech you to expound the various names and titles of the buddhas their great original vows and extraordinary merits, so that those who hear them may remove karmic obstructions, and sentient beings in the Dharma Semblance Age will obtain great benefit and joy.

如是我聞：: 」 爾時世尊， 讚曼殊室利童⼦⾔：
Then the World Honored One praised Bodhisattva Manjusri: Excellent!

Excellent!

如是我聞：: 善哉！ 曼殊室利！ 汝以大悲， 勸請我說諸佛名 號， 本願功德， 為拔業障所纏有情， 利益安樂像法轉時諸有情故。

如是我聞：: 汝今諦聽！ 極善思 惟！
Now, listen attentively and reflect thoroughly.

如是我聞：: 當為汝說。
I will explain them to you.

如是我聞：: 」曼殊室利⾔： 「唯然願說！
Bodhisattva Manjusri replied: Yes, please instruct us.

如是我聞：: 我等樂聞！
We will listen joyfully.

如是我聞：: 佛號藥 師琉璃光如來、應正等覺， 明⾏圓滿、善逝、世間解、無上⼠、調御丈 夫、天⼈師、佛、薄伽梵。

如是我聞：: 曼殊室利！ 彼佛世尊藥師琉璃光如來， 本⾏菩 薩道時， 發⼗⼆大願， 令諸有情，
