如是我聞：: 所求皆得。 第⼀大願： 願我來世， 得阿耨多羅三藐三菩提時， 自身光明， 熾然照耀，
They are: The first great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain unsurpassed, complete enlightenment, my body will shine forth brilliant rays, illuminating infinite, countless boundless realms.

如是我聞：: 無量無數無邊世界， 以三⼗⼆大丈夫相， ⼋⼗隨好， 莊嚴其身； 令⼀切有 情， 如我無異。
This body will be adorned with Thirty-two Marks of the Great One and Eighty Auspicious Characteristics, enabling all sentient beings to become just like me.

如是我聞：: 第⼆大願： 願我來世， 得菩提時， 身如琉璃， 內外明徹，
The second great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, my body will be translucent inside and out, like lapis lazuli, with brightness and flawless purity.

如是我聞：: 淨無瑕穢； 光明 廣大， 功德巍巍， 身善安住， 燄網莊嚴， 過於日月；
This body will be adorned with superlative virtues and dwell peacefully in a mesh of light more magnificent than the sun or moon.

如是我聞：: 幽冥眾⽣， 悉蒙開 曉， 隨意所趣， 作諸事業。
The light will awaken the minds of all beings dwelling in darkness, enabling them to engage in their pursuits according to their wishes.

如是我聞：: 第三大願： 願我來世， 得菩提時， 以無量無邊智慧方便， 令諸有情， 皆得 無盡所受用物， 莫令眾⽣，
The third great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, with infinite wisdom and skillful means, I will provide all sentient beings with inexhaustible goods to meet their needs so that they will never lack anything.

如是我聞：: 有所乏少。 第四大願： 願我來世， 得菩提時， 若諸有情， ⾏邪道者， 悉令安住菩提道 中； 若⾏聲聞獨覺乘者， 皆以大乘⽽安立之。
The fourth great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, if there are those who follow evil ways, I will set them all upon the bodhi path; if there are those who cultivate the path of the sravaka or pratyekabuddha, I will set them onto the Mahayana path.

如是我聞：: 第五大願： 願我來世， 得菩提時， 若有無量無邊有情， 於我法中，
The fifth great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, I will help all the countless sentient beings who cultivate morality in accordance with my Dharma to observe the precepts to perfection, in conformity with the Three Sets of Pure Precepts.

如是我聞：: 修⾏梵 ⾏， ⼀切皆令得不缺戒， 具三聚戒； 設有毀犯， 聞我名已， 還得清淨， 不 墮惡趣！
Upon hearing my name, even those guilty of disparaging or violating the precepts will regain their purity and avoid descending into the wretched destinies.

如是我聞：: 第六大願： 願我來世， 得菩提時， 若諸有情， 其身下劣， 諸根不具， 醜 陋、頑愚、盲聾、瘖瘂、攣躄背僂、白癩癲狂、種種病苦； 聞我名已， ⼀ 切皆得端正黠慧，
The sixth great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, sentient beings with imperfect bodies, whose senses are deficient, who are ugly, stupid, blind, deaf, mute, crippled, hunchedbacked, leprous, insane, or suffering from various other illnessesupon hearing my name, they will obtain normal bodies, be endowed with intelligence, and intact senses, and will be free of illness and suffering.

如是我聞：: 諸根完具， 無諸疾苦。 第七大願： 願我來世， 得菩提時， 若諸有情，
The seventh great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, sentient beings afflicted with various illnesses, with no one to help them, nowhere to turn, no physicians, no medicine, no family, no home, who are destitute and miserable, will, as soon as my name passes through their ears, be relieved of all their illnesses.

如是我聞：: 眾病逼切， 無救無歸， 無醫 無藥， 無親無家， 貧窮多苦； 我之名號， ⼀經其耳， 眾病悉除， 身⼼安 樂， 家屬資具， 悉皆豐⾜， 乃⾄證得無上菩提。
With mind and body content and at peace, they will enjoy home, family, and property in abundance, and eventually realize unsurpassed enlightenment.

如是我聞：: 第⼋大願： 願我來世， 得菩提時， 若有⼥⼈， 為⼥百惡之所逼惱， 極⽣厭 離， 願捨⼥身； 聞我名已， ⼀切皆得轉⼥成男，
The eighth great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, if there are women who are extremely disgusted with the numerous feminine afflictions, and wish to abandon their female form, upon hearing my name, they will be reborn as men endowed with noble features, and eventually realize unsurpassed enlightenment.

如是我聞：: 具丈夫相， 乃⾄證得無上 菩提。 第九大願： 願我來世， 得菩提時， 令諸有情， 出魔羂網，
The ninth great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, I will help all sentient beings escape from the demons net and free themselves from the bonds of heretical paths.

如是我聞：: 解脫⼀切外道 纏縛； 若墮種種惡見稠林， 皆當引攝， 置於正見， 漸令修習諸菩薩⾏， 速 證無上正等菩提！
Should they be caught in the thicket of wrong views, I will lead them to correct views, gradually inducing them to cultivate the ways of the bodhisattva so that they will promptly realize unsurpassed, complete enlightenment.

如是我聞：: 第⼗大願： 願我來世， 得菩提時， 若諸有情， 王法所錄， 繩縛鞭撻， 繫閉 牢獄， 或當刑戮， 及餘無量災難凌辱， 悲愁煎迫， 身⼼受苦； 若聞我名， 以我福德威神⼒故， 皆得解脫⼀切憂苦！ 第⼗⼀大願：
The tenth great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, those sentient beings who are shackled, beaten, imprisoned, condemned to death, or subjected to countless miseries and humiliations by royal decree, and who are suffering in body and mind from such oppression, need only hear my name to be freed from all those afflictions, thanks to the marvelous power of my merits and virtues.

如是我聞：: 願我來世， 得菩提時， 若諸有情， 饑渴所惱， 為求食故， 造 諸惡業； 得聞我名， 專念受持， 我當先以上妙飲食，
The eleventh great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, if sentient beings who are tormented by hunger and thirst, creating evil karma in their attempts to survive, should hear my name, recite it wholeheartedly and hold fast to it, I will first satisfy them with the most exquisite food and drinks.

如是我聞：: 飽⾜其身， 後以法 味， 畢竟安樂， ⽽建立之。
Later, with the flavor of the Dharma, I will establish them in the realm of peace and happiness.

如是我聞：: 第⼗⼆大願： 願我來世， 得菩提時， 若諸有情， 貧無衣服，
The twelfth great vow: I vow that in the future, when I attain perfect enlightenment, if sentient beings who are utterly destitute, lacking clothes to protect them from mosquitoes and flies, heat and cold, and are suffering day and night, should hear my name, recite it wholeheartedly and hold fast to it, their wishes will be fulfilled.

如是我聞：: 蚊虻寒熱， 晝 夜逼惱； 若聞我名， 專念受持， 如其所好， 即得種種上妙衣服， 亦得⼀切 寶莊嚴具， 華鬘塗香， 鼓樂眾伎，
They will receive all manners of exquisite clothing, precious adornments, flower garlands and incense powder, and will enjoy music and entertainment to their hearts content.

如是我聞：: 隨⼼所翫， 皆令滿⾜。 曼殊室利！ 是為彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來， 應正等覺⾏菩薩道時，
Manjusri, the World Honored Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, Arhat, the Completely Enlightened made these Twelve Sublime Vows when he was cultivating the bodhisattva path.

如是我聞：: 所發⼗⼆ 微妙上願。 復次， 曼殊室利！ 彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來， ⾏菩薩道時， 所發 大願， 及彼佛⼟， 功德莊嚴， 我若⼀劫、若⼀劫餘， 說不能盡。
Moreover, Manjusri, as to these Great Vows made by the Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata while he was practicing the bodhisattva way, as well as the merits, virtues, and adornments of his Buddha Land, I cannot possibly describe them all, not even if I were to speak for a kalpa or more.

如是我聞：: 然彼佛 ⼟， ⼀向清淨， 無有⼥⼈， 亦無惡趣， 及苦音聲；
However, this Buddha Land is utterly pure, without any woman, without the wretched destinies or any sounds of suffering.

如是我聞：: 琉璃為地， ⾦金繩界 道， 城闕宮閣， 軒窗羅網， 皆七寶成；
Its ground is made of lapis lazuli; the boundaries are demarcated with golden cords, the towns, towers, palaces, pavilions, balconies, windows, and draperies are all made of the seven jewels.

如是我聞：: 亦如西方極樂世界， 功德莊嚴， 等 無差別。
The merits, virtues, and adornments of this realm are identical to those of the Land of Ultimate Bliss in the west.

如是我聞：: 於其國中， 有⼆菩薩摩訶薩： ⼀名日光遍照， ⼆名月光遍照。
In this land dwell two great bodhisattvas: One is called Universal Sunlight and the other Universal Moonlight.

如是我聞：: 是彼無量無 數菩薩眾之上首， 次補佛處， 悉能持彼世尊藥師琉璃光如來正法寶藏。
They are the leaders of countless bodhisattvas and will serve as successors to this Buddha, upholding the True Dharma Treasury of the World Honored Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata.

如是我聞：: 是 故曼殊室利！ 諸有信⼼善男⼦、善⼥⼈等， 應當願⽣彼佛世界。
For these reasons, Manjusri, devout men and women should vow to be born in this Buddha Land.

如是我聞：: 爾時世尊， 復告曼殊室利童⼦⾔： 曼殊室利！ 有諸眾⽣， 不識善惡，
The Buddha then told Bodhisattva Manjusri: Manjusri, there are sentient beings who cannot tell right from wrong.

如是我聞：: 唯懷 貪吝， 不知布施， 及施果報，
They are greedy and mean, do not practice charity and do not understand dana and its rewards.

如是我聞：: 愚癡無智，
They lack wisdom and are ignorant.

如是我聞：: 闕於信根， 多聚財寶， 勤加守 護。
Lacking the root of faith, they amass riches, which they assiduously hoard.

如是我聞：: 見乞者來， 其⼼不喜， 設不獲已， ⽽⾏施時， 如割身⾁，
When they see those begging for alms, they become annoyed; when they have to give against their will, they feel as much pain and regret as if they were parting with their own flesh.

如是我聞：: 深⽣痛惜。 復有無量慳貪有情，
Moreover, there are also countless sentient beings who are miserly and avaricious.

如是我聞：: 積集資財， 於其自身， 尚不受用， 何況能與⽗母妻⼦ 奴婢作使，
They amass wealth, yet do not even spend it on themselves, let alone on their parents, spouses, children, servants, slaves, or beggars.

如是我聞：: 及來乞者？ 彼諸有情， 從此命終， ⽣餓鬼界，
Upon their death, these people will descend into the realms of hungry ghosts or animals.

如是我聞：: 或傍⽣趣。 由昔 ⼈間， 曾得暫聞藥師琉璃光如來名故， 今在惡趣， 暫得憶念彼如來名， 即 於念時，
However, if they have briefly heard the name of the Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata when they were humans, although now they are reborn into the wretched destines, if they can recall the Buddhas name even briefly, they will immediately be free from these destinies and be reborn as human beings.

如是我聞：: 從彼處沒， 還⽣⼈中； 得宿命念， 畏惡趣苦，
They will remember their sojourn in the lower destinies, and, dreading their past sufferings, cease to wallow in worldly pleasures.

如是我聞：: 不樂欲樂， 好⾏惠 施， 讚歎施者，
They will gladly practice dana, praise others who do so, and will no longer be ungenerous.

如是我聞：: ⼀切所有， 悉無貪惜， 漸次尚能以頭目⼿手⾜， ⾎血⾁身分， 施來求者， 況餘財物？ 復次，
Gradually, they will even be able to donate their heads, eyes, limbs, blood, flesh, or other parts of their bodies to those who need them, not to mention mere material possessions.

如是我聞：: 曼殊室利！ 若諸有情， 雖於如來受諸學處， ⽽破⼫羅； 有雖不破 ⼫羅，
Moreover, Manjusri, there are sentients beings who accept the teachings of the Tathagata but have violated the precepts; or, they have not violated the precepts, but have broken the regulations.

如是我聞：: ⽽破軌則； 有於⼫羅軌則， 雖得不壞， 然毀正見； 有雖不毀正見， ⽽棄多聞， 於佛所說契經深義， 不能解了；
Or else, while they do not violate the precepts or the regulations, they have disparaged right views; or they have not disparaged right views but have abandoned extensive study of the Dharma and therefore cannot understand the profound meaning of the sutras preached by the Buddha.

如是我聞：: 有雖多聞， ⽽增上慢，
Or else, although they may be knowledgeable, they have grown conceited in their Dharma knowledge.

如是我聞：: 由增上慢， 覆蔽⼼故， 自是非他，
Because conceit clouds the mind, they believe that they are always right and others are the wrong.

如是我聞：: 嫌謗正法， 為魔伴黨。
Or, they deprecate the right Dharma, thereby allying themselves with demons.

如是我聞：: 如 是愚⼈， 自⾏邪見， 復令無量俱胝有情， 墮大險坑。
Such deluded persons not only follow wrong view themselves, but also lead countless other sentient beings into great dangerous pitfall.

如是我聞：: 此諸有情， 應於地獄 傍⽣鬼趣， 流轉無窮。
These sentient beings are bound to wander endlessly on the paths of hell, animals, and hungry ghosts.

如是我聞：: 若得聞此藥師琉璃光如來名號， 便捨惡⾏， 修諸 善法， 不墮惡趣；
Yet, if they should hear the name of the Medicine Buddha, they will abandon evil conduct, cultivate good deeds, and avoid descending into the wretched destinies.

如是我聞：: 設有不能捨諸惡⾏、修⾏善法， 墮惡趣者， 以彼如來本 願威⼒， 令其現前，
Even those who descend into the wretched destinies because they cannot abandon evil practices or cultivate good deeds, they can still benefit from the marvelous power of the Medicine Buddhas original vows.

如是我聞：: 暫聞名號， 從彼命終， 還⽣⼈趣， 得正見精進， 善調 意樂，
If they should hear his name even briefly, at the end of their lives they will be reborn in the human realm, hold right views, be diligent, pursue right liveliood, and discipline their minds to attain joy.

如是我聞：: 便能捨家， 趣於非家，
They will then be able to abandon home life to become monastics.

如是我聞：: 如來法中， 受持學處， 無有毀犯，
They will uphold and study the Dharma of the Tathagatas without disparaging or violating it.

如是我聞：: 正見多聞， 解甚深義， 離增上慢， 不謗正法，
With right views and extensive study, they will fathom the extremely profound meaning [of the teachings], be free from arrogance, and cease to disparage the right Dharma.

如是我聞：: 不為魔伴， 漸次修⾏諸菩薩⾏， 速得圓滿。
They will no longer have demons as companions, but will gradually cultivate the practices of bodhisattvas and swiftly perfect them.

如是我聞：: 復次， 曼殊室利！ 若諸有情， 慳貪嫉妒， 自讚毀他，
Moreover, Manjusri, there are sentient beings who are miserly, avaricious, envious, jealous, praise themselves, and disparage others.

如是我聞：: 當墮三惡趣中， 無量千歲， 受諸劇苦！
They are bound to sink into the three wretched destinies, suffering intense misery for countless thousands of years.

如是我聞：: 受劇苦已， 從彼命終， 來⽣⼈間， 作⽜馬駝驢，
When this intense suffering comes to an end, they will be reborn in the human world as oxen, horses, donkeys or camels.

如是我聞：: 恆被鞭撻， 饑渴逼 惱， 又常負重， 隨路⽽⾏。
Often beaten and suffering from hunger and thirst, they constantly travel along the road carrying heavy loads.

如是我聞：: 或得為⼈， ⽣居下賤， 作⼈奴婢， 受他 驅役， 恆不自在。
If they are reborn as human beings, they will be among the poor and lowly, always serving others and belabored by others, enjoying no freedom.

如是我聞：: 若昔⼈中， 曾聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號， 由此 善因， 今復憶念， ⾄⼼歸依。
However, if any of them, in a former incarnation as a human being, have heard the name of the World Honored Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, and as a result of this good cause, now remember and wholeheartedly take refuge in him, they will, thanks to this Buddhas spiritual powers, be freed from all suffering.

如是我聞：: 以佛神⼒， 眾苦解脫， 諸根聰利， 智 慧多聞， 恆求勝法， 常遇善友，
Their senses will be sharp and they will be wise and learned, constantly seeking the supreme teachings, and meeting with good spiritual friends.

如是我聞：: 永斷魔羂， 破無明殼， 竭煩惱河， 解脫⼀切⽣老病死， 憂愁苦惱。
They will break forever through Maras net, smash the shell of delusion, dry up the river of afflictions, and thus escape all the worry and suffering of birth, old age, illness, and death.

如是我聞：: 復次， 曼殊室利！ 若諸有情， 好喜乖離， 更相⾾訟，
Moreover, Manjusri, there are sentient beings who love to quarrel, create schisms, and engage in legal disputes.

如是我聞：: 惱亂自他， 以身語 意， 造作增長種種惡業，
They make themselves and others suffer, creating and increasing all kinds of evil karma with body, speech, and mind.

如是我聞：: 展轉常為不饒益事， 互相謀害。 告召⼭林樹塚等 神； 殺諸眾⽣， 取其⾎血⾁祭祀藥叉、羅剎婆等；
They plot against one another without mercy, while invoking the spirits of mountains, forests, trees, and tombs, they kill sentient beings and use their flesh and blood as sacrifices to the yaksa and raksara demons.

如是我聞：: 書怨⼈名， 作其形像， 以 惡咒術， ⽽咒詛之； 魘魅蠱道， 咒起屍鬼，
They may also write down the names and make images of those against whom they harbor grudges, curse them with evil mantras or try to harm or kill them with potions, witchcraft, or demons revived from the dead.

如是我聞：: 令斷彼命， 及壞其身。 是諸有 情， 若得聞此藥師琉璃光如來名號， 彼諸惡事， 悉不能害 ⼀切展轉，
However, if the victims succeed in hearing the name of the Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, none of these evil practices can harm them.

如是我聞：: 皆起慈⼼， 利益安樂，
Moreover, everyone concerned will develop compassionate minds, endeavoring to benefit and bring peace and joy to others.

如是我聞：: 無損惱意及嫌恨⼼， 各各歡悅，
Without harmful thoughts and angry spiteful minds, everyone will be happy and content.

如是我聞：: 於自所 受， ⽣於喜⾜， 不相侵凌， 互為饒益。 復次， 曼殊室利！ 若有四眾： 苾芻、苾芻尼、鄔波索迦、鄔波斯迦， 及餘 淨信善男⼦、善⼥⼈等， 有能受持⼋分齋戒， 或經⼀年，
Moreover, Manjusri, there are those in the fourfold assembly of bhiksus, bhiksunis, upasakas, and upasikas, as well as among other men and women of pure faith, who are able to adhere to the Eight Precepts for one year or three months, dedicating these good roots toward rebirths in the Western Land of Ultimate Bliss, so as to listen to the right Dharma from the Buddha Infinite Life.

如是我聞：: 或復三月， 受 持學處， 以此善根， 願⽣西方極樂世界無量壽佛所， 聽聞正法， ⽽未定 者，
However, their rebirth in the pure land is still uncertain.

如是我聞：: 若聞世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號， 臨命終時， 有⼋大菩薩， 其名曰： ⽂文 殊師利菩薩，
But if they hear the name of the World Honored Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata, then, at the time of death, eight great bodhisattvas, namely: Bodhisattva Manjusri, Bodhisattva Guanyin, Bodhisattva Great Strength, Bodhisattva Inexhaustible Mind, Bodhisattva Precious Sandalwood Flower, Bodhisattva Medicine King, Bodhisattva Superior Medicine, and Bodhisattva Maitreya, will descend from space and show them the way.

如是我聞：: 觀世音菩薩， 得大勢菩薩， 無盡意菩薩， 寶檀華菩薩， 藥王 菩薩， 藥上菩薩， 彌勒菩薩。 是⼋大菩薩乘空⽽來， 示其道路， 即於彼 界， 種種雜⾊色眾寶華中， 自然化⽣。
Thereupon, they will be reborn through natural transformation among precious flowers of various colors in that Pure Land.

如是我聞：: 或有因此⽣於天上， 雖⽣天中， ⽽本 善根， 亦未窮盡， 不復更⽣諸餘惡趣。
Moreover, thanks to hearing the Medicine Buddhas name, there are those who are born in the celestial realms, and with their good roots still not exhausted, they will not be born again into the wretched destinies.

如是我聞：: 天上壽盡， 還⽣⼈間， 或為輪王， 統攝四洲，
When their lifespan ends in the celestial realms, they may return to the human realm as Wheel Turning Kings, ruling over the Four Continents.

如是我聞：: 威德自在， 安立無量百千有情， 於⼗善道； 或⽣剎帝利、婆羅 門、居⼠大家， 多饒財寶， 倉庫盈溢，
With marvelous merits and ease, they will set countless hundreds of thousands of sentients beings onto the path of the ten virtues, or they may be born as ksatriyas, Brahmins, or laymen of affluent families, with abundant wealth and overflowing granaries.

如是我聞：: 形相端嚴， 眷屬具⾜， 聰明智慧， 勇健威猛， 如大⼒⼠。
Lan MoThey will be endowed with noble features, large families and full retainers, intelligence and wisdom, as well as courage, vigor, and marvelous power of great heros.

如是我聞：: 若是⼥⼈， 得聞 世尊藥師琉璃光如來名號， ⾄⼼受持， 於後不復更受⼥身。 復次，
Likewise, if there is any woman who hears the name of the World Honored Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Tathagata, and wholeheartedly concentrates on his name, she will never again be reborn with a female body.

如是我聞：: 曼殊室利！ 彼藥師琉璃光如來， 得菩提時， 由本願⼒， 觀諸有情， 遇眾病苦，
Manjusri, when the Medicine Master Lapis Lazuli Light Tathagata attained enlightenment, he realized, by virtue of his original vows, that sentient beings endured various ailments, such as emaciation, crippling disabilities, fever, dysentery, jaundice, etc.

如是我聞：: 瘦⽧疒乾消， 黃熱等病； 或被魘魅蠱毒所中； 或復短命， 或時 橫死；
Some were targets of black magic or various poisons, while others suffered short life or untimely death.

如是我聞：: 欲令是等病苦消除， 所求願滿。
He sought to put an end to these miseries and fulfill the wishes of all sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 時彼世尊， ⼊三摩地， 名曰除滅⼀ 切眾⽣苦惱。
At that time, the World Honored One entered a samadhi called Eliminating All the Suffering and Afflictions of Sentient Beings.

如是我聞：: 既⼊定已， 於⾁髻中， 出大光明， 光中演說， 大陀羅尼曰： 南無 薄伽伐帝 鞞殺社 窶嚕薜琉璃 鉢喇婆 喝囉闍也 怛他揭多耶　 阿囉喝帝 三藐三勃陀耶 怛姪他 唵 鞞殺逝 鞞殺逝 鞞殺社 三沒揭帝莎訶 爾時光中說此咒已， 大地震動，
Having entered that samadhi, a brilliant light shone forth from his urna as he uttered a great dharani: ná mó bó qié fá dì bō lá pó hē là shé yě sān miǎo sān bó tuó yē pí shā shì pí shā shè pí shā shè jù lū bì líu lí dá tā jiē duō yē ā là hē dì dá zhí tā ǎn pí shā shì sān mò jié dì suō hē As soon as the Medicine Buddha, in his radiance, had uttered this mantra, the entire earth shook and shone brilliant lights, Curing the disease and eradicating the suffering of sentient beings, enabling them to enjoy peace and happiness.

如是我聞：: 放大光明， ⼀切眾⽣， 病苦皆除， 受安隱 樂。 曼殊室利！ 若見男⼦⼥⼈， 有病苦者， 應當⼀⼼， 為彼病⼈， 常清淨 澡漱， 或食或藥、或無蟲⽔水、咒⼀百⼋遍，
Manjusri, if you come across any man or woman suffering from illness, you should bathe the body and rinse the mouth of that person; then recite the mantra with one mind one hundred and eight times over his food, medicine, or water that is free from insects.

如是我聞：: 與彼服食， 所有病苦， 悉皆消滅。
Once the sick person has taken the food or drink, the illness and suffering will be eradicted.

如是我聞：: 若有所求， ⾄⼼念誦， 皆得如 是， 無病延年；
If the patient wholeheartedly recites this mantra, he or she will be free of disease and enjoy longevity, with every wish being fulfilled.

如是我聞：: 命終之後， ⽣彼世界， 得不退轉， 乃⾄菩提。
Furthermore, after death, this person will be born in the land of the Medicine Buddha and attain enlightenment without retrogression."

如是我聞：: 一時， 薄伽梵在室羅筏住誓多林給孤獨園，
At one time, the Bhagavat was staying at Śrāvastī, dwelling in the Jeta Grove, in the garden of Donor-to-Those-Alone [i.e.

如是我聞：: 與其無量大苾芻眾、天人等俱。
without anyone to rely on, viz. Anāthapiṇḍada], together with his congregation of countless great bhikṣus, and divinities, humans, and so forth.

如是我聞：: 爾時， 憍薩羅主勝軍大王，
At that time, the Lord of Kośala, the great king Victorious Legions [viz.

如是我聞：: 尊位威德皆悉成就， 為欲瞻仰請問佛故， 嚴駕出城往如來所。
Prasenajit], who was, in his lofty rank and imposing virtues, perfect in all respects, wished to pay his respects to the Buddha, and humbly ask advice of him, so he had a wagon decked out, and left the city for the place where the Thus Come One was.

如是我聞：: 乘至下處步進入園，
He drove as far as the alighting place, and then proceeded into the garden on foot.

如是我聞：: 遙見世尊坐一樹下端嚴殊妙， 諸根閑寂其心宴然， 已能善得最上調順寂止究竟， 已能善到第一調順寂止彼岸， 善能密護降伏諸根， 為丈夫龍、丈夫牛王、丈夫良馬， 清淨無撓如澄泉池， 威德熾盛光明照曜如大金山， 有三十二大丈夫相圓滿莊嚴，
From afar, he beheld the World-Honoured One sitting under a tree—handsome, magnificent, outstanding and marvellous; his faculties serene, his mind calm; he had proven fully capable of attaining supreme discipline, and tranquilly tarried in the ultimate; he had proven fully capable of arriving at the foremost discipline, and tranquilly tarried on that other shore; he was properly capable of closely guarding and conquering his faculties; he was a dragon among men, a king of bulls among men, a fine steed among men; he was pure and unstirred, like a limpid spring or pond; his charismatic aura fiercely blazed, the light of him coruscating, like a great mountain of gold; he possessed the thirty-two marks of a great man [*mahāpuruṣa], bedecking him in their fullness; with the eighty ancillary marks of favour here and the readorning his members.

如是我聞：: 八十隨好間飾支體。 時， 勝軍王遙見佛已， 心喜踊躍不能自勝，
As soon as King Prasenajit thus saw the Buddha from afar, his heart leapt for joy, and he could not contain himself.

如是我聞：: 便即脫去剎帝利種灌頂大王隨身所有五標尊飾： 一者、頂上寶冠； 二者、所執神劍； 三者、眾寶傘蓋；
He doffed forthwith the fivefold insignia and regalia carried about the person by an anointed great king of the kṣatriya race: first, the jewelled crown atop his head; second, the sacred scimitar he bears; third, the jewelled umbrella; fourth, the maṇi [gem] yak-tail fly-whisk; and fifth, the jewelled slippers wovenfrom silk.

如是我聞：: 四者、末尼扇拂； 五者、織成寶履。 既去是已詣如來所，
Once he had doffed these things, he went to where the Buddha was.

如是我聞：: 到已頂禮世尊雙足， 右繞三匝退坐一面。
When he reached (the Buddha), he made obeisance with his head at the feet of the World-Honoured One, circumambulated him three times clockwise, and withdrew to sit to one side.

如是我聞：: 爾時， 勝軍大王坐一面已， 而白佛言： 「大悲世尊！ 惟願如來哀愍教授， 惟願善逝哀愍教誡， 令我長夜證於大義利益安樂。 」爾時， 世尊告大王曰：
Then, when the great king Prasenajit had sat down to one side, he said to the Buddha: “O greatly compassionate World-Honoured One, please may the Thus Come One take pity on me and instruct me; please may the Sugata take pity on me and admonish me—that I may for long hereafter realise the great objective, and benefit, and wellbeing.” Then the World-Honoured One said to the great king: “Excellent, excellent, O great king!—that you can now so humbly ask the Thus Come One about this great objective.

如是我聞：: 「善哉， 善哉！ 大王！
O great king!

如是我聞：: 汝今乃能請問如來如是大義。 大王！ 汝今為大國主， 應以正法勿以邪法， 應隨法行勿隨非法。
You now reign as the lord of a great state; you should do so by means of righteous Dharma, and not by means of perversions of Dharma; you should conduct yourself in accordance with Dharma, and not in accordance with what is not Dharma.

如是我聞：: 所以者何？
Why is that?

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 若有國王或諸王等， 棄捨正法以諸邪法而作國王， 彼於現在為諸聖賢之所訶毀， 後致憂悔， 身壞命終墮諸惡趣，
Know this: If there is a king of a state, or his princes, who abandon righteous Dharma, and exercise their kingship by means of perversions of Dharma, then in the present, they will be upbraided and deprecated by the sages and worthies; and in the future, it will lead to misery and regret, for when the body breaks up, at the end of life, they will fall into evil rebirth destinies, or be reborn in a hell to experience intense suffering.

如是我聞：: 生地獄中受諸劇苦； 又若國王或諸王等， 棄捨邪法以其正法而作國王， 彼於現在為眾聖賢之所稱讚， 後無憂悔， 身壞命終超昇善趣，
If, on the other hand, a king of a state, or his princes, give up perversions of Dharma, and exercise their kingship by means of that Dharma that is rightful for them, then in the present, they will bepraised and eulogized by the sages and worthies; and in the future, there will be no misery and regret, for when the body breaks up, at the end of life, they will pass beyond and above (this world) to a good rebirth destiny, and be reborn among the gods to experience wondrous happiness.

如是我聞：: 生諸天中受諸妙樂。 「大王！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 譬如父母憐愍於子， 心常欲令離苦得樂；
Let us draw an analogy to parents who feel tenderly towards their son: In their hearts, they always wish (the son) to be free of suffering and attain happiness.

如是我聞：: 王亦應爾， 於諸國邑所有眾生， 僮僕、作使、輔臣、僚佐，
A king should also be like this to all the beings of his city-states and towns—the servants, and menials, and courtiers, and officials. “He should gather them (i.e.

如是我聞：: 應以諸佛所說四攝而授受之。
his subjects) in (to his fold) with the four devices of enfoldment (catursaṃgrahavastu) taught by the Buddhas.

如是我聞：: 何等為四？
What are these four (devices)?

如是我聞：: 一者、布施； 二者、愛語； 三者、利行；
First, liberality (giving, dāna); second, pleasant speech; third, beneficial action; fourth, doing the same service [i.e.

如是我聞：: 四者、同事。
pursuing the same practices as them; ‘practicing what you preach’].

如是我聞：: 如是善攝國邑眾生， 僮僕、作使、輔臣、僚佐，
Thus he skilfully gathers up into his fold (saṃ√grah) the beings of his city-states and towns—the servants, and menials, and courtiers, and officials.

如是我聞：: 攝於二義同事同歸。 何等二義？ 一者、現在；
He gathers them into his fold in two senses: he ‘does the same service (as them)’, and he ‘reverts to the same thing (asthem).’ In which two senses?

如是我聞：: 二者、未來。
First, in the present; second, in the future.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 譬如男子或諸女人， 於其夢中夢心所見， 可愛園林可愛山谷， 可愛國邑并諸異類，
Let us draw an analogy to the lovely gardens and parks, or lovely mountains and valleys, or lovely cities and towns, or various other sorts of things seen in dreams by the dreaming minds of men or women.

如是我聞：: 彼夢覺已所見皆無。
Once they have woken up, all they have dreamt is not really there.

如是我聞：: 如是， 大王！
In this same manner, O great king!

如是我聞：: 國祚身命虛偽無常， 一切皆如夢之所見。
The fortunes of state, and life and limb, are vain and transitory; they are all equally like things seen in a dream.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
O great king!

如是我聞：: 王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂， 及餘所受諸欲樂具， 所謂象馬車步諸軍宮殿， 后妃太子諸王， 輔臣僚佐防衛士眾，
Know that the pleasures of wealth and rank of a king, and the pleasures of power of a king, and the pleasures of love and sensuality of a king, and all the objects of desire and pleasure that you enjoy —namely, your legions of elephant and horse (cavalry), chariots, and infantry, your places, queens and courtesans, your crown prince, princes, courtiers, officials, guards, gentlemen, parents, brothers, sisters, wives and concubines, your sons and daughters, servants young and old, menials, the beings of your cities and towns, your gold, silver, jewels, maṇi [gems], pearls, garments, coins and grains, treasuries, and such things—all such things, the objects of desire and pleasure that you enjoy, must be cast aside at the end of life; you will go alone to the next life, and not a single one of them will accompany you.

如是我聞：: 父母兄弟姊妹妻妾， 男女大小僮僕作使國邑眾生， 金銀珍寶末尼真珠， 衣服財穀庫藏等物， 如是所有諸欲樂具， 於命終時皆當棄捨， 獨往後世無一相隨。 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 如上所說一切樂具， 非常非恒不可保信， 皆變易法迅速不停， 流轉移動終歸壞滅， 念念遷謝後為灰燼，
Know that all objects of pleasure, as I have just explained, are impermanent, inconstant, and not to be trusted; they are all mutable things, which hurtle onward ceaselessly, churning and shifting, destined for ultimate destruction; from moment to moment they slip away and decay, and finally turn to ash; in the end, they are uniformly bound for the maw of annihilation; they are perishable things, beset with errors, attended by sudden calamity, and they multiply our woes; they are all alike things that fall to ruin, and are broken and scattered.

如是我聞：: 究竟同趣滅盡之門， 是失壞法有諸怖畏、有諸災橫、多諸愁惱， 皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法。 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 譬如樹林先見開華， 尋復結果後還無果， 先見其葉榮茂青翠， 尋復萎黃後皆凋落。 如是，
Know that we might liken (such things) to a grove of trees: First we see the flowers bloom; but shortly thereafter, they come to fruit; and finally they return to fruitlessness; first we see leaves, verdant and lush; but shortly thereafter, they wither and yellow; and then they all fall away.

如是我聞：: 大王！
Just so, O great king!

如是我聞：: 國祚身命， 王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂， 及餘所愛諸欲樂具， 所謂象馬車步軍等，
are the fortunes of state, and life and limb, and the pleasures of wealth and rank of a king, and the pleasures of power of a king, and the pleasures of love and sensuality of a king, and all the objects of desire and pleasure that you enjoy, namely, your legions of elephant and horse, chariots and infantry, .

如是我聞：: 廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法， 亦復如是。
. . and soon as detailed [earlier] down to: . . . they are all alike things that fall to ruin, and are broken and scattered, inexactly the same manner.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 如大火聚， 先見熾然復極熾然， 轉遍熾然後皆洞然， 雖久熾盛終歸滅盡。 如是，
Know that we might liken (such things) to a great conflagration: We see first that it burns fiercely; then it burns extremely fiercely; but then it returns to (merely) burning fiercely again; and finally, there is nothing at all—even though it long (burnt) fiercely and extravagantly, it ultimately ends up totally quenched.

如是我聞：: 大王！
Just so, O great king!

如是我聞：: 國祚身命， 王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂， 及餘所受諸欲樂具， 所謂象馬車步軍等，
are the fortunes of state, and life and limb, and the pleasures of wealth and rank of a king, and the pleasures of power of a king, and the pleasures of love and sensuality of a king, and all the objects of desire and pleasure that you enjoy, namely, your legions of elephant and horse, chariots and infantry, .

如是我聞：: 廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法， 亦復如是。
. . and so on as detailed [earlier] down to: . . . they are all alike things that fall to ruin, and are broken and scattered, in exactly the same manner.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 如日月輪， 有大神用具大勢力， 放大光明以自莊嚴， 遍照世間終歸隱沒。
Know that we might liken (such things) to the discs of the sun and moon: They havegreat divine power, and are possessed of great force and might, and give forth a great light, and with theirinnate resplendence, they illuminate the world entire; but ultimately, they revert to darkness and sink away.Just so, O great king!

如是我聞：: 如是， 大王！ 國祚身命， 王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂， 及餘所受諸欲樂具， 所謂象馬車步軍等，
are the fortunes of state, and life and limb, and the pleasures of wealth and rank of aking, and the pleasures of power of a king, and the pleasures of love and sensuality of a king, and all theobjects of desire and pleasure that you enjoy, namely, your legions of elephant and horse, chariots andinfantry, .

如是我聞：: 廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法， 亦復如是。
. . and so on as detailed [earlier] down to . . . they are all alike things that fall to ruin, and arebroken and scattered, in exactly the same manner.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 譬如大雲遍覆虛空， 暴風疾雷掣電注雨， 震動天地須臾散滅。
Know that we might liken (such things) to a great cloud: It covers the whole sky, withviolent winds and swift thunder, and racing lightning and torrents of rain, which set heaven and earth atremble;but in an instant, it disperses and vanishes.

如是我聞：: 如是， 大王！
Just so, O great king!

如是我聞：: 國祚身命， 王富貴樂、王自在樂、王愛欲樂， 及餘所受諸欲樂具， 所謂象馬車步軍等，
are the fortunes of state, and life andlimb, and the pleasures of wealth and rank of a king, and the pleasures of power of a king, and the pleasuresof love and sensuality of a king, and all the objects of desire and pleasure that you enjoy, namely, yourlegions of elephant and horse, chariots and infantry, .

如是我聞：: 廣說乃至皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法， 亦復如是。
. . and so on as detailed [earlier] down to: . . . they areall alike things that fall to ruin, and are broken and scattered, in exactly the same manner.

如是我聞：: 是故， 大王！
“Thus, O great king!

如是我聞：: 應善勤修， 隨無常觀、隨盡滅觀， 於自命終常當驚懼， 為大國王應以正法勿以非法， 應隨法行勿隨非法。
You should properly and diligently practice the contemplation that follows impermanence(with each inbreath and outbreath), and the contemplation that follows cessation (with eachinbreath and outbreath); you should constantly be fearful of the end of your life; and you should reign aslord of your great state by means of righteous Dharma, and not by what is not Dharma; you should conductyourself in accordance with Dharma, and not in accordance with what is not Dharma.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 如四大山從四方來， 牢固堅密無有缺漏無諸間隙， 周匝充遍總一合成， 上盡虛空下窮地際， 其中所有一切草木枝條花葉，
Know that it is as if four great mountains were to approach from the four directions—solid and dense, without any gaps or apertures, without any cracks or fissures, fully rounded out on allsides, fused into a single mass, upward exhausting the reach of the heavens, and downward beggaring thelimit of the earth; and all the grasses, trees, branches, flowers and leaves between them, and the sentientbeings that crawl the earth, all these are obliterated—they cannot be escaped by resolve and bravery, theycannot be resisted with strength and might, and they cannot be staved off with spells, or wealth, or medicaments.Just so, O great king!

如是我聞：: 及諸有情蠢動之類皆被磨滅， 難以決勇而可逃避， 難以勢力而能抗拒， 難以呪術財貨藥物而可禁止。 如是， 大王！ 世有四種大怖畏事， 各來磨滅一切眾生， 難以決勇而可逃避， 難以勢力而能抗拒，
there are in the world four monstrous horrors, which approach severally toobliterate all sentient beings—they cannot be escaped by resolve and bravery, they cannot be resisted withstrength and might, and they cannot be staved off with spells, or wealth, or medicaments.

如是我聞：: 難以呪術財貨藥物而能禁止。 「云何四種大怖畏事？
What are thosefour monstrous horrors?

如是我聞：: 大王當知！
O great king!

如是我聞：: 一者、老來逼害， 磨滅眾生少壯； 二者、病來逼害， 磨滅眾生調適； 三者、死來逼害， 磨滅眾生壽命； 四者、衰來逼害， 磨滅眾生興盛。
Know that the first is age, which comes pressing on us, oppressingus, and obliterates the youth of beings; the second is sickness, which comes pressing on us, oppressing us,and obliterates the health of beings; the third is death, which comes pressing on us, oppressing us, andobliterates the life of beings; and the fourth is decay, which comes pressing on us, oppressing us, and obliteratesthe flourishing of beings.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 譬如師子為眾獸王， 入鹿群中搏取一鹿， 若噉未噉自在無難。 其鹿爾時先所騰勇， 入師子口無復能為。
Know that we might liken it to a lion, who is king of the beasts, falling upon a herd ofdeer to seize one of the deer: whether or not he eats, he remains sovereign and untroubled; but the deer,which moments before was bounding away, falls into the lion’s maw, and there is nothing more it can do.Just so, O great king!

如是我聞：: 如是， 大王！ 一切眾生既入無常師子王口， 所有勢力無復能為。
are all beings. As soon as they fall into the maw of the lion-king of impermanence, allthe power in the world can do nothing more for them.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 譬如有人勇健多力毒箭所中，
Know this: It is as if there were a man, brave, sturdy and strong, who is struck by apoisoned arrow.

如是我聞：: 一切威猛皆悉摧滅。
All his valour and force is smashed and annihilated.

如是我聞：: 如是， 大王！
Just so, O great king!

如是我聞：: 一切眾生剛強佷戾， 死箭所中無復勢力、無復救護、無所歸依、無所投竄，
All beings,doughty and mighty as they may be, when they are struck by the arrow of death, no longer have any strength, no longer have any protection, no longer have anything to depend upon, no longer have anywhere to flee.

如是我聞：: 臨欲捨命解支節時， 血肉枯竭心胸熱惱， 焦渴所逼張口大息， 手足紛亂無所堪能， 無有勢力涎涕交流， 大小便利穢污身體， 六根閉塞喉顙哽噎喘息逾急， 良醫拱手棄諸妙藥。 其所飲噉美味珍饌無不悉捨， 偃臥床枕臨往異趣淪沒無際， 生老病死無常瀑流，
On the verge of leaving this life, the limbs and members fall apart, and flesh and blood becomes arid and parched, and the heart is tormented by fever, and a parching thirst oppresses you, and the mouth gapes, and you breathe in great gasps, and your arms and legs flail chaotically; you can do nothing and have no strength; drool and tears flow together, and urine and excrement foul the body; the six faculties are sealed off; you gag with a guttural gurgle, panting ever more frantically; the best doctors fold their hands and put aside their wonder-drugs, and the treats and delicacies you supped upon without exception are cast aside; sprawled out on the deathbed, on the brink of heading for another rebirth destiny, you are tossed and plunged in the limitless, rough torrent of impermanence—of birth, aging, sickness and death; on the brink of the last station, when not a jot remains of life, by dint of the power vested in moral action (karma), the next existence looms into view before you, and you quail in terror of King Yama’s emissaries; swallowed up by the vast black night, you pant in and out; and at that very last, when annihilation is imminent, you are all alone, without any second or other companion; then suddenly you turn your back on this rebirth, and fall under the sway of the next life.

如是我聞：: 至臨終位餘命無幾， 業有力故後有現前。 甚大怖畏琰魔王使， 廣大黑闇夜分所吞， 出息入息最後將滅， 唯獨一身無有第二及餘伴侶， 奄背此生歸於後世。 是大移轉趣大叢林，
This is the great transformation.

如是我聞：: 入大黑闇遊大曠野， 泛大溟海業風所飄， 往無標記冥寞方所，
You go into the great jungle, enter the great darkness, wander the great wasteland, and drift on the face of the vast deep; you are tossed on the winds of karma, and head toward regions unmarked, obscure, and deserted.

如是我聞：: 當於爾時無異救護、無異歸依、無異投竄， 唯除正法。
When that time comes, there is surely no other salvation, no other refuge, no other place to flee, except for righteous Dharma.

如是我聞：: 大王！
O great king!

如是我聞：: 彼於爾時， 唯有正法能為救護、能為宮室、能作歸依， 是所奔趣是所投竄， 能拔眾生出生死苦。
At that time, righteous Dharma is all there is that can serve as salvation, or can serve as a palace, or can function as a refuge, or is a direction to run, or is a place to flee to, or can pluck beings out of the woe of birth-and-death.. “O great king!

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！ 譬如有人寒苦所逼， 唯有煖火日光衣等， 所能止息而可獲安； 熱苦所逼唯林泉等； 若涉遠道唯清涼陰；
Know that it is as if there were a person afflicted by the misery of cold—only a warm fire, or the light of the sun, or garments and the like can give him respite, so that he can find comfort; or one afflicted by the misery of heat, whose only respite is glades, springs, and so on; or one travelling a long road, whose only respite is cool shade; or one afflicted by thirst, whose only respite is pure, cold water; or one afflicted by hunger, whose only respite is ample, fine viands; or one afflicted by illness, whose only respiteis skilled physicians and nurses; or one afflicted by fear, whose only respite is a staunch companion.

如是我聞：: 若渴所逼唯清冷水； 若飢所逼唯多美膳， 若病所逼惟良醫藥及供侍者； 若怖所逼惟強伴侶。 如是， 大王！
“Just so, O great king!

如是我聞：: 一切眾生死箭所中， 無復勢力、無復救護、無所歸依、無所投竄，
all beings, when they are struck by the arrow of birth-and-death, no longer have any strength, no longer have any protection, no longer have anything to depend upon, no longer have anywhere to flee.

如是我聞：: 臨欲捨命解支節時， 血肉枯竭心胸熱惱， 焦渴所逼張口太息， 手足紛亂無所堪能，
On the verge of leaving this life, the limbs and members fall apart, and flesh and blood becomes arid and parched, and the heart is tormented by fever, and a parching thirst oppresses you, and the mouth gapes, and you breathe in great gasps, and your arms and legs flail chaotically; you can do nothing and have no strength, .

如是我聞：: 廣說乃至彼於爾時唯有正法， 能為救護、能為宮室、能作歸依， 是所奔趣是所投竄，
. . and so on, down to: . . . At that time, righteous Dharma is all there is that can serve as salvation, or can serve as a palace, or can function as a refuge, or is a direction to run, or is a place to flee to, or can pluck beings out of the woe of birth-and-death.

如是我聞：: 能拔眾生出生死苦。 所以者何？
And why is that?

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 如是身者， 雖加守護雖久洗飾， 雖以眾多上妙飲食恣意飽滿， 及至臨終， 要當不免飢渴所逼而便捨命。
Know that the body being thus, one might well lavish protection upon it; one might well for a long time wash it and adorn it; one might well sate it as much as one pleases with exquisite food and drink—but when one reaches the brink of the end of life, there is no way one will avoid dying oppressed by hunger and thirst.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 如是身者， 雖常澡浴， 塗香末香熏香花鬘隨意嚴飾， 由此自體穢漏成故， 臨捨命時， 終必歸於不淨臭穢。
Know that the body being thus, one might well bathe it always, and festoon it as one likes with scented unguents, or perfumed talcs, or sweet perfumes, or garlands—but because it is essentially made of filth and corruption, when one stands on the verge of giving life up, it will finally and certainly return to foulness, stench and filth.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 如是身者， 雖以種種上妙衣服覆蔽纏裹， 由此自身諸不淨物所合成故， 於命終時， 要當不淨種種流出。
Know that the body being thus, one might well swaddle it and wrap it and cover it with all sorts of exquisite garments—but because it is innately a compound of impure things, when life is at an end, it will surely ooze with all sorts of corruption.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 如是身者， 雖處宮室后妃婇女內官美人眷屬圍遶， 作眾伎樂種種倡伎， 以自娛樂歡喜快樂， 臨命終時，
Know that the body being thus, one might well dwell in a palace, surrounded by an entourage of queens, concubines, courtesans, and beauties, and have them perform dance and music and all sorts of entertainments in order to amuse oneself, cheer oneself, and enjoy oneself—but when the end of life is nigh, ill omens will spontaneously appear, and you will surely be terrified, woebegone, and sorely troubled.

如是我聞：: 自見惡相， 要當驚怖憂悲苦惱。 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 如是身者， 雖處宮室綵飾圖畫殿閣樓臺， 戶牖軒窓重關密掩， 種種香花以自嚴飾， 種種燈燭增光照明， 施設珍奇屏障帷幄， 燒眾名香散諸妙花， 香花寶瓶處處陳列， 安置種種金銀琉璃眾寶床座， 敷設上妙氍氀錦繡文蓐花氈，
Know that the body being thus, for all that one might dwell in a palace, with tapestries and paintings, pavilions and turrets, doors and shutters and verandas and windows, ensconced in layered walls and closely secluded; with all kinds of flowers to adorn oneself, and all kinds of lamps to brighten and lighten up the place; appointed with expensive and exquisite screens and canopies; burning renowned incenses, and scattering wonderful flowers, with fragrant blossoms in precious vases lined up everywhere in rows; setting out all kinds of couches and divans of gold, silver, and beryl, and laying out the finest felt mats, and brocade, and patterned rugs, and floral felts; with vermilion cushions placed at both ends of the couches, covered with the finest embroidered kerchiefs and fancy coverlets, so that waking or sleeping, in rest or repose, one is blissful and absorbed—but once life is over, you will perceive none of that.

如是我聞：: 床座兩頭俱置丹枕， 覆以上妙綺帊錦衾， 寤寐安寢歡娛耽著， 於命終後無所覺知， 或送屍骸置於葬所， 烏鵲鵰鷲狐狼野干， 餓狗鵄梟諸惡禽獸爭共食噉， 骨肉膿血鬚髮糞穢， 流溢地上臭處可惡。
“And perhaps they will send your corpse to be flung on the charnel ground, and crows and carrion birds, and foxes, wolves, and jackals, and ravenous dogs and owls, and all manner of evil birds and beasts will contend with one another to eat your bones, flesh, marrow and blood, and your whiskers and hair and excrement and ordure will spill across the ground, in an abominable place of stench.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 如是身者， 先常乘馭香象駿馬眾寶輦輿， 擊鼓吹貝作大音樂， 眾寶傘蓋隨侍於後， 執持扇拂掩映搖動， 無量勇健象軍馬軍車軍步軍導從前後，
Know that the body being thus, where formerly, you always rode perfumed elephants, or fine steeds, or bejewelled palanquins; with kettledrums beating and conches blasting, and a great fanfare struck up; followed behind by attendants shading you from the sun with jewelled canopies and flourishing yak-tail fly-whisks; with countless doughty and valiant regiments of elephant, horse, chariots and infantry, parading before and behind and guarding your left and right; with hundreds and thousands of ministers and courtiers sincerely singing your praises, and the people of the cities and towns saluting and cheering— although you might have enjoyed such excellent rewards as these, and power and glory, before long, you will certainly close your eyes, and stretch out your arms, and stir no more; your corpse will lie flat on its back on the funeral bier, and be carried by a throng out the gate of the city; and your parents, wives, children, brothers, sisters, menials, servants, courtiers, attendants, relatives and intimates will follow behind and on either side, their hearts trammelled by grief, their hair loose and unbound, raising their hands to bludgeon their heads, beating their breasts and dolefully keening, so shaken by grief they collapse, all wailing, ‘Woe!’ And the people of the cities and towns of the land, seeing them, will cry out a lament, and accompany the corpse to the funeral ground.

如是我聞：: 防衛左右百千臣僚竭誠敬奉， 城邑士庶合掌驚歎。 雖受如是勝妙果報自在榮華， 不久要當瞑目辟手無復動搖， 橫屍偃仰喪車輿上， 眾人荷挽出大城門， 父母妻子兄弟姊妹作使僮僕群僚輔佐， 親屬內人隨從左右， 心纏憂惱頭髮被散， 舉手拍頭椎胸悲噎， 哀感崩慟皆言： 『苦哉！ 』城邑國人覩之號慕。 隨送葬所， 或有露屍施諸禽獸， 鳥鵲餓狗鵰鷲鵄梟， 狐狼野干及諸惡獸， 楂掣食噉骨肉狼籍， 風飃日曝雨漬霜封，
“And perhaps your corpse might be exposed, and given over to the birds and beasts, so that all manner of evil beasts—crows and ravenous dogs, and carrion birds and owls, and foxes, wolves, and jackals— will rip it and tear it and eat and devour it, and the bones and flesh will litter the ground in a jumble, blasted by wind and baked by sun, drenched by rain and caked with frost, the limbs dismembered and flung apart, scattered separately here and there.

如是我聞：: 支節解散零落異所； 或有積薪以火焚葬， 筋骨焦爛血肉消化， 臭煙熢㶿四面充塞，
“Or else it might be that a pyre is built, and you are cremated in the fire, and the muscles and bones are burnt to bits, and the blood and flesh steam off, and putrid smoke billows and reeks and chokes on all sides, and when the fire dies, the bones will have vanished, and flown in ash and scattered as dust.

如是我聞：: 火滅骨消灰飛塵散； 或有掘地埋殯墳陵， 經歷多時肉消骨腐。
“Or it might be that a hole is dug in the ground, and you will be interred and encoffined in a burial mound, and after much time passes, the flesh will waste away and the bones will rot.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 此身如是變壞無常， 一切眾生及以諸行皆悉如是， 非常非恒不可保信， 皆變易法迅速不停， 流轉移動終歸壞滅，
Know that just as the body is thus mutable, destructible, and impermanent, all beings, and all compounded things, are without exception similarly impermanent, inconstant, and not to be trusted; they are all mutable things, which hurtle onward ceaselessly, churning and shifting, destined for ultimate destruction; from moment to moment they slip away and decay, and finally turn to ash; in the end, they are uniformly bound for the maw of annihilation; they are perishable things, beset with terrors, attended by sudden calamity, and they multiply our woes; they are all alike things that fall to ruin, and are broken and scattered.

如是我聞：: 念念遷謝後為灰燼， 究竟同趣滅盡之門， 是失壞法， 有諸怖畏有諸災橫多諸愁惱， 皆是墜墮零落斷壞離散之法。 「是故， 大王！
“Thus, O great king!

如是我聞：: 應善勤修， 隨無常觀、隨盡滅觀， 勿為貪欲之所染污， 勿為瞋恚之所鼓動， 勿為愚癡之所覆蔽， 勿復耽染王富貴樂， 勿復耽染王自在樂， 勿復耽染王愛欲樂， 勿復耽染及餘所受諸欲樂具。
You should properly and diligently practice the contemplation that follows impermanence (with each inbreath and outbreath), and the contemplation that follows cessation (with each inbreath and outbreath); be not polluted by the taint of greed; be not driven by the drumbeat of wrath; be not veiled by ignorance; wallow no more in the pleasures of wealth and rank of a king; wallow no more in the pleasures of power of a king; wallow no more in the pleasures of love and sensuality of a king; wallow no more in the other objects of desire and pleasure that you enjoy.

如是我聞：: 應當滅除財命憍逸， 應當驚懼無常死魔， 不與人期奄忽而至。
You should root out and quash all arrogance and negligence with regard to wealth and life; you should ever fear the devil’s legions of impermanence and death, whose advent is sudden and unforeseen.

如是我聞：: 為大國主， 應以正法勿以非法， 應隨法行勿隨非法，
“You reign as lord of a great state, and you should do so by means of righteous Dharma, and not by means of perversions of Dharma; you should conduct yourself in accordance with Dharma, and not in accordance with what is not Dharma.

如是我聞：: 應愍眾生皆如一子， 應當至誠護持佛法， 紹隆三寶勿復餘顧。
You should feel tenderly for beings as if they were your only son; you should most sincerely protect and sustain the Buddha’s Dharma, and secure the succession of the Three Jewels; do not any longer have regard for other things.

如是我聞：: 所以者何？
And why is that?

如是我聞：: 生死海中流轉無始， 唯佛正法是大津梁， 千萬億劫實難值故。
Because we tumble and churn in the ocean of birth-and-death from beginningless time, and only the true Dharma of the Buddha is our bridge, but in a thousand, a myriad, a billion kalpas, it is truly difficult to meet with it.

如是我聞：: 「大王當知！
“O great king!

如是我聞：: 我終不說獲得世間諸欲樂具， 積聚受用名富貴者， 我說獲得諸佛正法聖慧財寶積聚受用， 乃名圓滿真富貴者。
Know that I have never taught that the winning of the objects of worldly desire and pleasure, accumulating them, and enjoying them is called wealth and rank; I teach that the winning of the wealth and treasure of the sagely wisdom of the true Dharma of the Buddhas, accumulating it, and enjoying it—only that is called perfect, true wealth and rank.

如是我聞：: 是故， 大王！
For this reason, O great king!

如是我聞：: 應當厭離世間所有諸欲樂具， 應當願求諸佛正法聖慧財寶。 」時薄伽梵說是經已， 憍薩羅主勝軍大王，
You should turn away in disgust from all objects of worldly desire and pleasure; you should seek the wealth and treasure of the sagely wisdom of the true Dharma of the Buddhas.” At that time, when the Bhagavat had preached this sutra, the Lord of Kośala, the great king Prasenajit, and the assembly of humans, gods, etc.

如是我聞：: 及諸世間天人等眾， 聞佛所說皆大歡喜， 信受奉行。
of all the worlds, hearing what was preached by the Buddha, all greatly rejoiced, accepted it in faith, and reverentially upheld it.

如是我聞：: 一時， 婆伽婆入於神通大光明藏，
At one time the Bhagavan entered the Samadhi of the Great Illuminating Storehouse of Spiritual Penetration.

如是我聞：: 三昧正受， 一切如來光嚴住持，
This is the samadhi in which all Tathagatas brightly and majestically abide.

如是我聞：: 是諸眾生清淨覺地；
It is the ground of the pure enlightenment of all sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 身心寂滅平等本際， 圓滿十方不二隨順，
[The Bhagavan’s] body and mind were in the state of quiescent-extinction, where past, present, and future are intrinsically equal and identical, and his completeness filled all ten directions, and was in accord with everything without duality.

如是我聞：: 於不二境現諸淨土。
From within this condition of nonduality, he caused various Pure Lands to appear.

如是我聞：: 與大菩薩摩訶薩十萬人俱，
[The Bhagavan] was accompanied by one hundred thousand great bodhisattvas and mahasattvas .

如是我聞：: 其名曰文殊師利菩薩、普賢菩薩、普眼菩薩、金剛藏菩薩、彌勒菩薩、清淨慧菩薩、威德自在菩薩、辯音菩薩、淨諸業障菩薩、普覺菩薩、圓覺菩薩、賢善首菩薩等，
Chief among them were Bodhisattva Manjusri, Bodhisattva Samantabhadra, Bodhisattva of Universal Vision, Bodhisattva Vajragarbha, Bodhisattva Maitreya, Bodhisattva of Pure Wisdom, Bodhisattva at Ease in Majestic Virtue, Bodhisattva of Sound Discernment, Bodhisattva Cleansed of All Karmic Obstructions, Bodhisattva of Universal Enlightenment, Bodhisattva of Complete Enlightenment, and Bodhisattva Foremost in Virtue and Goodness.

如是我聞：: 而為上首； 與諸眷屬皆入三昧， 同住如來平等法會。
Together with their retinues, they all entered samadhi, abiding in the Tathagata’s Dharma assembly of impartial equality.

如是我聞：: 於是文殊師利菩薩在大眾中即從座起， 頂禮佛足右遶三匝， 長跪叉手而白佛言： 「大悲世尊！
Bodhisattva Manjusri Thereupon Bodhisattva Manjusri rose from his seat in the midst of the assembly, prostrated himself at the feet of the Buddha, circled the Buddha three times to the right, knelt down, joined his palms, and said: “O World Honored One of great compassion!

如是我聞：: 願為此會諸來法眾， 說於如來本起清淨因地法行，
Please expound to the multitude who have come to this assembly the Tathagata’s Dharma practice of the original-arising purity of the causal ground.

如是我聞：: 及說菩薩於大乘中發清淨心， 遠離諸病，
Please also expound to us how bodhisattvas may initiate this state of pure mind within the Mahayana and leave all illness.

如是我聞：: 能使未來末世眾生求大乘者不墮邪見。 」作是語已五體投地，
[Pray teach us] so that sentient beings in the future Dharma Ending Age who aspire to the Mahayana will not fall into erroneous views.” Having said these words, he prostrated himself on the ground.

如是我聞：: 如是三請終而復始。
He made the same request three times, each time repeating the same procedure.

如是我聞：: 爾時， 世尊告文殊師利菩薩言：
At that time the World Honored One said to Bodhisattva Manjusri: “Excellent, excellent!

如是我聞：: 「善哉！ 善哉！ 善男子！ 汝等乃能為諸菩薩諮詢如來因地法行，
Virtuous man, for the benefit of the multitude of bodhisattvas you have asked about the Tathagata’s Dharma practice of the causal ground.

如是我聞：: 及為末世一切眾生求大乘者， 得正住持不墮邪見。
For the benefit of all sentient beings in the Dharma Ending Age who aspire to Mahayana, you asked how they can attain correct abiding and not fall into erroneous views.

如是我聞：: 汝今諦聽！
Listen attentively now.

如是我聞：: 當為汝說。 」時， 文殊師利菩薩奉教歡喜， 及諸大眾默然而聽。
I shall explain it to you.” Hearing this, Bodhisattva Manjusri was filled with joy and listened silently along with the assembly.

如是我聞：: 「善男子！ 無上法王有大陀羅尼門， 名為圓覺， 流出一切清淨真如菩提涅槃及波羅蜜教授菩薩。
“Virtuous man, the Supreme Dharma King possesses the method of the great dharani called Complete Enlightenment, out of which emanates pure true suchness, bodhi, and nirvana, as well as the paramitas to teach bodhisattvas.

如是我聞：: 一切如來本起因地， 皆依圓照清淨覺相，
The original-arising [purity] of the causal ground of all Tathagatas relies on the complete illumination of [intrinsic] enlightenment, which is pure [in essence] and permanently free from ignorance.

如是我聞：: 永斷無明方成佛道。
Only then do the [Tathagatas] accomplish the Buddha Path.

如是我聞：: 云何無明？
“What is ignorance?

如是我聞：: 善男子！ 一切眾生從無始來種種顛倒， 猶如迷人四方易處，
Virtuous man, since beginningless time, all sentient beings have had all sorts of delusions, like a disoriented person who has lost his sense of direction.

如是我聞：: 妄認四大為自身相， 六塵緣影為自心相；
They mistake the four great elements as the attributes of their bodies, and the conditioned impressions of the six sense objects as the attributes of their minds.

如是我聞：: 譬彼病目見空中花及第二月。
They are like a man with an illness of the eyes who sees an [illusory] flower in the sky, or a second moon.

如是我聞：: 善男子！ 空實無花， 病者妄執。
“Virtuous man, there is in reality no flower in the sky, yet the sick man mistakenly clings to it.

如是我聞：: 由妄執故， 非唯惑此虛空自性， 亦復迷彼實花生處，
Because of his mistaken clinging, he is not only deluded about the intrinsic nature of empty space, but also confused about the arising of the flower.

如是我聞：: 由此妄有輪轉生死，
Because of this false existence [to which he clings], he remains in the turning wheel of birth and death.

如是我聞：: 故名無明。
Hence this is called ignorance.

如是我聞：: 善男子！ 此無明者非實有體，
“Virtuous man, this ignorance has no real substance.

如是我聞：: 如夢中人夢時非無， 及至於醒了無所得；
It is like a person in a dream. Though the person exists in the dream, when [the dreamer] awakens, there is nothing that can be grasped.

如是我聞：: 如眾空花滅於虛空， 不可說言有定滅處，
Like an [illusory] flower in the sky that vanishes into empty space, one cannot say that there is a fixed place from which it vanishes.

如是我聞：: 何以故？
Why?

如是我聞：: 無生處故。
Because there is no place from which it arises!

如是我聞：: 一切眾生於無生中， 妄見生滅，
Amidst the unarisen, all sentient beings deludedly perceive birth and extinction.

如是我聞：: 是故說名輪轉生死。
Hence this is called the turning wheel of birth and death.

如是我聞：: 善男子！ 如來因地修圓覺者， 知是空花，
“Virtuous man, one who practices Complete Enlightenment of the causal ground of the Tathagata realizes that [birth and extinction] are like an illusory flower in the sky.

如是我聞：: 即無輪轉， 亦無身心受彼生死，
Thus there is no continuance of birth and death and no body or mind that is subject to birth and death.

如是我聞：: 非作故無，
This nonexistence of [birth and death and body and mind] is so not as a consequence of contrived effort.

如是我聞：: 本性無故。
It is so by its intrinsic nature.

如是我聞：: 彼知覺者猶如虛空， 知虛空者即空花相，
“The awareness [of their nonexistence] is like empty space. That which is aware of the empty space is like the appearance of the illusory flower.

如是我聞：: 亦不可說無知覺性。
However, one cannot say that the nature of this awareness is nonexistent.

如是我聞：: 有、無俱遣， 是則名為淨覺隨順。
Eliminating both existence and nonexistence is in accordance with pure enlightenment.

如是我聞：: 何以故？
“Why is it so?

如是我聞：: 虛空性故， 常不動故，
Because the nature of empty space is ever unmoving.

如是我聞：: 如來藏中無起滅故，
Likewise, there is neither arising nor perishing within the Tathagatagarbha.

如是我聞：: 無知見故，
It is free from conceptual knowledge and views.

如是我聞：: 如法界性究竟圓滿遍十方故； 是則名為因地法行。
Like the nature of dharmadhatu , which is ultimate, wholly complete, and pervades all ten directions, such is the Dharma practice [of the Tathagata] of the causal ground.

如是我聞：: 菩薩因此於大乘中發清淨心，
“Because of this [intrinsic completeness], bodhisattvas within the Mahayana may give rise to pure bodhi-mind.

如是我聞：: 末世眾生依此修行不墮邪見。 」爾時， 世尊欲重宣此義而說偈言： 「文殊汝當知， 一切諸如來，
If sentient beings in the Dharma Ending Age practice accordingly, they will not fall into erroneous views.” At that time, the World Honored One, wishing to clarify his meaning, proclaimed these gathas: Manjusri, you should know that all Tathagatas, from their original-arising causal ground, use wisdom to enlighten and penetrate ignorance.

如是我聞：: 」於時世尊即從座起， 纔起座已從佛身出種種光明， 間錯妙色照觸十方，

如是我聞：: 悉皆警覺， 然後趣道。
Being thus alerted, all set off on the road.

如是我聞：: 時婆羅門以恭敬心持妙香華，
At that time, respectfully escorting the Buddha, the Brahmin held wonderful incense and flowers with a reverent heart.

如是我聞：: 與諸眷屬及天龍八部、釋梵四王， 先行治道， 奉引如來。

如是我聞：: 爾時世尊前路不遠， 中至一園名曰豐財。
At that time the World-Honored One, having traveled not too far on the road, came to a garden called Abundant Wealth.

如是我聞：: 於彼園中有古朽塔，

如是我聞：: 摧壞崩倒荊棘掩庭、蔓草封戶瓦礫埋隱， 狀若土堆。

如是我聞：: 釋迦牟尼！ 今日所行極善境界。

如是我聞：: 又婆羅門！ 汝於今日獲大善利。 」爾時世尊禮彼朽塔， 右繞三迊，

如是我聞：: 脫身上衣用覆其上， 泫然垂淚涕血交流，

如是我聞：: 泣已微笑。

如是我聞：: 當爾之時， 十方諸佛皆同觀視亦皆流淚， 各所放光來照是塔。

如是我聞：: 于時大眾驚愕變色， 互欲決疑。
At that time the huge assembly was so astonished as to lose their color and wanted to resolve their bewilderment.

如是我聞：: 爾時金剛手菩薩等亦皆流淚，

如是我聞：: 由是妙事， 是塔所在之處， 有大神驗殊勝威德，
Because of these wondrous things, the site of this pagoda has great spiritual efficacy and superb, awesome virtue.

It can fill the entire world with auspicious events.’ When the huge assembly heard the Buddha’s words, they abandoned their emotional defilements, ended their afflictions, and obtained the pure Dharma-eye.

如是我聞：: 時眾機異利益亦別， 須陀洹果、斯陀含果、阿那含果、阿羅漢果、辟支佛道， 及菩薩道、阿鞞跋致、薩波若智， 於如是事各得其一， 或有證得初地二地乃至十地，

如是我聞：: 或有滿足六波羅蜜。 其婆羅門遠塵離垢， 得五神通。

如是我聞：: 由如是故， 九十九百千萬俱胝一切如來應正等覺側塞無隙猶如胡麻重疊赴來，

如是我聞：: 晝夜現身加持其人。

如是我聞：: 如是一切諸佛如來無數恒沙，

如是我聞：: 前聚未去後群重來，

如是我聞：: 須臾推遷迴轉更赴， 譬如細沙在水旋急，

如是我聞：: 不得停滯迴去復來。

If a person makes offerings of incense, flowers, solid perfumes, garlands, apparel, and wonderful decorative objects to this Sūtra, he in effect makes an entire offering before 99 billion koṭi Tathāgatas in the ten directions, of divine incense, flowers, apparel, and decorative objects made of the seven treasures, all piled high like Mount Sumeru.

如是我聞：: 由諸眾生業果劣故隱蔽不現。

如是我聞：: 由塔隱故， 如來全身非可毀壞，

如是我聞：: 我若滅度， 後世末法逼迫之時，
After I have abandoned my body, the ending of the Dharma will be unrelenting in future times.

如是我聞：: 若有眾生習行非法應墮地獄， 不信三寶不植善根，

如是我聞：: 為是因緣佛法當隱，

如是我聞：: 然猶是塔堅固不滅， 一切如來神力所持。
However, this pagoda will still be solid and will not be demolished because it is supported by the spiritual powers of all the Tathāgatas.

如是我聞：: 無智眾生惑障覆蔽， 徒朽珍寶不知採用，
However, ignorant beings, obscured and obstructed by their delusions, not knowing how to excavate and make use of it, would leave the treasure in disuse.

如是我聞：: 以是事故我今流淚， 彼諸如來亦皆流淚。 」復次佛告金剛手言： 「若有眾生書寫此經置塔中者， 是塔即為一切如來金剛藏窣都婆，

如是我聞：: 亦為一切如來陀羅尼心祕密加持窣都婆， 即為九十九百千萬俱胝如來窣都婆， 亦為一切如來佛頂佛眼窣都婆， 即為一切如來神力所護。

If you enshrine this Sūtra inside a Buddha’s statue in a stūpa, the statue will in effect be made of the seven treasures.

如是我聞：: 靈驗應心， 無願不滿；
This statue will be so efficacious and responsive that all wishes will be fulfilled without exception.

如是我聞：: 或土或木若石若甎， 由經威力自為七寶。

如是我聞：: 一切如來於此經典加其威力，
Moreover, all the Tathāgatas will increase the power of this Sūtra.

如是我聞：: 以誠實言不斷加持。
Keeping a sincere promise, they support it incessantly.

如是我聞：: 生免災殃、死生佛家。

如是我聞：: 塔及形像所在之處， 一切如來神力所護，
‘Furthermore, the place of the pagoda or of its image will be protected by the spiritual powers of all the Tathāgatas.

如是我聞：: 其處不為暴風雷電霹靂所害，
The place will not be damaged by hurricanes, lightening, or thunderbolt.

The radiance of the emanations of all the Tathāgatas of the present and of the future as well as the whole- body relics of all the Buddhas of the past is in this Treasure Chest Seal Dhāraṇī.

The three bodies of every Tathāgata are also in it.’ Then the Buddha pronounced the Dhāraṇī: namas tryadhvikānāṁ sarva tathāgatānāṁ | oṁ bhuvi-bhavana-vare vacana- vacati | suru suru dhara dhara | sarva tathāgata dhātu dhare padmaṁ bhavati | jaya vare mudre | smara tathāgata dharma-cakra pravartana vajre bodhimaṇḍa- alaṅkāra-alaṅkṛte | sarva tathāgata-adhiṣṭhite | bodhaya bodhaya bodhi bodhi budhya budhya | saṁbodhani saṁbodhaya | cala cala calantu sarva-āvaraṇāni | sarva pāpa vigate | huru huru sarva śoka vigate | sarva tathāgata hṛdaya vajriṇi | saṁbhāra saṁbhāra | sarva tathāgata guhya dhāraṇī mudre | bhūte subhūte | sarva tathāgata-adhiṣṭhita dhātu garbhe svāhā | samaya-adhiṣṭhite svāhā | sarva tathāgata hṛdaya dhātu mudre svāhā | supratiṣṭhita stūpe tathāgata-adhiṣṭhite huru huru hūṁ hūṁ svāhā | oṁ sarva tathāgatoṣṇīṣa dhātu mudrāṇi sarva tathāgata sadhātu vibhūṣita-adhiṣṭhite hūṁ hūṁ svāhā || After the Buddha finished reciting this spiritual Mantra, all the Buddha-Tathāgatas from the pile of earth voiced their praises: ‘Very good!

如是我聞：: 梨音)冐地滿拏(十三)楞迦囉(十四)楞訖哩(二合)諦(十五)薩嚩怛他(引)蘖多地瑟恥(二合)諦(十六)冐馱野冐馱野(十七)冐地冐地(十八)沒𠆙沒𠆙(十九)參冐馱儞參冐馱野(二十)者攞者攞(二十一)者懶都(二十二)薩嚩嚩囉拏儞(二十三)薩嚩播波尾蘖諦(二十四)戶嚕戶嚕(二十五)薩嚩戍迦弭蘖帝(二十六)薩嚩怛他蘖多(二十七)紇哩(二合)娜野嚩日囉(二合)抳(二十八)三婆囉三婆囉(二十九)薩嚩怛他蘖多(三十)虞呬野(二合)馱囉抳畝涅梨(二合)(三十一)沒悌蘇沒悌(三十二)薩嚩怛他蘖多(引)地瑟恥(二合)多(三十三)馱覩蘖陛娑嚩(二合)賀(三十四)三摩耶(引)地瑟恥(二合)帝娑嚩(二合)訶(三十五)薩嚩怛他蘖多紇哩(二合)娜野馱覩畝捺犁(二合)娑嚩(二合)訶(三十六)蘇鉢羅(二合)底瑟恥(二合)多薩覩(二合)閉怛他蘖多地瑟恥(二合)帝戶嚕戶嚕吽吽娑嚩(二合)訶(三十七)唵薩嚩怛他蘖多(三十八)塢瑟抳(二合)沙馱覩畝捺囉(二合)尼薩嚩怛他蘖單娑馱覩尾部使多地瑟恥(二合)帝(三十九)吽吽娑嚩(二合)訶(引)(四十)」爾時佛說是神呪已， 諸佛如來自土聚中出聲讚言： 「善哉善哉！
Very good!

如是我聞：: 釋迦世尊出濁惡世， 為利無依無怙眾生演說深法。
Śākya the World- Honored One, you have appeared in this turbid, evil world to expound the profound Dharma for the benefit of sentient beings that have nothing and nobody to depend upon.

如是我聞：: 如是法要久住世間， 利益廣多安穩快樂。 」于時佛告金剛手言：
Therefore, the essence of the Dharma will remain a long time in the world, bringing wide, abundant benefits and joyful peace.’ Then the Buddha said to Vajrapāṇi, ‘Hearken!

如是我聞：: 「諦聽諦聽。
Hearken!

如是我聞：: 如是法要神力無窮利益無邊，
The essence of this Dharma has inexhaustible spiritual power and boundless benefits!

如是我聞：: 譬如幢上如意寶珠， 常雨珍寶滿一切願。
It is like a wish-fulfilling jewel on the top of a cylindrical banner, constantly raining down treasures and fulfilling all wishes.

如是我聞：: 我今略說萬分之一，
I will now speak briefly about one ten thousandth thereof.

如是我聞：: 汝宜憶持利益一切。
You should memorize and uphold it for benefiting all sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 若有惡人死墮地獄， 受苦無間免脫無期。
‘If an evil man falls to hell after death, he will have to suffer uninterruptedly without a date of release.

如是我聞：: 有其子孫稱亡者名， 誦上神呪纔至七遍， 洋銅熱鐵忽然變為八功德池，
However, if his descendants address his name and then recite this spiritual Mantra, upon completion of only seven repetitions, the molten copper and burning iron in the hell will suddenly turn into a pond of eight virtues.

如是我聞：: 蓮生承足寶蓋駐頂，
[This deceased] will have a lotus flower supporting his feet and a jeweled canopy over his head.

如是我聞：: 地獄門破菩提道開，
The door of hell will break and the Bodhi Way will open.

如是我聞：: 其蓮如飛至極樂界，
His lotus flower will fly him to the Land of Ultimate Bliss.

如是我聞：: 一切種智自然顯發，
There, his all-encompassing knowledge will unfold spontaneously.

如是我聞：: 樂說無窮位在補處。
Delighting in expounding the Dharma endlessly, he will attain the rank of realizing Buddhahood in the next life.

如是我聞：: 復有眾生重罪報故， 百病集身苦痛逼心， 誦此神呪二十一遍，
‘Furthermore, for a person who, in retribution for his grave sins, is suffering from 100 diseases with a heavy heart, he should recite this spiritual Mantra 21 times.

如是我聞：: 百病萬惱一時消滅，
Then 100 diseases and 10,000 distresses will be eliminated at once.

如是我聞：: 壽命延長福德無盡。
His lifespan will be extended, and his fortune and virtue will become infinite.

如是我聞：: 若復有人慳貪業故生貧窮家，
‘Suppose a person has been born into a poor family because of his karma of stinginess and greed.

如是我聞：: 衣不隱身食不續命，
His clothing cannot cover his body and his food cannot sustain his life.

如是我聞：: 𮡚瘦衰蔽人所惡賤。
Emaciated and haggard, he is despicable to others.

如是我聞：: 是人慚愧入山折採無主搹華，
This person, ashamed of himself, goes to the mountain and plucks wild flowers not owned by anyone.

如是我聞：: 若磨朽木持以號香，
He grates rotten wood for incense powder.

如是我聞：: 往至塔前禮拜供養， 旋遶七匝流淚悔過，
Then he goes to the pagoda to make obeisance and give offerings, circumambulating it seven times, repenting in tears.

如是我聞：: 由神呪力及塔威德， 滅貧窮報富貴忽至，
Because of the power of this spiritual Mantra and the awesome virtue of the pagoda, his poverty retribution will terminate and fortune will suddenly arrive.

如是我聞：: 七寶如雨無所闕乏。
The seven treasures will appear like abundant rain.

如是我聞：: 但當此時， 彌飾佛法施與貧乏，
However, at this time, he should give to the poor and needy, completely honoring the Buddha Dharma.

如是我聞：: 若有悋惜財寶忽滅。
If he is reluctant to give, his riches will suddenly vanish.

如是我聞：: 若復有人為種善根隨分造塔， 或泥或甎隨力所辦，
‘Suppose a person, planting the good roots for himself, builds a pagoda at his pleasure, using earth or bricks that he can afford.

如是我聞：: 大如菴羅高四指許，
The pagoda is as big as a mango, with its height about four times the length of a finger.

如是我聞：: 書寫神呪安置其中，
He copies this spiritual Mantra and enshrines the copy in the pagoda.

如是我聞：: 持以香華禮拜供養。
Then he makes obeisance and offers incense and flowers.

如是我聞：: 以其呪力及信心故， 自小塔中出大香雲，
Because of the power of the Mantra and his faithful heart, vast, fragrant clouds will come out of the little pagoda.

如是我聞：: 香氣雲光周遍法界， 薰馥晃曜廣作佛事，
The fragrance and the light of the clouds will pervade the dharma realm, infusing fragrance with dazzling radiance, doing Buddha work widely.

如是我聞：: 所得功德如上所說，
The virtues he will gain are just as I have already stated.

如是我聞：: 取要言之無願不滿。
In sum, all his wishes will be fulfilled without exception.

如是我聞：: 若有末世四輩弟子善男善女， 為無上道盡力造塔安置神呪， 所得功德說不可盡。
During the Dharma-ending age, if, among the four groups of my disciples, good men, and good women, there are those who, following the unsurpassed Way, do their best to build pagodas and enshrine this Mantra in them, the virtues they will acquire will be too numerous to recount.

如是我聞：: 若人求福， 至其塔所， 一華一香禮拜供養右旋行道，
‘If a person, wishing for fortune, goes to the pagoda, he should make obeisance and offer a flower and a little incense to the pagoda, and circumambulate it to the right.

如是我聞：: 由是功德官位榮耀不求自至，
From his virtuous act, rank and glory will arrive unsought.

如是我聞：: 壽命富饒不祈自增，
Longevity and prosperity will increase without effort.

如是我聞：: 怨家盜賊不討自敗，
Foes and bandits will fall without being subjugated.

如是我聞：: 怨念呪咀不厭歸本，
Vengeful thoughts and curses will return to their source without resistance.

如是我聞：: 疫癘邪氣不拔自避，
Epidemics and evil forces will turn away without being purged.

如是我聞：: 善夫良婦不求自得， 賢男美女不禱自生，
A good husband or good wife will come without being persuaded. Beautiful good children will be born without being prayed for.

如是我聞：: 一切所願任意滿足。
All wishes will be fulfilled at will.

如是我聞：: 若有烏雀鵄梟鳩鴿鵂鶹、狗狼野干蚊虻蟻螻之類， 暫來塔影及踏場草， 摧破惑障、覺悟無明，
Even for ravens, owls, turtledoves, owlets, wolves, jackals, mosquitoes, ants, and the like, which momentarily come in the shadow of the pagoda and step on the grass there, their affliction-hindrance will be destroyed, and they will recognize their ignorance.

如是我聞：: 忽入佛家恣領法財。
They will suddenly enter Buddha’s family and freely receive Dharma wealth.

如是我聞：: 況有眾人或見塔形、或聞鐸聲、或聞其名、或當其影，
Not to mention human beings who have seen the form of the pagoda, heard its bell tolling, heard of its name, or been in its shadow.

如是我聞：: 罪障悉滅、所求如意，
Their hindrance by sin will all be annihilated, and their wishes fulfilled.

如是我聞：: 現世安穩、後生極樂。
Their present lives will be peaceful, and they will be reborn in the Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss.

如是我聞：: 或人隨力以一丸泥塗塔壞壁、運一拳石扶塔礩傾， 由此功德增福延壽，
‘If a person, without extra effort, applies a glob of mud to the damaged wall of a pagoda or uses a fist-sized stone to support a leaning pagoda, from this virtuous act his fortune will increase and his lifespan will be extended.

如是我聞：: 命終之後成轉輪王。
After death, he will be reborn as a Wheel-Turning King.

如是我聞：: 若我滅後四部弟子， 於是塔前濟苦界故供養香華， 至心發願誦念神呪，
‘After I have abandoned my body, the four groups of my disciples, in order to rescue sentient beings in miserable existence, should come before this pagoda, make offerings of incense and flowers, and recite this spiritual Mantra, making vows in earnest.

如是我聞：: 文文句句放大光明， 照觸三途苦具皆辟，
Then each and every word and phrase [they utter] will radiate vast, bright light, illuminating the three evil life-journeys to extinguish all sufferings.

如是我聞：: 眾生脫苦佛種牙萌，
Once those sentient beings are delivered from sufferings, their seed of Buddhahood will germinate.

如是我聞：: 隨意往生十方淨土。
They will then be reborn as they wish in [any of] the Pure Lands in the ten directions.

如是我聞：: 若人往在高山峰上至心誦呪， 眼根所及遠近世界山谷林野江湖河海， 其中所有毛羽鱗甲一切生類， 碎破惑障、覺悟無明，
‘If a person recites this Mantra earnestly on the top of a high mountain, all living beings within the scope of his sight, including those in furs, feathers, scales, and shells, residing near and far in mountain valleys, forests, streams, lakes, rivers, and oceans, will shatter their affliction-hindrance and recognize their ignorance.

如是我聞：: 顯現本有三種佛性， 畢竟安處大涅槃中。
They will manifest the three kinds of Buddha nature they innately have and ultimately attain the great nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 若與此人往過道路， 或觸衣風、或踏其跡， 或唯見面、或暫交語， 如是等人重罪咸滅、悉地圓滿。 」爾時佛告金剛手言： 「今此祕密神呪經典付囑汝等，
If people take the road walked by this person and if they are touched by the wind blown through his clothes, step on his footprints, see his face, or converse with him briefly, their grave sins will all be expunged and their siddhis perfected.’ At that time the Buddha said to Vajrapāṇi, ‘I now entrust this secret spiritual Mantra and Sūtra to you and all others present.

如是我聞：: 尊重護持流布世間，
Revere, protect, uphold, and propagate them in the world.

如是我聞：: 不令眾生傳受斷絕。 」金剛手言： 「我今幸蒙世尊付囑。
Do not allow transmission [of the Dharma] to end for sentient beings.’ Vajrapāṇi said, ‘I am now honored to receive the trust of the World-Honored One.

如是我聞：: 唯願我等為報世尊深重恩德， 晝夜護持流布宣揚一切世間。
I pray only that we will repay the World-Honored One for his profound lovingkindness, day and night protecting, upholding, propagating, and pronouncing [the Mantra and the Sūtra] to the world.

如是我聞：: 若有眾生書寫受持憶念不斷， 我等麾催釋梵四王、龍神八部， 晝夜守護不暫捨離。 」佛言： 「善哉！
If there are sentient beings that copy, uphold, and remember them unceasingly, we will command the Brahma-kings, the god-king Śakra, the four great god- kings, and the eight classes of Dharma protectors to protect them day and night without even leaving temporarily.’ The Buddha said, ‘Very good!

如是我聞：: 金剛手！ 汝為未來世一切眾生大利益故， 護持此法令不斷絕。 」爾時世尊說此寶篋印陀羅尼廣作佛事，
Vajrapāṇi, for the benefit of all sentient beings of the future, protect and uphold this Dharma, and make it endless.’ At that time the World-Honored One pronounced this Treasure Chest Seal Dhāraṇī and did Buddha work widely.

如是我聞：: 然後往彼婆羅門家受諸供養， 令時人天獲大福利，
Then He went to the Brahmin’s home and accepted his offerings, causing humans and gods to receive great benefits.

如是我聞：: 却還所住。 爾時大眾，
Afterwards, He returned to the place where He was staying.

如是我聞：: 比丘、比丘尼、優婆塞、優婆夷、天、龍、夜叉、犍闥婆、阿修羅、迦樓羅、緊那羅、摩睺羅伽、人非人等，
At that time the bhikṣus, bhikṣuṇīs, upāsakas, upāsikās, gods, dragons, yakṣas, gandharvas, asuras, garuḍas, kiṁnaras, mahoragas, humans, nonhumans, and others in the assembly greatly rejoiced.

如是我聞：: 皆大歡喜， 信受奉行。
They all believed in, accepted, and reverently carried out the teachings.

如是我聞：: 一時， 釋迦牟尼佛在補陀落迦山， 觀世音宮殿， 寶莊嚴道場中， 坐寶師子座。
Once, when Śākyamuni Buddha was staying in Avalokiteśvara’s mansion at Potalaka Mountain, he sat upon the lion throne in the teaching hall, which was adorned with jewels.

如是我聞：: 其座純以無量雜摩尼寶， 而用莊嚴， 百寶幢旛， 周匝懸列。
This throne [was made] completely with countless sorts of maṇi jewels and, to adorn it, hundreds of jewel banners were hung all around.

如是我聞：: 爾時， 如來於彼座上， 將欲演說總持陀羅尼故。
At that time, the Tathāgata got up onto the throne because he had the intent to speak widely on the [effects] of keeping and holding dhāraṇīs.

如是我聞：: 與無央數菩薩摩訶薩俱，
Along with him was a gathering of countless bodhisattva- mahāsattvas.

如是我聞：: 其名曰： 總持王菩薩、寶王菩薩、藥王菩薩、藥上菩薩、觀世音菩薩、大勢至菩薩、華嚴菩薩、大莊嚴菩薩、寶藏菩薩、德藏菩薩、金剛藏菩薩、虛空藏菩薩、彌勒菩薩、普賢菩薩、文殊師利菩薩，
Their names [included]: Dhāraṇī King Bodhisattva, Jewel King Bodhisattva, Medicine King Bodhisattva, Supreme Medicine Bodhisattva, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Bearer of Great Power Bodhisattva, Flower Garland Bodhisattva, Great Adornment Bodhisattva, Jewel Womb Bodhisattva, Holy Womb Bodhisattva, Adamantine Womb Bodhisattva, Space Womb Bodhisattva, Maitreya Bodhisattva, Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, and Mañjuśrī Bodhisattva.

如是我聞：: 如是等菩薩摩訶薩， 皆是灌頂大法王子。
And so it was that these bodhisattvas were all anointed great princes of the Dharma.

如是我聞：: 又與無量無數大聲聞僧， 皆行阿羅漢十地， 摩訶迦葉而為上首。
Also gathered there was an unfathomable, countless gathering of great disciples, each pursuing on the tenth arhat ground, the foremost of whom was Mahākāśyapa.

如是我聞：: 又與無量梵摩羅天， 善吒梵摩而為上首。
Also gathered there were unfathomable numbers of devas of the pure realms, the foremost of whom was Śikhin Brahmā.

如是我聞：: 又與無量欲界諸天子俱， 瞿婆伽天子而為上首。
Also gathered there were unfathomable numbers of devas of the desire realm, the foremost of whom was the god Gopaka.

如是我聞：: 又與無量護世四王俱， 提頭賴吒而為上首。
Also gathered there were unfathomable numbers of world protecting [devas], the foremost of whom was Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

如是我聞：: 又與無量天、龍、夜叉、乾闥婆、阿修羅、迦樓羅、緊那羅、摩睺羅伽、人、非人等俱， 天德大龍王而為上首。
Also gathered there were unfathomable numbers of nāgas, yakṣas, gandharvas, asuras, garuḍas, kiṃnaras, mahoragas, humans, and nonhumans, the foremost of whom was the divine and virtuous great king of the nāgas.

如是我聞：: 又與無量欲界諸天女俱， 童目天女而為上首。
Also gathered there were unfathomable numbers of goddesses of the desire realm, the foremost of whom was the goddess Kumari-cakṣu.

如是我聞：: 又與無量虛空神、江海神、泉源神、河沼神、藥草神、樹林神、舍宅神、水神、火神、地神、風神、土神、山神、石神、宮殿等神，
Also gathered there were unfathomable numbers of spirits of the air, spirits of the rivers, spirits of the springs, spirits of the wetlands, spirits of healing herbs, spirits of the woods and forests, spirits of the home, water spirits, fire spirits, earth spirits, wind spirits, spirits of the land, spirits of the mountains, spirits of the stones, and spirits of the mansions.

如是我聞：: 皆來集會。
All had come and gathered with the assembly.

如是我聞：: 時觀世音菩薩， 於大會中密放神通， 光明照曜， 十方剎土及此三千大千世界， 皆作金色。
Then, from within that great gathering, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, by means of his spiritual power shone light that illuminated the buddha worlds throughout the ten directions and [each of the] Three Thousand Great Thousand Worlds had a golden hue.

如是我聞：: 天宮、龍宮、諸尊神宮， 皆悉震動；
The mansions of the devas and of the nāgas, and all the mansions of those worthy of worship, shook.

如是我聞：: 江河、大海、鐵圍山、須彌山、土山、黑山， 亦皆大動。 日、月、珠、火、星宿之光， 皆悉不現。
The rivers, great oceans, circles of iron mountains, Sumerus, earthy mountains, and the black Mountains all shook greatly, and the lustres of the Sun and the Moon, of pearls, fires, and the constellations all became inapparent [as they were outshone].

如是我聞：: 於是總持王菩薩， 見此希有之相， 怪未曾有。
As Dhāraṇī King Bodhisattva saw this wonderful sign, he was surprised [in away he had] never [experienced] before.

如是我聞：: 即從座起， 叉手合掌， 以偈問佛， 如此神通之相，
He immediately got up from his seat and brought his palms together with fingers crossed to ask the Buddha in verse about these signs and who had set them forth.

如是我聞：: 是誰所放？ 以偈問曰： 「誰於今日成正覺？ 普放如是大光明，
[And so,] in verse he asked: Who accomplished right awakening today, Everywhere lit, with such a great light?

如是我聞：: 十方剎土皆金色， 三千世界亦復然。
Throughout the ten directions, the worlds are all of golden hue And all the Three Thousand Great Thousand Worlds, too.

如是我聞：: 誰於今日得自在？ 演放希有大神力，
Who found freedom today, Displaying such awesome great spiritual power?

如是我聞：: 無邊佛國皆震動， 龍神宮殿悉不安。
Boundless [numbers of] buddha worlds were shaken, [As were] the halls and mansions of the nāgas and yakṣas.

如是我聞：: 今此大眾咸有疑， 不測因緣是誰力？
Now, this great assembly is all uncertain, Undecided whose power is the cause.

如是我聞：: 為佛菩薩大聲聞？
Was it a buddha, bodhisattva, some great disciple?

如是我聞：: 為梵魔天諸釋等？
Was it Brahmā, Māra, or Śakra?

如是我聞：: 唯願世尊大慈悲， 說此神通所由以！
Answer this wish, Lord, [show] great compassion, Say where this spiritual power came from!

如是我聞：: 」佛告總持王菩薩言： 「善男子！
The Buddha spoke to Dhāraṇī King Bodhisattva, saying: ‘Good son!

如是我聞：: 汝等當知， 今此會中， 有一菩薩摩訶薩，
You should all know that in this gathering there is a certain bodhisattva mahāsattva named Avalokiteśvara.

如是我聞：: 名曰『觀世音自在』。 從無量劫來， 成就大慈大悲，
During past unfathomable kalpas, he has developed great kindness and great compassion.

如是我聞：: 善能修習無量陀羅尼門，
He is someone well able to cultivate countless numbers of [different] dhāraṇī gateways.

如是我聞：: 為欲安樂諸眾生故， 密放如是大神通力。 」佛說是語已。 爾時， 觀世音菩薩，
Because of his wish to [bring] peace and joy to all living creatures, he mysteriously emits this great spiritual power.’ After the Buddha had said this, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva then arose from his seat, tidied his clothing, and facing the Buddha, brought his palms together and spoke to the Buddha, saying: ‘Lord!

如是我聞：: 從座而起， 整理衣服， 向佛合掌， 白佛言： 「世尊！ 我有大悲心陀羅尼呪，
I have the Dhāraṇī of the Great Compassionate Heart.

如是我聞：: 今當欲說。 為諸眾生得安樂故， 除一切病故， 得壽命故， 得富饒故， 滅除一切惡業、重罪故，
I now want to talk about it because it leads all living creatures to find peace and joyfulness, because it eliminates all malaise, because it leads to a longer life, because it leads to richness and plenty, because it burns away all the bad karma of grave sins, because it averts obstacles and hardships, because it increases all pure methods and all their merits, because it fulfills each and every good root, because it averts each and every fear, and because it can quickly fulfill each and every wish.

如是我聞：: 離障難故，
Good Sons! You must take up this dhāraṇī!

如是我聞：: 增長一切白法諸功德故， 成就一切諸善根故， 遠離一切諸怖畏故， 速能滿足一切諸希求故。 惟願世尊， 慈哀聽許！ 」佛言： 「善男子！
In future evil ages, every living creature [can] use it to create great benefits and joy.’ The Buddha said: ‘Good Son!

如是我聞：: 汝大慈悲， 安樂眾生。 欲說神呪，
You have great compassion and kindness, you want to talk about this dhāraṇī for the peace and happiness of all livings creatures.

如是我聞：: 今正是時， 宜應速說。
Now is the right time [and so it is] right that you are invited to talk.

如是我聞：: 如來隨喜， 諸佛亦然。 」觀世音菩薩重白佛言：
As the Tathāgata is delighted, so too are all the buddhas!’  Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva reverently said to the Buddha: ‘Lord!

如是我聞：: 「世尊！ 我念過去無量億劫， 有佛出世， 名曰『千光王靜住如來』。
I recall some unfathomable numbers of kalpas ago, [a time when] there was a buddha who came into the world whose name was King of Radiant Light, Dweller in Peace Tathāgata.

如是我聞：: 彼佛世尊憐念我故， 及為一切諸眾生故， 說此『廣大圓滿無礙大悲心陀羅尼』。
Because of that buddha’s compassionate thoughts toward me, and because of his [compassion] toward all living creatures, he spoke of the dhāraṇī of the vast, complete, and unhindered heart of great compassion.

如是我聞：: 以金色手摩我頂上作如是言： 『善男子！
As he touched his golden hand on the crown [of my head, he] said: ‘Good Son!

如是我聞：: 汝當持此心呪， 普為未來惡世一切眾生， 作大利樂。 』「我於是時， 始住初地，
You must take up this dhāraṇī of the heart to create the great benefit of happiness for all living creatures everywhere during the future evil age.’ ‘At that time, I had begun to dwell on the first ground, but then because I heard this dhāraṇī, I stepped up onto the eighth ground.

如是我聞：: 一聞此呪故， 超第八地。 我時心歡喜故， 即發誓言： 『若我當來， 堪能利益、安樂一切眾生者， 令我即時， 身生千手、千眼具足。 』「發是願已，
Because at that moment my heart was so joyful, I then made this vow, saying: ‘If, in the future, I am to be capable of benefiting and [creating] peace and joy for all living creatures, let my body forthwith grow a thousand arms complete with a thousand eyes.’ ‘Right after making this vow, there was a full thousand arms with a thousand eyes on my body.

如是我聞：: 應時身上， 千手千眼， 悉皆具足； 十方大地， 六種震動； 十方千佛， 悉放光明， 照觸我身，
The great earth throughout the ten directions shook in six ways and the thousands of buddhas throughout the ten directions all beamed light that shone on my body, which then radiated throughout the boundless worlds of the ten directions.

如是我聞：: 及照十方， 無邊世界。 「從是已後， 復於無量佛所、無量會中， 重更得聞， 親承受持，
Thereafter, beside unfathomable numbers of buddhas and [amidst] unfathomable numbers of gatherings, I repeatedly got to hear [it, and so have] cherished, received, and kept this dhāraṇī.

如是我聞：: 是陀羅尼。 復生歡喜， 踊躍無量， 便得超越無數億劫微細生死。
Repeatedly giving rise to bliss, my rejoicing was immeasurable, and so I got to overstep countless tens of millions of kalpas and insignificant births and deaths.

如是我聞：: 從是已來， 常所誦持，
Following this, I have constantly kept and recited it.

如是我聞：: 未曾廢忘，
At no time have I put it aside or forgotten it.

如是我聞：: 由持此呪故， 所生之處， 恒在佛前， 蓮華化生， 不受胎藏之身。 「若有比丘、比丘尼、優婆塞、優婆夷、童男、童女，
