Because I have kept hold of this dhāraṇī, wherever I was born, it has always been in front of a buddha; born transformed within a lotus flower, in a body that was not obtained from within any womb.’ ‘If any monk, nun, layman, laywoman, son, or daughter wants to take up and recite it, [those who,] for all living creatures, give rise to a compassionate heart, [let them] first follow me and take this vow: Adoration to the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

如是我聞：: 欲誦持者， 於諸眾生， 起慈悲心， 先當從我， 發如是願： 「『南無大悲觀世音！ 願我速知一切法。
May I swiftly get to know all dharmas.

如是我聞：: 南無大悲觀世音！
Adoration to the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

如是我聞：: 願我早得智慧眼。
May I soon come to get the wisdom eye.

如是我聞：: 南無大悲觀世音！
Adoration to the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

如是我聞：: 願我速度一切眾。
May I swiftly get to ferry all living creatures.

如是我聞：: 南無大悲觀世音！
Adoration to the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

如是我聞：: 願我早得善方便。
May I soon come to get skillful means.

如是我聞：: 南無大悲觀世音！
Adoration to the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

如是我聞：: 願我速乘般若船。
May I swiftly get to board the ship of wisdom.

如是我聞：: 南無大悲觀世音！
Adoration to the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

如是我聞：: 願我早得越苦海。
May I soon come to cross over the ocean of suffering.

如是我聞：: 南無大悲觀世音！
Adoration to the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

如是我聞：: 願我速得戒定道。
May I swiftly get to find morality, realization and the path.

如是我聞：: 南無大悲觀世音！
Adoration to the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

如是我聞：: 願我早登涅槃山。
May I soon come to climb the mountain of Nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 南無大悲觀世音！
Adoration to the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

如是我聞：: 願我速會無為舍。
May I swiftly get to gather in the house [of the] uncreated.

如是我聞：: 南無大悲觀世音！
Adoration to the greatly compassionate Avalokiteśvara!

如是我聞：: 願我早同法性身。
May I soon come to be the living truth.

如是我聞：: 「『我若向刀山， 刀山自摧折。
If I go toward a mountain of knives, May that mountain of knives spontaneously break apart.

如是我聞：: 我若向火湯， 火湯自消滅。
If I go toward fiery boiling waters, May those fiery boiling waters spontaneously burn out.

如是我聞：: 我若向地獄， 地獄自枯竭。
If I go toward [any] hell, May that hell spontaneously disappear.

如是我聞：: 我若向餓鬼， 餓鬼自飽滿。
If I go toward any hungry ghost, May that hungry ghost be spontaneously satisfied.

如是我聞：: 我若向修羅， 惡心自調伏。 我若向畜生， 自得大智慧。
If I go toward any asura, May their evil thoughts become spontaneously tempered, If I go toward any beast, May they spontaneously obtain great wisdom.

如是我聞：: 』「發是願已， 至心稱念， 我之名字， 亦應專念， 我本師阿彌陀如來，
‘After making this vow, in your heart call out my name in your thoughts, and then fix your thoughts on my root-teacher, Amitābha Tathāgata, after which recite this dhāraṇī.

如是我聞：: 然後即當誦此陀羅尼神呪。 一宿誦滿五遍， 除滅身中， 百千萬億劫生死重罪。 」觀世音菩薩復白佛言： 「世尊！
[After] reciting his dhāraṇī in its entirety five times during one night, the heavy sins of a billion kalpas of births and deaths will be completely burnt away in a single lifetime.’ Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva then spoke to the Buddha, saying: ‘Lord!

如是我聞：: 若諸人天， 誦持大悲章句者， 臨命終時， 十方諸佛， 皆來授手。 欲生何等佛土， 隨願皆得往生。 」復白佛言：
If any man or god takes up and recites the words of the [Dhāraṇī of] Great Compassion, then when their life comes to an end, all the buddhas of the ten directions will come together and off er their hands, and in whichever buddha realm they desire to be born, their wishes will be fulfilled completely [as they] go onward to obtain birth there.’ He again spoke to the Buddha saying: ‘Lord!

如是我聞：: 「世尊！ 若諸眾生， 誦持大悲神呪， 墮三惡道者， 我誓不成正覺。
If any living creature, someone who takes up and recites the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion, were to stray into [any of] the three evil paths, I vow not to complete the right awakening.

如是我聞：: 「誦持大悲神呪者， 若不生諸佛國者， 我誓不成正覺。 「誦持大悲神呪者，
If those who take up and recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion are not born into any buddha realm, then I vow not to complete the right awakening.

如是我聞：: 若不得無量三昧辯才者， 我誓不成正覺。
‘If someone has pilfered the fixtures [of the Sangha], its drink, food, or property, they must go before [all] the teachers [throughout] the ten directions to beg and repent [of their sins]; [only] then will these begin to be burnt out.

如是我聞：: 「誦持大悲神呪者， 於現在生中一切所求， 若不果遂者， 不得為大悲心陀羅尼也。
‘If whatever those who take up and recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion seek in this life does not come to fruition, then they have not acquired the great compassionate heart of the dhāraṇī, or they have no good [intent] or are not completely sincere.

如是我聞：: 唯除不善， 除不至誠。 「若諸女人， 厭賤女身， 欲成男子身， 誦持大悲陀羅尼章句。
‘If [any] woman dislikes and despises her female body and desires to turn [her body] into a male body, [then she should] take up and recite the words of the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion.

如是我聞：: 若不轉女身成男子身者， 我誓不成正覺。
If her female body does not turn into a male body, then I vow not to complete the right awakening.

如是我聞：: 生少疑心者， 必不果遂也。
[But,] it will not come to fruition for those who give rise to even the slightest feelings of doubt.

如是我聞：: 「若諸眾生， 侵損常住飲食、財物， 千佛出世， 不通懺悔， 縱懺亦不除滅。
‘If [any] living creature has pilfered the fixtures [of the Sangha], its drink, food, or property, [then even after] a thousand buddhas appear in the world [and they still] have not repented, then even if they do repent, it will not burn out [the effects of those deeds].

如是我聞：: 今誦大悲神呪， 即得除滅。
[But, if they now sincerely] recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion, [the effects of those deeds] will be burnt out.

如是我聞：: 若侵損食用， 常住飲食、財物， 要對十方師懺謝， 然始除滅。
If [any living creature has] pilfered the fixtures [of the Sangha], its drink, food, or property, they must go before [all] the teachers of the ten directions to beg and repent [of their sins]; [only] then will these begin to be burnt out.

如是我聞：: 今誦大悲陀羅尼時， 十方師即來， 為作證明， 一切罪障， 悉皆消滅。
[But, if they now] recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion, the teachers of the ten directions will come, and clearly witnessing this, all sinful impediments will be completely burnt away.

如是我聞：: 一切十惡、五逆、謗人、謗法、破齋、破戒、破塔、壞寺、偷僧祇物、污淨梵行， 如是等一切惡業、重罪， 悉皆滅盡。 唯除一事， 於呪生疑者，
‘All of the ten wicked [acts], the five treacherous [deeds], slandering the Dharma, broken fasts, broken vows, damaging stupas, ruining temples, stealing the belongings of the Sangha, and defiling the purity of celibacy; so it is that [the burning fire of] all these wicked actions and heavy sins can be completely burnt out, except for one thing: if any doubts about this dhāraṇī arise, then even the light sins, [however insignificant] an act, cannot be burnt out, how much more so the heavy sins.

如是我聞：: 乃至小罪輕業， 亦不得滅， 何況重罪？ 雖不即滅重罪， 猶能遠作菩提之因。 」復白佛言： 「世尊！ 若諸人天，
Even if for now there is no burning out of the heavy sins, just [reciting the dhāraṇī] will act as a cause of future awakening.’ [Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva] again spoke to the Buddha, saying: ‘Lord, if any man or god takes up and recites the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion, then they will obtain a birth with fifteen good qualities, and not suffer any of the fifteen sorts of wicked death.

如是我聞：: 誦持大悲心呪者， 得十五種善生， 不受十五種惡死也。 其惡死者： 一者， 不令其飢餓困苦死。 二者， 不為枷禁杖楚死。 三者， 不為怨家讐對死。 四者， 不為軍陣相殺死。 五者， 不為犲狼惡獸殘害死。 六者， 不為毒蛇蚖蠍所中死。 七者， 不為水火焚漂死。
‘[They will] 1. not be caused to die through hunger, starvation, or poverty; 2. nor be chained up, imprisoned, and painfully beaten to death with sticks; 3. nor die through facing up to [their] enemies; 4. nor die killed in the battling between armies; 5. nor die slain by wolves [or any other] wicked beast; 6. nor die poisoned by snakes, vipers, and scorpions; 7. nor die by water or fire, [either] burnt or drowned; 8. nor die by poisoning; 9. nor die by charms that poison [the mind]; 10. nor die due to mad confusion or the loss of thought; 11. nor die due to the collapse of hills, trees, [or] the edges of cliffs; 12. nor die due to some wicked person’s vetāla; 13. nor die suddenly due to vicious spirits or wicked ghosts; 14. nor die of some evil disease that envelops the body; 15. nor die due to [any form] of wild self-harm.

如是我聞：: 八者， 不為毒藥所中死。 九者， 不為蠱毒害死。 十者， 不為狂亂失念死。 十一者， 不為山樹崖岸墜落死。 十二者， 不為惡人厭魅死。 十三者， 不為邪神惡鬼得便死。 十四者， 不為惡病纏身死。 十五者， 不為非分自害死。 誦持大悲神呪者， 不被如是十五種惡死也。
‘Those who take up and recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion are not subject to these fifteen sorts of wicked death.

如是我聞：: 「得十五種善生者：
They will acquire a birth with fifteen good qualities: 1.

如是我聞：: 一者， 所生之處， 常逢善王。
Wherever they are born, [there will] always happen to be a good king.

如是我聞：: 二者，
常生善國。 三者， 常值好時。
They will always be born in a good country, and 3. always during a time when it is possible to encounter the good [Dharma].

如是我聞：: 四者，
常逢善友。 五者， 身根常得具足。
They will always happen to have good friends, and 5. their bodily senses will always be complete.

如是我聞：: 六者，
道心純熟。 七者， 不犯禁戒。
Their aspiration for the path will be perfect, and 7. they will not violate the precepts.

如是我聞：: 八者，
所有眷屬， 恩義和順。 九者， 資具財食， 常得豐足。
Whatever followers [they have] will be grateful and cooperative; 9. they will have the wealth, property, and food that they need, always in abundance.

如是我聞：: 十者，
恒得他人， 恭敬扶接。 十一者， 所有財寶， 無他劫奪。
They will always obtain the respect and support of other people, and 11. whatever wealth [they have,] no one else will steal it away.

如是我聞：: 十二者，
意欲所求， 皆悉稱遂。 十三者， 龍天善神， 恒常擁衛。
Whatever they desire to [set their] minds to, all will come to completion as, 13. nāgas, devas, and good spirits, will forever guard over them.

如是我聞：: 十四者，
所生之處， 見佛聞法。
Wherever they are born, they will see the Buddha and hear the Dharma.

如是我聞：: 十五者，
所聞正法， 悟甚深義。
And, [whenever] they hear the right Dharma, they will awaken to its very deep meaning.

如是我聞：: 若有誦持大悲心陀羅尼者， 得如是等十五種善生也。
‘Whosoever recites the Dhāraṇī of the Heart of Great Compassion will obtain a birth with these fifteen good qualities.

如是我聞：: 一切天、人應常誦持， 勿生懈怠。 」觀世音菩薩說是語已， 於眾會前，
[And so,] all devas and men should keep and recite it, and never grow negligent.’ After Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva had finished saying these words in front of the entire gathering, he brought his palms together and then spoke the Dhāraṇī of the Vast, Complete, and Unobstructed Heart of Great Compassion, the Great Dhāraṇī, the Dhāraṇī of Wondrous Words, saying:  Namo ratna-trayāya nama ārya avalokiteśvaraya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya mahā-kāruṇikāya Oṁ sarva-bhayeṣu trāṇa-karāya tasya namaskṛtvā imaṁ ārya avalokiteśvara-stavanaṁ Nīlakaṇṭha-nāma.

如是我聞：: 合掌正住， 於諸眾生， 起大悲心， 開顏含笑， 即說如是「廣大圓滿無礙大悲心大陀羅尼神妙章句陀羅尼」曰：
Hṛdayaṁ vartayiṣyāmi sarvārtha-sādhanaṁ śubham ajeayaṁ sarva-bhūtānāṁ bhava-mārga-viśodhakam.Tadyathā. Oṁ avaloka e ālokapati atikrānta ehy-ehi Hare mahābodhisattva sarpa-sarpa smara-smara mama hṛdayaṁ kuru-kuru karma dhuru-dhuru vijayanta e mahāvijayanta e dhara-dhara dharaṇindreśvara-rāja cala-cala mama vimalāmala-mūrtte re ehy-ehi Lokeśvara rāga-viṣam vinaśaya dveṣa-viṣaṁ vināśaya moha-jāla-viṣaṁ vinaśaya hulu-hulu Malla hulu Hare Padmanābha sara-sara siri-siri suru-suru bodhiya-bodhiya bodhaya-bodhaya maitriya Nīlakaṇṭha darśanena prahlādaya manaḥ svāhā. Siddhāya svāhā mahāsiddhāya svāhā siddhayogeśvarāya svāhā Nīlakaṇṭhāya svāhā Varāhamukha-siṁhamukhāya svāhā padma-hastāya svāhā cakra-hastāya svāhā śaṅkha-śabda-nibodhanaya svāhā mahākuṭa-dharāya svāhā vāma-skandha-deśa-sthita-kṛṣṇājināya svāhā vyāghra-carma-nivasanāya svāhā.

如是我聞：: 「南無喝囉怛那哆囉夜㖿(一)南無阿唎㖿(二)婆盧羯帝爍鉢囉㖿(三)菩提薩跢婆㖿(四)摩訶薩跢婆㖿(五)摩訶迦盧尼迦㖿(六)唵(上聲)(七)薩皤囉罰曳(八)數怛那怛寫(九)南無悉吉利埵伊蒙阿唎㖿(十)婆盧吉帝室佛囉㘄馱婆(十一)南無那囉謹墀(十二)醯唎摩訶皤哆沙咩(羊鳴音)(十三)薩婆阿他豆輸朋(十四)阿逝孕(十五)薩婆薩哆那摩婆伽(十六)摩罰特豆(十七)怛姪他(十八)唵阿婆盧醯(十九)盧迦帝(二十)迦羅帝(二十一)夷醯唎(二十二)摩訶菩提薩埵(二十三)薩婆薩婆(二十四)摩羅摩羅(二十五)摩醯摩醯唎馱孕(二十六)俱盧俱盧羯懞(二十七)度盧度盧罰闍耶帝(二十八)摩訶罰闍耶帝(二十九)陀羅陀羅(三十)地利尼(三十一)室佛囉耶(三十二)遮羅遮羅(三十三)摩摩罰摩囉(三十四)穆帝囇(三十五)伊醯移醯(三十六)室那室那(三十七)阿囉嘇佛囉舍利(三十八)罰沙罰嘇(三十九)佛羅舍耶(四十)呼嚧呼嚧摩囉(四十一)呼嚧呼嚧醯利(四十二)娑囉娑囉(四十三)悉利悉利(四十四)蘇嚧蘇嚧(四十五)菩提夜菩提夜(四十六)菩馱夜菩馱夜(四十七)彌帝利夜(四十八)那囉謹墀(四十九)地唎瑟尼那(五十)波夜摩那(五十一)娑婆訶(五十二)悉陀夜(五十三)娑婆訶(五十四)摩訶悉陀夜(五十五)娑婆訶(五十六)悉陀喻藝(五十七)室皤囉耶(五十八)娑婆訶(五十九)那囉謹墀(六十)娑婆訶(六十一)摩囉那囉(六十二)娑婆訶(六十三)悉囉僧阿穆佉耶(六十四)娑婆訶(六十五)娑婆摩訶阿悉陀夜(六十六)娑婆訶(六十七)者吉囉阿悉陀夜(六十八)娑婆訶(六十九)波陀摩羯悉哆夜(七十)娑婆訶(七十一)那囉謹墀皤伽囉㖿(七十二)娑婆訶(七十三)摩婆利勝羯囉夜(七十四)娑婆訶(七十五)南無喝囉怛那哆囉夜耶(七十六)南無阿唎㖿(七十七)婆嚧吉帝(七十八)爍皤囉夜(七十九)娑婆訶(八十)唵悉殿都曼哆囉鉢馱耶(八十一)娑婆訶(八十二)」觀世音菩薩說此呪已。 大地六變震動， 天雨寶華，
Namo ratna-trayāya nama ārya avalokiteśvarāya svāhā.

如是我聞：: 繽紛而下。
Samāpta.

如是我聞：: 十方諸佛悉皆歡喜， 天魔外道恐怖毛竪， 一切眾會皆獲果證。 或得須陀洹果，
After Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva had finished speaking this dhāraṇī, the great earth shook six times, and it rained jewel flowers of numerous colors everywhere.All the buddhas of the ten directions were completely delighted, but the god Māra and other opponents of the Dharma were so frightened that their hair stood upright!All those in the gathering each gained fruits of awakening.

如是我聞：: 或得斯陀含果， 或得阿那含果， 或得阿羅漢果者，
[Some got] the fruit of the stream-entry, or the fruit of the once-returner, or the fruit of the non- returner, or the fruit of the arhat.

如是我聞：: 或得一地、二地、三地、四地、五地， 乃至十地者。 無量眾生發菩提心。 爾時， 大梵天王，
[Some] reached the first ground, the second ground, the third ground, the fourth ground, the fifth ground, right up to the tenth ground, and unfathomable numbers of living creatures raised the aspiration to become a buddha.Whereupon the king of the devas of the realm of Great Purity arose from his seat, tidied his clothing, brought his palms together in respect and spoke to Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, saying: ‘Excellent, mahāsattva!

如是我聞：: 從座而起， 整理衣服， 合掌恭敬， 白觀世音菩薩言： 「善哉！ 大士！ 我從昔來， 經無量佛會， 聞種種法、種種陀羅尼，
I have, since former times come and attended innumerable numbers of buddha gatherings and heard about various methods and various dhāraṇīs.

如是我聞：: 未曾聞說， 如此無礙大悲心、大悲陀羅尼神妙章句。
But at no time have I ever heard this spoken of—the heart of unobstructed great compassion and the wondrous words of the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion.

如是我聞：: 唯願大士， 為我說此陀羅尼形貌狀相，
Answer my wish, mahāsattva, describe for me the appearance of the signs of this dhāraṇī.

如是我聞：: 我等大眾， 願樂欲聞！ 」觀世音菩薩告梵王言： 「汝為方便利益一切眾生故，
I and [all this] great gathering would like to hear!’ Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva addressed the Brahmā king, saying: ‘You ask about this because it is a means of benefiting all living creatures.

如是我聞：: 作如是問。 汝今善聽， 吾為汝等， 略說少耳！ 」觀世音菩薩言： 「大慈悲心是， 平等心是， 無為心是，
You [should] listen well as I will only say this in brief!’ Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva said: ‘The heart of great compassion is a heart of equality, a heart without intent, a heart untouched by [any form of] taint, a heart that sees without content, a heart that reveres, a heart of humility, a heart without confusion and a heart that sees without grasping.

如是我聞：: 無染著心是， 空觀心是， 恭敬心是， 卑下心是， 無雜亂心， 無見取心是， 無上菩提心是。
[It is the heart] of unsurpassed awakening.

如是我聞：: 當知如是等心， 即是陀羅尼相貌。
So, know these [qualities of the] heart through these appearances and signs.

如是我聞：: 汝當依此而修行之。 」大梵王言： 「我等大眾， 今始識此陀羅尼相貌。
You should conform to these [as you] develop [your] practice.’ The king of the devas of the realm of Great Purity [then] said: ‘We now know the appearances and signs of this dhāraṇī.

如是我聞：: 從今受持， 不敢忘失。 」觀世音言： 「若善男子、善女人， 誦持此神呪者， 發廣大菩提心，
From now on, we will recite and hold it, and will never dare to forget or lose it.’ Avalokiteśvara said: ‘If those good sons and good daughters who take up and recite this dhāraṇī raise the great vow of aspiring to become awakened for the sake of carrying over all living creatures; keep the bodily purifications and toward all living creatures raise the heart of equality; always recite this dhāraṇī [and] are not disrupted by any interruption; dwell in a clean room, are bathed clean, [and] wear clean clothing; hang banners and make offerings of burning lamps, perfumes, flowers, and food and drink of a hundred flavors; and are single-minded with no distractions whatsoever—[this, then,] is the method of taking and reciting.’ ‘At such times, Radiant Sun Bodhisattva and Radiant Moon Bodhisattva, together with unfathomable numbers of sages, will come to witness this, thereby enhancing the benefits of their exertions.

如是我聞：: 誓度一切眾生。 身持齋戒， 於諸眾生， 起平等心。 常誦此呪， 莫令斷絕。 住於淨室， 澡浴清淨， 著淨衣服。 懸旛、然燈、香華、百味飲食， 以用供養。 制心一處， 更莫異緣， 如法誦持。 「是時當有， 日光菩薩、月光菩薩與無量神仙， 來為作證， 益其効驗。 我時當以千眼照見， 千手護持。
I will then behold them with my thousand eyes, and keep them safe with my thousand hands.

如是我聞：: 從是以往， 所有世間經書， 悉能受持； 一切外道法術、韋陀典籍，
And, from this, then, they will be able to grasp and understand any worldly text, every trick of the homeless wanderers, and will be able to penetrate the Vedic texts.

如是我聞：: 亦能通達。 誦持此神呪者， 世間八萬四千種病， 悉皆治之， 無不差者。
Those who take up and re- cite this dhāraṇī can completely cure the world of its eighty-four thousand sorts of illnesses—there is no mistake.

如是我聞：: 亦能使令一切鬼神， 降諸天魔， 制諸外道。 若在山野， 誦經坐禪， 有諸山精、雜魅、魍魎、鬼神，
Furthermore, they can command all ghosts and spirits, subdue the devas of the Māra [realm], and govern all opponents of the Dharma.’ ‘If [anyone out] on some mountain or in the wilderness reciting sūtras while seated in meditative absorption has mountain spirits, monsters, deceptive demons, or ghosts cut across the appearances [in their mind which makes them] distressed, [such that their] heart is not peaceful and settled, then recitation of this dhāraṇī, [even] once, will subdue all those ghosts and spirits.

如是我聞：: 橫相惱亂， 心不安定者， 誦此呪一遍， 是諸鬼神， 悉皆被縛也。 「若能如法誦持， 於諸眾生， 起慈悲心者， 我時當勅一切善神、龍王、金剛密迹， 常隨衛護，
If that person is able to take up and recite with this method and raises a compassionate heart toward all living creatures, then I will direct all good spirits, nāga kings, and treasure guards to always follow and protect them, and to never leave their side; to protect them as they would protect [their own] eyes and as they would protect [their own] lives.’ He [then] spoke this command in verse, saying: ‘I command the soldiers, [guards of] the concealed treasures, Ucchusma, Kuṇḍali, Aṅkuśa, And the eight divisions of the hero Sāgara To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 不離其側， 如護眼睛， 如護己命。 」說偈勅曰： 「我遣密跡金剛士， 烏芻君荼鴦俱尸， 八部力士賞迦羅， 常當擁護受持者。 我遣摩醯那羅延， 金剛羅陀迦毘羅，
I command the Great Nārāyaṇa, Vajrarada, and Kapila, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 常當擁護受持者。 我遣婆馺娑樓羅， 滿善車鉢真陀羅，
I command Pajra, Indra, The completely good Catura and Kinnara, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 常當擁護受持者。 我遣薩遮摩和羅， 鳩闌單吒半祇羅，
I command Śeṣa Mahā Bala, The kumbhāṇḍaka, and Pañjara,To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 常當擁護受持者。 我遣畢婆伽羅王， 應德毘多薩和羅，
I command King Vibhākara, And the ever-virtuous Bhūtaśvara, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 常當擁護受持者。 我遣梵摩三鉢羅， 五部淨居炎摩羅， 常當擁護受持者。 我遣釋王三十三，
I command Samvara, king of the pure realms, The five divisions of the ‘pure living’ devas and Yama, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].I command Śakra, king of the thirty-three, The great Sarasvatī, and Vardhana, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 大辯功德婆怛那， 常當擁護受持者。 我遣提頭賴吒王，
I command King Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Hāritī and the hordes of heroes, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 神母女等大力眾， 常當擁護受持者。 我遣毘樓勒叉王， 毘樓博叉毘沙門，
I command the kings Virūḍhaka, Virupaksa, and Vaiśravaṇa, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 常當擁護受持者。 我遣金色孔雀王， 二十八部大仙眾，
I command King Suvarṇa Mayūra, And the twenty-eight divisions of great yakṣas, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 常當擁護受持者。 我遣摩尼跋陀羅， 散支大將弗羅婆，
I command Māṇibhadra, Pañcika, and the great general Phalava, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 常當擁護受持者。 我遣難陀跋難陀，
I command Nanda, Upandanda, Sāgaranāga and Elāpattra, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 婆伽羅龍伊鉢羅， 常當擁護受持者。 我遣脩羅乾闥婆， 迦樓緊那摩睺羅，
I command the asuras and gandharvas, garuḍas, kiṃnaras, and mahoragas, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].

如是我聞：: 常當擁護受持者。 我遣水火雷電神， 鳩槃荼王毘舍闍， 常當擁護受持者。 「是諸善神及神龍王、神母女等， 各有五百眷屬，
I command the spirits of water, fire, thunder, and lightning, The kings of the kumbhaṇḍa, and the piśācas, To forever guard those who have received and keep [this dhāraṇī].’ ‘These good spirits, nāga kings, and Hāritī, and each of all the five hundred followers, and the mighty yakṣas, will forever follow and protect those who take up and recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion.

如是我聞：: 大力夜叉， 常隨擁護， 誦持大悲神呪者。 其人若在空山、曠野， 獨宿孤眠， 是諸善神， 番代宿衛， 辟除災障。
If [any] one [of them] were to dwell in the empty mountains or in the wilderness, [as they] lie down to sleep alone, then all those goodly spirits will take turns to keep watch, to guard and protect them as they lie asleep by putting down all dangers.

如是我聞：: 若在深山， 迷失道路， 誦此呪故， 善神龍王， 化作善人，
If [any] one [of them] were to become lost in the mountains, gone astray following a wrong path, then reciting this dhāraṇī [will result in those] goodly spirits transforming into goodly people who will point out the right path.

如是我聞：: 示其正道。 若在山林、曠野， 乏少水火， 龍王護故， 化出水火。 」觀世音菩薩復為誦持者，
If [any one of them were] to enter a mountain forest or wilderness and were in need of some water or fire then, because of the nāga kings’ protection, water or fire will miraculously appear.’ And [then] Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, for those who have taken up and recite this dhāraṇī, spoke these verses on the eradication of danger and the cooling down of adversities: ‘If ever traveling in deserts, moorlands, mountains, or fens, Should any tiger, wolf, or wicket beast be met, Or snakes, spirits, fiends, ghouls, or phantoms, [When] they hear this mantra recited, no harm can they do.

如是我聞：: 說消除災禍， 清涼之偈： 「若行曠野山澤中， 逢值虎狼諸惡獸， 蛇蚖精魅魍魎鬼， 聞誦此呪莫能害。 若行江湖滄海間， 毒龍蛟龍摩竭獸， 夜叉羅剎魚黿鼈， 聞誦此呪自藏隱。
If ever going upon rivers, lakes, or the vast ocean, Then venomous snakes, crocodiles, makaras, yakṣas, rākṣasas, fishes, and sea turtles, Will hide themselves away [when they] hear this dhāraṇī.

如是我聞：: 若逢軍陣賊圍繞， 或被惡人奪財寶， 至誠稱誦大悲呪， 彼起慈心復道歸。
If ever by battling soldiers or raiders surrounded, Or subject to someone evil seizing their wealth, Then sincerely call out, recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion, and They will give rise to a compassionate heart and return on their way.

如是我聞：: 若為王官收錄身， 囹圄禁閉杻枷鎖， 至誠稱誦大悲呪， 官自開恩釋放還。 若入野道蠱毒家，
If ever detained by some king’s officer, Imprisoned, shackled, staked, or locked in a pillory, Then sincerely call out, recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion, and The officer will himself become compassionate and release, to make free once more [those detained].If ever, on entering the wilderness, the path [leads to some] baneful house, [Where] drink and food is laced with poison [but] looks desirable, Then sincerely call out, recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion, And anything poisonous will magically change into amṛta.

如是我聞：: 飲食有藥欲相害， 至誠稱誦大悲呪， 毒藥變成甘露漿。 女人臨難生產時， 邪魔遮障苦難忍， 至誠稱誦大悲呪， 鬼神退散安樂生。
When a woman gives birth and the descent is difficult, As wicked Maras obstruct and hinder, and pain is suffered, Then sincerely call out, recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion, and The wicked spirits will turn back and scatter, and the birth [will be] peaceful and joyous.

如是我聞：: 惡龍疫鬼行毒氣， 熱病侵陵命欲終， 至心稱誦大悲呪， 疫病消除壽命長。
If the poisonous breaths of evil nāgas passing by [Cause] fevers and afflictions, and life is at the brink of ending, Recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion with all your heart and Those diseases will be eradicated and the life span prolonged.

如是我聞：: 龍鬼流行諸毒腫， 癰瘡膿血痛叵堪， 至心稱誦大悲呪， 三唾毒腫隨口消。
As nāgas spread poisonous swellings, ulcers, and abscesses with blood, pus, and unbearable pain, Recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion with all your heart and Spit three times, and the poison from those swellings will vanish through the mouth.

如是我聞：: 眾生濁惡起不善， 厭魅呪詛結怨讐， 至心稱誦大悲呪， 厭魅還著於本人。 惡生濁亂法滅時， 婬欲火盛心迷倒， 棄背妻婿外貪染， 晝夜邪思無暫停，
Muddled living creatures whose wickedness gives rise to no good, Are, by wraith hexes, charmed and bound by the hatred of enemies, Recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion with all your heart and Those vetālas will return, to seize those men from [whom they] originally [came].When the Dharma is burning out, and evil grows into a muddied chaos, [And a man] burns with lewd lust, his heart beguiled and down-[beaten], Rejecting his wife [and the duties of a] husband, tainted by the lust [for something] outside, Day and night thinking wrong thoughts without brief pause,If he can call out, recite the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion then, Those fires of lewd lust will burn out and wrong thoughts become cast away.

如是我聞：: 若能稱誦大悲呪， 婬欲火滅邪心除。 我若廣讚呪功力， 一劫稱揚無盡期。 」爾時， 觀世音菩薩， 告梵天言： 「誦此呪五遍， 取五色線作索， 呪二十一遍， 結作二十一結，
Were I to praise the workings and power of this dhāraṇī, [Even after] a kalpa of praises, I would not be finished.’ Then, Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva told the devas of the pure realms: ‘Recite this dhāraṇī five times, take threads of the five colors and make a cord, [recite] the dhāraṇī twenty-one times [while making] twenty-one knots [and then] tie [it around your] neck.’ ‘This dhāraṇī has been spoken of by all the buddhas of the past [as numerous as] the sands of 990 million Ganges Rivers.

如是我聞：: 繫項。 「此陀羅尼， 是過去九十九億恒河沙諸佛所說。 彼等諸佛， 為諸行人， 修行六度， 未滿足者， 速令滿足故；
All those buddhas [have done so] for the sake of those who pursue and cultivate the pursuit of the Six Perfections [but] have not yet completed them, because [this dhāraṇī] will make them succeed the quicker.

如是我聞：: 未發菩提心者， 速令發心故。
As for those who have not yet raised the aspiration to become awakened, it will cause them to aspire the sooner.

如是我聞：: 若聲聞人， 未證果者， 速令證故。
As for disciples who have not yet seen the fruits [of their efforts], it will cause them to experience these more quickly.

如是我聞：: 「若三千大千世界內， 諸神仙人， 未發無上菩提心者， 令速發心故。
As for all those rishis and men throughout the Three Thousand Great Thousand Worlds, those who have not yet raised the aspiration for the unsur­passable awakening, it will cause them to aspire the sooner.

如是我聞：: 若諸眾生， 未得大乘信根者， 以此陀羅尼威神力故， 令其大乘種子， 法芽增長。
As for those living creatures who have not yet found the root of faith in the Mahāyāna, because of the mighty spiritual power of this dhāraṇī, it will cause [their seed] of the Mahāyāna to grow and sprout as the Dharma.

如是我聞：: 以我方便慈悲力故， 令其所須， 皆得成辦。
Because my means [of benefiting others] is powered by compassion, whatever they need will be obtained completely.

如是我聞：: 「若三千大千世界， 幽隱闇處， 三塗眾生， 聞我此呪， 皆得離苦。
As for those living creatures throughout the Three Thousand Great Thousand Worlds, trapped and buried away in the three [evil] destinies, hearing this, my dhāraṇī will completely free them from misery.

如是我聞：: 有諸菩薩， 未階初住者， 速令得故， 乃至令得十住地故。 又令得到佛地故， 自然成就三十二相、八十隨形好。
[As for] those bodhisattvas who are not yet dwelling on the first step, it will cause them to find it, and then [cause] them to go on to find and dwell upon the tenth ground; it will cause them to find and reach the buddha ground and spontaneously develop the thirty-two signs and the eighty complementary fine appearances.

如是我聞：: 「若聲聞人， 聞此陀羅尼， 一經耳者， 修行、書寫此陀羅尼者， 以質直心，
‘If any disciple hears this dhāraṇī, as soon as he hears it, [if it is pursued and cultivated] and he writes down this dhāraṇī, then his heart will be steady and will dwell in accord with the Dharma, and the four fruits of the śramaṇa , [although] not sought after, will be spontaneously obtained.

如是我聞：: 如法而住者， 四沙門果， 不求自得。 「若三千大千世界內， 山河、石壁、四大海水， 能令涌沸； 須彌山及鐵圍山， 能令搖動；
As for all the mountains, rivers, cliffs, and the waters of the four great oceans throughout the Three Thousand Great Thousand Worlds, they will be caused to bubble and boil; Mount Sumeru and the circle of iron mountains will be made to tremble, caused to break into pieces like the fi nest dust, and the living creatures therein all led to raise the unsurpassed aspiration for the unsurpassable awakening.

如是我聞：: 又令碎如微塵， 其中眾生， 悉令發無上菩提心。 「若諸眾生， 現世求願者， 於三七日， 淨持齋戒， 誦此陀羅尼， 必果所願。
If all those living creatures who have aspirations during this present life keep a pure fast and recite this dhāraṇī [for] three [lots of] seven days, their aspirations are sure to come to fruition.

如是我聞：: 從生死際， 至生死際， 一切惡業， 並皆滅盡。
‘From [one round of] birth and death to [the next round of] birth and death, all evil karma will be burnt out completely.

如是我聞：: 三千大千世界內， 一切諸佛、菩薩、梵釋四天王、神仙、龍王， 悉皆證知。 「若諸人天， 誦持此陀羅尼者， 其人若在江河大海中沐浴，
Throughout the Three Thousand Great Thousand Worlds, all the buddhas, bodhisattvas, Brahmās, Śakras, Four Heavenly Kings, rishis, and nāga kings will all witness and know this.’ ‘Suppose [some] man or god is someone who recites and keeps this dhāraṇī, and that person bathes in a river or the great ocean.

如是我聞：: 其中眾生， 得此人浴身之水， 霑著其身， 一切惡業、重罪， 悉皆消滅， 即得轉生他方淨土， 蓮華化生， 不受胎身、濕卵之身，
Then all those living creatures in the water in which that person washes their body, as [that water] touches and wets their body, [then] all the evil karma of their heavy sins will be completely burnt away; they will, on the next turning of birth, be born in a pure land [in some] other direction; born through transformation [on] a lotus flower, not receiving any body [born from a] womb, [nor any body born from] moisture or an egg.

如是我聞：: 何況受持讀誦者？ 「若誦持者，
‘What about those who have received, keep, and recite [the dhāraṇī]?

如是我聞：: 行於道路， 大風時來， 吹此人身、毛髮、衣服， 餘風下過， 諸類眾生，
If some­one who recites and keeps [this dhāraṇī] walks along a road and a great wind comes that blows [across] their body, hair, and clothing then, as the remainder of that wind passes by, the wind will flow around the bodies of all sorts of living creatures.

如是我聞：: 得其人飃身風， 吹著身者， 一切重罪、惡業， 並皆滅盡，
[As that wind blows,] all of their heavy sins and evil karma will be completely burnt out.

如是我聞：: 更不受三惡道報， 常生佛前。
As an effect of no longer enduring any of the three evil destinies, they will be forever born before a buddha.

如是我聞：: 「當知受持者， 福德果報， 不可思議。
So, know that the fruition and rewards of the merits of those who receive and take up [this dhāraṇī] are inexpressible.

如是我聞：: 誦持此陀羅尼者， 口中所出言音， 若善、若惡， 一切天魔、外道、天龍、鬼神聞者， 皆是清淨法音， 皆於其人起恭敬心，
‘As the sounds of the words come out of the mouths of those who recite and keep this dhāraṇī, those who hear them, whether they are good or wicked, or some god of the Māra [realm], homeless-wanderer heavenly nāga or yakṣa, [because] all [that they hear is] the pure sound of the Dharma, then all those people will give rise to feelings of reverence as though revering a buddha.

如是我聞：: 尊重如佛。 「誦持此陀羅尼者， 當知其人， 即是佛身藏， 九十九億恒河沙諸佛所愛惜故。 當知其人，
‘Know such a man who recites and keeps this dhāraṇī to be the womb of the buddha’s body, cherished by all the buddhas as [numerous as] the sands of 990 million Ganges Rivers.

如是我聞：: 即是光明藏， 一切如來光明照故。 當知其人，
Know that man to be the womb of shining light, shone upon by the radiant light of all the Tathāgatas.

如是我聞：: 是慈悲藏， 恒以陀羅尼救眾生故。 當知其人，
Know that man to be the womb of compassion, constantly rescuing all living creatures through this dhāraṇī.

如是我聞：: 是妙法藏， 普攝一切諸陀羅尼門故。
Know that man to be the womb of the wonderful Dharma, one who has gathered all the dhāraṇī gates.

如是我聞：: 當知其人， 是禪定藏， 百千三昧常現前故。
Know that man to be the womb of meditative absorption, having the 100,000 [inspired] realizations constantly appear [to him].

如是我聞：: 當知其人， 是虛空藏， 常以空慧觀眾生故。 當知其人，
Know that man to be the womb of space, who sees and knows living creatures [throughout all] space.

如是我聞：: 是無畏藏， 龍天善神常護持故。
Know that man to be the womb of fearlessness as nāgas, devas, and yakṣas protect him.

如是我聞：: 當知其人， 是妙語藏， 口中陀羅尼音無斷絕故。
Know that man to be the womb of wondrous words, as the sounds of the dhāraṇī [that come from] within his mouth are uninterrupted.

如是我聞：: 當知其人， 是常住藏， 三災惡劫不能壞故。
Know that man to be the womb of the everlasting, because [even] the three catastrophes of the evil kalpa cannot ruin him.

如是我聞：: 當知其人， 是解脫藏， 天魔外道不能稽留故。
Know that man to be the womb of freedom, because the devas of the Māra [realm] and homeless wanderers cannot restrain him.

如是我聞：: 當知其人， 是藥王藏， 常以陀羅尼療眾生病故。
Know that man to be the womb of Bhaiṣajyaguru, because it is through this dhāraṇī [that he] forever heals the sicknesses of living creatures.

如是我聞：: 當知其人， 是神通藏， 遊諸佛國得自在故。
Know that man to be the womb of spiritual power, because he travels to any buddha realm at will.

如是我聞：: 其人功德讚不可盡。 「善男子！
The praises of the merits of [such a] man are inexhaustible.’ ‘Good son!

如是我聞：: 若復有人， 厭世間苦， 求長生樂者，
Again suppose that a man dissatisfied with the sufferings of the world is someone who seeks long life and happiness.

如是我聞：: 在閑淨處， 清淨結界。 呪衣著。 若水、若食、若香、若藥， 皆呪一百八遍， 服， 必得長命。
[To do so he should] secure a clean and peaceful place to recite [the dhāraṇī], [put together whatever] clothing, water, food, incense, or medicine [he might have and] recite it 108 times before using them, and for sure he will acquire a long life.

如是我聞：: 「若能如法結界， 依法受持， 一切成就。 其結界法者，
If he is able to make a place secure in accord with the [right] procedure and relies on this method, accepts and keeps to it, then everything will be successful.’ ‘These are the methods of making a secure place.

如是我聞：: 取刀， 呪二十一遍， 劃地為界。
Take hold of a knife, recite [the dhāraṇī] twenty-one times, and then [use that knife to] mark a boundary on the ground.

如是我聞：: 或取淨水， 呪二十一遍， 散著四方為界。
Or, take up some clean water, recite [the dhāraṇī] twenty-one times, and then sprinkle [the water] to mark out the four sides of the boundary.

如是我聞：: 或取白芥子， 呪二十一遍， 擲著四方為界。
Or, take hold of some white mustard seeds, recite [the dhāraṇī] twenty-one times, and then scatter them to mark out the four sides of the boundary.

如是我聞：: 或以想到處為界， 或取淨灰， 呪二十一遍為界。
Or, either by visu­alizing the boundaries of the place or taking up some pure ash, recite [the dhāraṇī] twenty-one times toward the boundary.

如是我聞：: 或呪五色線二十一遍， 圍繞四邊為界。
Or, recite the [dhāraṇī over a] five-colored thread twenty-one times and circle it around the four sides of the boundary.

如是我聞：: 皆得。
All [of these methods will] obtain [the same result].

如是我聞：: 「若能如法受持， 自然剋果。 若聞此陀羅尼名字者， 尚滅無量劫生死重罪， 何況誦持者？
If someone who has received and keeps [the dhāraṇī] can follow this method, then the fruits of success [come] naturally.’ ‘ If the heavy sins of countless numbers of kalpas are burnt away even for those who hear [just the] name of this dhāraṇī, then what about those who recite and keep it?

如是我聞：: 若得此神呪誦者， 當知其人， 已曾供養無量諸佛， 廣種善根。 「若能為諸眾生，
If someone has obtained this dhāraṇī and recites it, then know that man [to be someone who] has already made offerings to all the unfathomable numbers of buddhas and has widely planted the roots of goodness.

如是我聞：: 拔其苦難， 如法誦持者， 當知其人， 即是具大悲者。 成佛不久，
If he can remove the miseries of all living creatures as someone who uses the method of reciting and keeping [this dhāraṇī], then know that man to be someone who is completely com­passionate, and will become a buddha before long.

如是我聞：: 所見眾生， 皆悉為誦， 令彼耳聞， 與作菩提因，
[If ever] he sees living crea­tures, he will recite it for all of their sakes causing, as it is heard, all of them to come to together to create the causes of awakening.

如是我聞：: 是人功德， 無量無邊， 讚不可盡。
The merits of such a man are unfathomable and boundless, the praise of whom is never ending.

如是我聞：: 「若能精誠用心， 身持齋戒， 為一切眾生， 懺悔先業之罪， 亦自懺謝，
‘If he is able with a sincere heart to keep his body pure, and [toward] all living creatures repents his former sinful acts and personally apologizes for the vari­ous sorts of wicked acts [he has done] over unfathomable numbers of kalpas, [and if] from his mouth [he can] quickly recite this dhāraṇī with no break [between its] sounds, [then] the four śramaṇa fruits [that arise in] this life will be evidence [of this].

如是我聞：: 無量劫來， 種種惡業， 口中馺馺， 誦此陀羅尼， 聲聲不絕者， 四沙門果， 此生即證。 其利根有慧， 觀方便者， 十地果位，
His sharp roots of wisdom and skillful means in seeing position him among the fruits of the tenth ground.

如是我聞：: 剋獲不難， 何況世間小小福報？
As successful acquisition [of that] is not difficult, what about the small rewards of this world?

如是我聞：: 所有求願， 無不果遂者也。 「若欲使鬼者， 取野髑髏淨洗， 於千眼像前設壇場， 以種種香華、飲食祭之，
Whatever he aspires to, there will be nothing that does not come to fruition.’ ‘If one wishes to command ghosts, get a skull from the wilderness, wash it clean, and place it on a platform in front of a likeness of Thousand Eyes, and then make offerings with various sorts of incense, flowers, drink, and food.

如是我聞：: 日日如是， 七日必來現身， 隨人使令。
Do this daily for seven days, and [the ghost] will come, manifesting a body that obeys one’s commands.

如是我聞：: 「若欲使四天王者， 呪檀香燒之。
If one desires to command the Four Heavenly Kings, recite [the dhāraṇī] over burning sandalwood incense.

如是我聞：: 「由此菩薩大悲願力深重故， 亦為此陀羅尼威神廣大故。 」佛告阿難： 「若有國土， 災難起時，
The vast and great awesome power of the dhāraṇī comes from the bodhisattva’s great and compassionate aspiration, which is deep and strong.’ The Buddha told Ānanda: ‘Suppose there is a country where, when calamity arises, the king of that country uses the right Dharma to rule the realm.

如是我聞：: 是土國王， 若以正法治國， 寬縱人物， 不枉眾生， 赦諸有過，
[A king who] is tolerant toward man and beast, is not unjust toward any living creature, and forgives all those at fault.

如是我聞：: 七日七夜， 身心精進， 誦持如是大悲心陀羅尼神呪， 令彼國土， 一切災難，
[If that king] exerts himself with body and soul for seven days and seven nights, and keeps and recites the charm that is the Dhāraṇī of Great Compassion, then [in] his realm he will cause all calamities to be completely burnt out, the five grains to be abundant, and all the people to be peaceful and content.

如是我聞：: 悉皆除滅， 五穀豐登， 萬姓安樂。 「又若為於他國怨敵， 數來侵擾， 百姓不安， 大臣謀叛， 疫氣流行， 水旱不調， 日月失度。 如是種種災難起時， 當造千眼大悲心像， 面向西方， 以種種香華、幢旛、寶蓋、或百味飲食，
‘Moreover, if the enemies of his realm often invade, the people are not peaceful, the great minister plans to revolt, plague qi flows, wet and dry are not in balance, [or] the Sun and Moon lose regularity, at such times when these various sorts of calamity arise, then a likeness of the Great Compassionate [One] with a Thousand Eyes should be made facing toward the west and various sorts of incense, flowers, banners, jewelled parasols, and drink and food of perhaps a hundred flavors, [should all be given] as offerings from the heart.

如是我聞：: 至心供養。 其王又能七日七夜， 身心精進， 誦持如是陀羅尼神妙章句。 外國怨敵， 即自降伏，
‘[If] that king also for seven days and seven nights, exerts himself with body and soul, reciting from memory the wondrous words of the dhāraṇī, [then] foreign enemies will surrender themselves and each will return.

如是我聞：: 各還政治， 不相擾惱， 國土通同， 慈心相向。
With order restored, and no friction between [any factions], his realm will be harmonious everywhere, and [the people will be] compassionate toward each other.

如是我聞：: 王子百官， 皆行忠赤， 妃后婇女， 孝敬向王。
The princes and officers will all be loyal, and his wife, the queen, and all his concubines will be respectful toward the king.

如是我聞：: 諸龍鬼神， 擁護其國。 雨澤順時， 果實豐饒， 人民歡樂。 「又若家內， 遇大惡病， 百怪競起， 鬼神邪魔， 耗亂其家， 惡人橫造口舌以相謀害， 室家大小內外不和者， 當向千眼大悲像前，
All the nāgas and spirits will closely protect that realm, it will rain at the right times, its fruits will be abundant and plenty, and the people will be contented.’ ‘Moreover, if [anyone] in a family were to suddenly catch some dreadful illness, or disputes arise due to a ‘hundred evil forces,’ or yakṣas or evil Māras were to wreak havoc upon that family, or wicked people besmirch [them so that they] argue amongst themselves, or intends to harm [the members of] that family [such that] the elders and young ones, close and distant [relatives] argue, then go before a likeness of the Heart of Great Compassion with a Thousand Eyes, set up a platform, and wholeheartedly think of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva.

如是我聞：: 設其壇場， 至心念觀世音菩薩。 誦此陀羅尼， 滿其千遍， 如上惡事， 悉皆消滅， 永得安隱。 」阿難白佛言：
Keep and recite the dhāraṇī a full thousand times, whereby the above evil matters will be completely burnt out and there will always be peace and tranquility.’ Ānanda spoke to the Buddha, saying: ‘Lord!

如是我聞：: 「世尊！ 此呪名何？ 云何受持？ 」佛告阿難： 「如是神呪有種種名。 一名：
This dhāraṇī, what is it called, how is it received and kept?’ The Buddha told Ānanda: ‘This dhāraṇī has various names: one name is Vast and Perfect, one name is Unimpeded Great Compassion, one name is Rescuer from Suffering Dhāraṇī, one name is Life-Lengthening Dhāraṇī, one name is Quick Burning Out of Evil Dhāraṇī, one name is Destroyer of Evil Works and Obstructions Dhāraṇī, one is Wish-Fulfilling Dhāraṇī, one name is Following the Heart’s Freedom Dhāraṇī, and one name is Quickly Stepping Up [Through] the Grounds Dhāraṇī.

如是我聞：: 廣大圓滿。 一名： 無礙大悲。 一名： 救苦陀羅尼。 一名： 延壽陀羅尼。 一名： 滅惡趣陀羅尼。 一名： 破惡業障陀羅尼。 一名： 滿願陀羅尼。 一名： 隨心自在陀羅尼。 一名： 速超上地陀羅尼。 如是受持。 」阿難白佛言： 「世尊！ 此菩薩摩訶薩， 名字何等？ 善能宣說如是陀羅尼。 」佛言： 「此菩薩名『觀世音自在』，
This is how you are to receive and keep it.’ Then Ānanda spoke to the Buddha, saying: ‘Lord, this bodhisattva-m ahāsattva, what is the name [of the one whose] goodness enables him to speak such a dhāraṇī?’ The Buddha said: ‘This bodhisattva is named Avalokiteśvara; he is also called Rope Holder and [another name] is A Thousand Bright Eyes.

如是我聞：: 亦名『撚索』， 亦名『千光眼』。 「善男子！
Good son!

如是我聞：: 此觀世音菩薩， 不可思議威神之力，
This Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva has inexpressibly mighty spiritual power.

如是我聞：: 已於過去無量劫中， 已作佛竟， 號『正法明如來』。 大悲願力， 為欲發起一切菩薩，
Some unfathomable numbers of kalpas ago in the past, he has already become a buddha named Light of the Right Dharma Tathāgata and now manifests as this Bodhisattva because of his great compassion, strength of aspiration, and desire to cause all bodhisattvas to [bring] peace and happiness to all living creatures.

如是我聞：: 安樂成熟諸眾生故， 現作菩薩。 「汝等大眾、諸菩薩摩訶薩、梵、釋、龍、神， 皆應恭敬，
All of you in this great gathering—all you bodhisattva- mahāsattvas, Brahmās, Śakras, nāgas, and yakṣas— you should all worship him without even the slightest trace of contempt.

如是我聞：: 莫生輕慢。 一切人天， 常須供養。 專稱名號， 得無量福， 滅無量罪， 命終往生阿彌陀佛國。 」佛告阿難： 「此觀世音菩薩，
All men and devas should constantly make offerings and recite his name to obtain innumerable blessings, to burn out innumerable sins so that, at the end of their lives, they go on to birth in the realm of Amitabha Buddha.’ The Buddha told Ānanda: ‘This Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva and the dhāraṇī that he has spoken of is true and no deception.

如是我聞：: 所說神呪， 真實不虛。 若欲請此菩薩來， 呪拙具羅香(拙具羅香， 安息香也)三七遍， 燒， 菩薩即來。 「若有猫兒所著者， 取弭哩吒那(死猫兒頭骨也)燒作灰，
If there is the desire to invite this bodhisattva to come, [recite the dhāraṇī] over some guggul incense three times seven times, burn it, and the bodhisattva will come.’ If someone is seized by a cat [spirit], get the skull of a dead kitten and burn it to make ashes.

如是我聞：: 和淨土泥， 捻作猫兒形，
Then, with mud [made from clean soil] shape it with the fingers into the form of a cat.

如是我聞：: 於千眼像前， 呪鑌鐵刀子一百八遍， 段段割之，
Then recite [the dhāraṇī] over a wrought iron knife 108 times, cutting it piece by piece.

如是我聞：: 亦一百八段， 遍遍一呪， 一稱彼名，
For each time one of those 108 pieces [is cut, recite the] dhāraṇī once and call out its name once.

如是我聞：: 即永差不著。
Thereafter, it will be drawn out forever, and never seize [that person again].

如是我聞：: 「若為蠱毒所害者， 取藥劫布羅(龍腦香也)， 和拙具羅香，
‘If someone is harmed by venomous insects, get some medicinal camphor and guggul incense each in equal proportion and boil it in one sheng of fresh well water.

如是我聞：: 各等分， 以井華水一升和煎， 取一升， 於千眼像前， 呪一百八遍， 服， 即差。 「若為惡蛇蠍所螫者， 取乾薑末， 呪一七遍， 著瘡中， 立即除差。 「若為惡怨橫相謀害者， 取淨土、或麵、或蠟，
Take a sheng [of the decoction] and, in front of a likeness of Thousand Eyes, recite the dhāraṇī 108 times; apply [the medicine and then the venom will be] immediately drawn out.’ ‘If someone is struck by a malignant snake or scorpion, get some powdered dry ginger, recite the dhāraṇī [over it] one times seven times, press it onto the wound, and the [venom] will be immediately drawn out.’ ‘If someone is hated or resented and injurious plots [are made] against them, get some clean soil, or flour or wax, and shape it with the fingers to form a body.

如是我聞：: 捻作本形， 於千眼像前， 呪鑌鐵刀一百八遍，
Then, in front of a likeness of Thousand Eyes, recite the dhāraṇī over a wrought iron knife 108 times.

如是我聞：: 一呪一截， 一稱彼名， 燒盡一百八段， 彼即歡喜，
With each recitation of the dhāraṇī, make one cut and say the name [of the aggressor] once, and then burn completely all of the 108 pieces.

如是我聞：: 終身厚重， 相愛敬。 「若有患眼睛壞者， 若青盲眼暗者， 若白暈、赤膜， 無光明者， 取訶梨勒果、菴摩勒果、鞞醯勒果，
That person will like [their former victim], be courteous to them till the end of their life, and they will look upon them with kindness and respect.’ ‘If someone suffers an injury to their eyes, or if someone has ‘clear-eye blindness’, dim vision, a white haze or red membrane, or a lack of clear [vision], then get [dried] chebulic, emblic, and beleric myrobalan fruits.

如是我聞：: 三種各一顆， 擣破細研。
From each type, take one piece, pound these into bits, and grind them into fine crumbs.

如是我聞：: 當研時， 唯須護淨， 莫使新產婦人及猪、狗見。
During the grinding, you must be watchful over the purity [of the process and so] let no woman who has just given birth, or any pig or dog see it.

如是我聞：: 口中念佛， 以白蜜、若人乳汁， 和封眼中。
Orally recite the [name of the] Buddha and then mix with white honey, or perhaps mother’s milk, for application to the eyes.

如是我聞：: 著其人乳， 要須男孩子母乳， 女母乳不成。
If it is applied with mother’s milk, then it is important that it be from a boy’s mother—a girl’s mother’s milk will not do.

如是我聞：: 其藥和竟， 還須千眼像前， 呪一千八遍， 著眼中，
The final mixture of the medicine should be brought immediately before a likeness of Thousand Eyes, the dhāraṇī recited 1,008 times, and then applied to the eyes.

如是我聞：: 滿七日， 在深室慎風， 眼睛還生。
[After a full] seven days in a dark room free from any draught, the eyes will become clear again.

如是我聞：: 青盲、白暈者， 光奇盛也。 「若患瘧病著者， 取虎、豹、犲、狼皮， 呪三七遍，
Any partial blindness or white haze [will have gone and the vision will] be bright and clear.’ ‘If someone is suffering in the grasp of a fever, get the skin of a tiger, wild cat, or wolf, recite the dhāraṇī three times, open [it up and] wrap it over their body [and the fever will] be immediately drawn out.

如是我聞：: 披著身上， 即差。 師子皮最上。 若被蛇螫， 取被螫人結𦡲， 呪三七遍， 著瘡中， 即差。 「若患惡瘧， 入心悶絕欲死者， 取桃膠一顆， 大小亦如桃顆， 清水一升和煎，
Lion skin is the best.’ ‘If someone is bitten by a snake, get some earwax from that person, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times toward the earwax, apply it to the wound; then it will be driven out.’ ‘If someone is suffering from a grievous fever, [such that a] desire for death as the [only way to] end their pain enters their thoughts, get some peach gum, a lump the size of an actual peach, and boil it together with a pint of clean water [until] half a sheng [remains].

如是我聞：: 取半升， 呪七遍， 頓服盡， 即差。
Then, recite the dhāraṇī seven times, drink it completely and [the fever will be] driven out.

如是我聞：: 其藥莫使婦人煎。 「若患傳屍鬼氣、伏屍連病者， 取拙具羅香， 呪三七遍， 燒熏鼻孔中。
This medicine should not be prepared by a woman.’ ‘If someone is the carrier of a spirit or a vetāla, then to subdue the sickness bound to that corpse, get some guggul incense, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and burn it [so that its] smoke enters the nostrils.

如是我聞：: 又取七丸如兔糞， 呪三七遍， 吞， 即差。
Then, take seven pills, about the size of a rabbit stool, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, swallow them, and it will be driven out.

如是我聞：: 慎酒肉五辛及惡罵。 若取摩那屎羅(雄黃是也)， 和白芥子印成鹽， 呪三七遍， 於病兒床下燒，
Be cautious [about drinking] alcohol, [eating] meat or any of the Five Pungent [Roots], and using foul language.’ ‘If some realgar and white mustard seeds are ground with salt, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and burn it undern eath the bed of a sick child.

如是我聞：: 其作病兒， 即魔掣迸走， 不敢住也。 「若患耳聾者， 呪胡麻油， 著耳中， 即差。 「若患一邊偏風， 耳鼻不通、手脚不隨者， 取胡麻油， 煎青木香， 呪三七遍，
Any malicious spirits will then be immediately driven out as they dare not linger.’ ‘If someone suffers from deafness in one ear, recite the dhāraṇī [over some] linseed oil, put it into the ear, and it will be driven out.’ ‘If someone is suffering from a Wind dysfunction that affects one side of the body causing it to sag, to be numb from nose to ear, and the arm and left side to not be responsive, then get linseed oil, and decoct with pipevine; recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and wipe it over the body with the hand [and the infliction] will be driven out forever.

如是我聞：: 摩拭身上， 永得除差。 又方取純牛酥， 呪三七遍， 摩， 亦差。 「若患難產者， 取胡麻油， 呪三七遍， 摩產婦臍中及玉門中， 即易生。 「若婦人懷妊， 子死腹中， 取阿波末利伽草(牛膝草也)一大兩， 清水二升和煎，
Another method is to get ghee, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, rub [it in], and it will be driven out.’ ‘If a woman has difficulty in giving birth, get some sesame oil, recite the mantra three times seven times, rub it on to the navel and within the jade gate, and the birth will become easier.’ ‘If a woman is pregnant, and the child dies in her belly, get a large liang of prickly chaff flower grass and boil it in two sheng of clean water.

如是我聞：: 取一升， 呪三七遍， 服， 即出一，
Take one sheng [of the decoction], recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, and take it.

如是我聞：: 無苦痛。 胎衣不出者，
Then, when it comes out, there will be no pain.

如是我聞：: 亦服此藥， 即差。 「若卒患心痛不可忍者， 名『遁屍疰』， 取君柱魯香(薰陸香)， 乳頭成者一顆， 呪三七遍，
If the afterbirth does not come out, take more of this medicine and it will then be discharged.’ ‘If someone suddenly suffers from unbearable heart pain, described as the ‘grip of the hidden dead, get some frankincense incense, a piece in the shape of a nipple, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, and put it into the mouth, chew, and swallow.

如是我聞：: 口中嚼咽， 不限多少， 令變吐， 即差。
There is no fixed amount, [take whatever amount is needed] to cause vomiting, then it will be driven out.

如是我聞：: 慎五辛、酒肉。 「若被火燒瘡， 取熱瞿摩夷(烏牛屎也)， 呪三七遍， 塗瘡上，
Be cautious [about consuming] any of the five pungent vegetables, alcohol, or meat.’ ‘If someone has burn blisters, get some warm dung from a black cow, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and spread it over the blisters.

如是我聞：: 即差。 「若患蛔蟲齩心， 取骨魯末遮(白馬尿也)半升， 呪三七遍， 服， 即差。
They will soon go.’ ‘If someone is suffering from tapeworms or worms biting the heart, get some urine from a white horse, about half a sheng, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, take it, and these will soon be driven out.

如是我聞：: 重者一升，
If severe, one sheng.

如是我聞：: 蟲如綟索出來。 「若患丁瘡者， 取凌鎖葉擣取汁，
The worms will then come out like ropes.’ ‘If someone is suffering from a deep-rooted boil, get some astringent leaves and pound them.

如是我聞：: 呪三七遍， 瀝著瘡上， 即拔根出， 立差。
Take the juice, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, apply by trickling it onto the boil, and then squeeze the root out.

如是我聞：: 「若患蠅螫眼中， 骨魯怛佉(新驢屎也)濾取汁， 呪三七遍， 夜臥著眼中，
It will be released immediately.’ ‘If [someone] is suffering from eyes stung by flies, [get some] white donkey or mule dung, strain it to get the fluids, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, and then, [when going to] sleep at night, put it into the eyes.

如是我聞：: 即差。 「若患腹中痛， 和井華水， 和印成鹽三七顆，
It will soon go.’ ‘If [someone] is suffering from abdominal pains, mix well-flower water with crushed salt, three [times] seven lumps.

如是我聞：: 呪三七遍， 服半升， 即差。 「若患赤眼者， 及眼中有努肉及有翳者， 取奢奢彌葉(苟杞葉也)， 擣濾取汁，
Recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times, take a half sheng, and it will be driven out.’ ‘If someone is suffering from red eyes, or someone has a growth on their eye or [their vision had become] cloudy, get some shami leaves, pound and strain to get the juice.

如是我聞：: 呪三七遍， 浸青錢一宿， 更呪七遍，
Recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and soak a copper coin in it overnight.

如是我聞：: 著眼中， 即差。 「若患畏夜， 不安恐怖， 出入驚怕者， 取白線作索， 呪三七遍， 作二十一結， 繫項， 恐怖即除。
Then, recite the dhāraṇī seven times, put it into the eyes, and it will soon be driven out.’ ‘If someone is afraid of the dark, is anxious, is terrified, or dreads coming and going, get some white thread and make a cord, [recite] the dhāraṇī three [times] seven [times], then make twenty-one knots, fasten it around [their] neck, and [their] fear will be cast out.

如是我聞：: 非但除怖， 亦得滅罪。 「若家內橫起災難者， 取石榴枝， 寸截一千八段，
Not only will [their] fears be cast out, [whatever] evil [they fear] will be burnt away too.’ ‘If someone has a sudden misfortune befall [their] family, get a branch from a pomegranate [tree], cut it into 1,008 bits one cun [in length], spread butter and honey on both ends, recite the dhāraṇī once, and burn one piece [at a time].

如是我聞：: 兩頭塗酥酪蜜， 一呪一燒， 盡千八遍，
At the end, [recite the dhāraṇī a further] 1,008 times.

如是我聞：: 一切災難悉皆除滅，
All misfortunes will be completely gone, burnt away.

如是我聞：: 要在佛前作之。 「若取白菖蒲， 呪三七遍， 繫著右臂上， 一切鬪處、論義處，
It is import ant to do this in front of a buddha [image].’ ‘If some calamus leaves are taken, the dhāraṇī [is recited] three times seven times, and [the leaves are] tied above the right forearm, [then] wherever there are disputes or wherever there are arguments, the [bearer] will always triumph over others.’ ‘If a leafy branch from a shami [tree] is taken and cut [into bits one] cun [in length], and ghee, white honey, and butter are spread over both ends, then for one [recitation of] the dhāraṇī, burn one [piece of the wood until all] 1,008 pieces [are burnt].

如是我聞：: 皆得勝他。 「若取奢奢彌葉枝柯， 寸截， 兩頭塗真牛酥、白蜜牛酥， 一呪一燒， 盡一千八段， 日別三時， 時別一千八遍，
[Do this] three separate times per day, each time for 1,008 repetitions.

如是我聞：: 滿七日， 呪師自悟通智也。 「若欲降伏大力鬼神者， 取阿唎瑟迦柴(木患子也)， 呪七七遍，
Do this for a full seven days [to become] a master of dhāraṇīs, and awaken penetrat- ing knowledge [within] yourself.’ ‘If someone wants to subdue a powerf ul ghost or spirit, get some firewood from an Indian soapberry tree, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times and burn it in a fire, after spreading it with butter and honey.

如是我聞：: 火中燒， 還須塗酥酪蜜， 要須於大悲心像前作之。 若取胡嚧遮那(牛黃是也)一大兩， 著瑠璃瓶中， 置大悲心像前， 呪一百八遍， 塗身、點額， 一切天、龍、鬼、神、人及非人， 皆悉歡喜也。
This must be done in front of a likeness of the Great Compassionate One.’ ‘If two large liangs of ox bezoar are taken, put into a bottle [made of] lapis lazuli, set up in front of a likeness of the Great Compassionate One, and the dhāraṇī [is recited] 108 times, then [after this] spread upon the body, [and a] spot [is placed on the] forehead, all devas, nāgas, ghosts, spirits, humans, and non-humans will be thoroughly delighted.’ ‘If someone’s body is covered with shackles, get the droppings of a white pigeon, recite the dhāraṇī 108 times, dab it onto the hands, and then rub the shackles.

如是我聞：: 「若有身被枷鎖者， 取白鴿糞， 呪一百八遍， 塗於手上， 用摩枷鎖， 枷鎖自脫也。 「若有夫婦不和， 狀如水火者， 取鴛鴦尾， 於大悲心像前，
The shackles will spontaneously drop off.’ ‘If a husband and wife are disharmonious, and their condition is like water and fire, get [feathers from the] tails of a pair of mandarin ducks, [hold them in] front of a likeness of the Great Compassion One, recite the dhāraṇī 1,008 times, and then [let them] wear them.

如是我聞：: 呪一千八遍， 帶， 彼即終身歡喜相愛敬。 「若有被蟲食， 田苗及五果子者， 取淨灰、淨沙或淨水， 呪三七遍，
Then they will, until their lives’ end, be happy, loving, and respectful toward each other.’ ‘If seedlings in the fields or the five sorts of fruit on a farm are being eaten by bugs, get clean ash, clean sand, or clean water, recite the dhāraṇī three times seven times.

如是我聞：: 散田苗四邊， 蟲即退散也。
[Then,] scatter it around the four sides of the field [with the] seedlings, and the grubs will scurry away.

如是我聞：: 果樹兼呪水灑者， 樹上蟲不敢食果也。 」佛告阿難： 「若為富饒， 種種珍寶資具者，
Sprinkle it on the fruits of the trees while [reciting the] dhāraṇī, and the grubs on the trees will not dare eat the fruit.’ The Buddha told Ānanda: ‘If [someone wishes] to become rich, to have wealth [such as the] various sorts of jewels and property, then make the wish-fulfilling gem mudrā.

如是我聞：: 當於如意珠手。 若為種種不安求安隱者， 當於羂索手。
If it is to seek peace and tranquility during various sorts of unrest, then make the rope mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為腹中諸病， 當於寶鉢手。
If it is to [remedy] an illness of the abdomen, then make the jewel bowel mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為降伏一切魍魎鬼神者， 當於寶劍手。 若為降伏一切天魔神者，
If it is to subdue any spirit, monster, or yakṣa, then make the jewel sword mudrā. If it is to subdue any god of the Māra [realm], then make the vajra mudrā.

如是我聞：: 當於跋折羅手。 若為摧伏一切怨敵者， 當於金剛杵手。
If it is to crush an enemy, then make the vajra-staff mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為一切處怖畏不安者， 當於施無畏手。
If it is to [overcome] any sort of fear and anxiety, then make the fearlessness-giving mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為眼闇無光明者， 當於日精摩尼手。
If it is [to heal] shadowy and unclear vision, then make the sunshine gem mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為熱毒病求清涼者， 當於月精摩尼手。
If it is to seek the cooling of some feverish illness, then make the moonshine gem mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為榮官益職者， 當於寶弓手。
If it is to [gain] esteemed office, or promotion, then make the jewel bow mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為諸善朋友早相逢者， 當於寶箭手。
If it is to [bring] together others, all as good friends, then make the jewel arrow mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為身上種種病者， 當於楊枝手。 若為除身上惡障難者， 當於白拂手。
If it is to [remedy] the various illnesses of the body, then make the tooth stick mudrā. If it is to drive evil obstacles and difficulties away from the body, then make the white whisk mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為一切善和眷屬者， 當於胡瓶手。
If it is to [establish] the good and [bring] harmony between followers, then make the [mixing] pot mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為辟除一切虎狼犲豹諸惡獸者， 當於旁牌手。
If it is to ward off any tiger, wolf, bear, leopard, and all [other sorts] of malicious beasts, then make the shield mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為一切時處好離官難者， 當於斧鉞手。
If it is to always live in a goodly place that turns away political strife, then make the battle-axe mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為男女僕使者， 當於玉環手。
If it is to [manage] male and female servants, then make the jade bracelet mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為種種功德者， 當於白蓮華手。
If it is to [gain] various sorts of merits, then make the white lotus mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為欲得往生十方淨土者， 當於青蓮華手。
If it is to [realize] the wish to go on to a birth in a pure land [somewhere] throughout the ten directions, then make the blue lotus mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為大智慧者， 當於寶鏡手。
If it is to [obtain] great wisdom, then make the jewel mirror mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為面見十方一切諸佛者， 當於紫蓮華手。
If it is to meet face [to face with] all the buddhas of the ten directions, then make the purple lotus mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為地中伏藏者， 當於寶篋手。
If it is to [find] treasures hidden in the ground, then make the jewel casket mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為仙道者， 當於五色雲手。
If it is to [tread] the path of the rishis, then make the five-color cloud mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為生梵天者， 當於軍遲手。 若為往生諸天宮者， 當於紅蓮華手。
If it is to [obtain] birth as a god in a pure realm, then make the [bathing] pot mudrā. If it is to [go on to] birth some heavenly mansion, then make the lotus mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為辟除他方逆賊者， 當於寶戟手。
If it is to subdue the opposition of others, then make the jewel spear mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為召呼一切諸天善神者， 當於寶螺手。 若為使令一切鬼神者， 當於髑髏杖手。
If it is to rally all devas and good yakṣas, then make the jewel conch mudrā. If it is to control ghosts and spirits, then make the ‘dead skull stick’ mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為十方諸佛速來授手者， 當於數珠手。 若為成就一切上妙梵音聲者， 當於寶鐸手。
If it is to [have] all the buddhas of the ten directions swiftly come and take [your] hand [at the moment of death], then make the counting-bead mudrā. If it is to achieve the fi nest, purest-sounding voice, then make the jewel bell mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為口業辭辯巧妙者， 當於寶印手。
If it is to be someone with the ability to speak with skillfully [chosen] words in a clever and admirable [way], then make the jewel seal mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為善神龍王常來擁護者， 當於俱尸鐵鉤手。
If it is to always have goodly spirits and the nāga kings come and [give their] protection, then make the rope and goad mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為慈悲覆護一切眾生者， 當於錫杖手。
If it is to compassionately safeguard e very living creature, then make the tin stick mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為一切眾生常相恭敬愛念者， 當於合掌手。
If it is for all living creatures to always respect and cherish each other, then make the ‘namaste’ mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為生生之處不離諸佛邊者， 當於化佛手。
If it is to never, from life to life, depart from the sides of all the buddhas, then make the transformation buddha mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為生生世世常在佛宮殿中， 不處胎藏中受身者， 當於化宮殿手。
If it is to forever, from birth to birth, and life to life, dwell in the mansion of a buddha, and not live in any body received from within any womb, then make the transformation palace mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為多聞廣學者， 當於寶經手。
If it is for hearing much and learning widely, then make the jewel sūtra mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為從今身至佛身， 菩提心常不退轉者， 當於不退金輪手。
If it is to never, from this present body until [obtaining] the body of a buddha, turn away from bodhicitta, then make the irreversible golden wheel mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為十方諸佛速來摩頂授記者， 當於頂上化佛手。
If it is to have all the buddhas of the ten directions come and rub the top of [one’s] head and grant the receipt of an account, then make the transformation buddha crown mudrā.

如是我聞：: 若為果蓏諸穀稼者， 當於蒲萄手。
If it is for fruits, melons, and all [other] crops, then make the myrobalan mudrā.

如是我聞：: 如是可求之法， 有其千條， 今粗略說少耳。 」日光菩薩為受持大悲心陀羅尼者，
There are a thousand sorts of this method of re quest; I have roughly outlined a few.’ Radiant Sun Bodhisattva then spoke this great dhāraṇī [for the] protection [of] those who have received and keep the Dhāraṇī of the Heart of Great Compassion:8 Adoration to the Buddha, of [all good] qualities.

如是我聞：: 說大神呪，
Adoration to the Dharma, the great understanding.

如是我聞：: 而擁護之：
Adoration to the Sangha, [those who] journey.

如是我聞：: 「南無勃陀瞿(上聲)那(上聲)迷(一)南無達摩莫訶低(二)南無僧伽多夜泥(三)底(丁以切)哩部畢薩(僧沒切)咄(登沒切)檐納摩「誦此呪，
[These] three, in the Bodhisattva as one, so named. Hail!

如是我聞：: 滅一切罪， 亦能辟魔及除天災。 「若誦一遍，
‘Reciting this dhāraṇī burns out all sins and can restrain Māra and all other heaven[-wrought] misfortunes.

如是我聞：: 禮佛一拜， 如是日別三時， 誦呪禮佛， 未來之世， 所受身處， 當得一一相貌端正， 可喜果報。 」月光菩薩亦復為諸行人，
If it is recited once, while bowing to the buddhas once, and this reciting and bowing to the buddhas is repeated daily at the three times, then in future lives, wherever one is born, during each one [of those lives], one will have fine features, and the reward of happiness.’ Radiant Moon Bodhisattva then spoke this dhāraṇī [for the] protection of all the followers: [With] wickedness bound, Go in peace.

如是我聞：: 說陀羅尼呪， 而擁護之：
Lying down to sleep, Encounter, go across. Led by Yama, [With battles] won by [your] hand, Go beyond.

如是我聞：: 「深低帝屠蘇吒(一)阿若蜜帝烏都吒(二)深耆吒(三)波賴帝(四)耶彌若吒烏都吒(五)拘羅帝吒耆摩吒(六)沙婆訶「誦此呪五遍，
Hail!

如是我聞：: 取五色線， 作呪索， 痛處繫。
‘Recite this dhāraṇī five times, get a five-colored thread and make a dhāraṇī cord, fasten it around [anywhere] that is in pain.

如是我聞：: 「此呪乃是過去四十恒河沙諸佛所說，
In the past, this dhāraṇī has been spoken by buddhas [as numerous as the] sands of forty Ganges rivers.

如是我聞：: 我今亦說。 為諸行人， 作擁護故， 除一切障難故， 除一切惡病痛故， 成就一切諸善法故， 遠離一切諸怖畏故。 」佛告阿難：
I [have] now spoken it too, for all followers, because it protects, because it removes all hin­drances and difficulties, because it removes all evils, diseases, and pain, because it brings to fulfilment all wholesome methods, and because it turns away all fears.’ The Buddha told Ānanda: ‘You must, with a purity from the depths of your heart, accept and keep this dhāraṇī.

如是我聞：: 「汝當深心清淨， 受持此陀羅尼， 廣宣流布於閻浮提， 莫令斷絕。
Proclaim it widely so that it is known everywhere in Jambudvīpa, and never let its [transmission] become broken or stop.

如是我聞：: 「此陀羅尼， 能大利益三界眾生，
This dhāraṇī can [bring] great benefits to living creatures [throughout] the three realms.

如是我聞：: 一切患苦縈身者， 以此陀羅尼治之， 無有不差者。
For all those suffering miseries that riddle their bodies, this dhāraṇī is a cure—of this there is no mistake.

如是我聞：: 「此大神呪， 呪乾枯樹， 尚得生枝、柯、華、果，
If this great dhāraṇī [is] recited over a dry, withered tree, [its] branches will then start to sprout stems, flowers, and fruit.

如是我聞：: 何況有情、有識眾生？
[So,] what about living creatures with consciousness?

如是我聞：: 身有病患， 治之不差者， 必無是處。
If their bodies are diseased, it is a faultless cure—there is nothing impossible.

如是我聞：: 「善男子！
Good son!

如是我聞：: 此陀羅尼， 威神之力， 不可思議！ 不可思議！
This dhāraṇī’s mighty spiritual power is inexpressible and inconceivable, and its praises are inexhaustible!

如是我聞：: 歎莫能盡。 若不過去久遠已來廣種善根， 乃至名字不可得聞， 何況得見？ 汝等大眾， 天、人、龍、神，
‘[Those of] you [who] have not, since the far and distant past, widely planted goodly [karmic] roots and did not get to hear the name [of the dhāraṇī], let alone encounter it, you should [now also] rejoice [along with the] great assembly of devas, humans, nāgas, and yakṣas on hearing me praising [it].

如是我聞：: 聞我讚歎， 皆應隨喜。 「若有謗此呪者， 即為謗彼九十九億恒河沙諸佛。
If anyone slanders this dhāraṇī, then [they] are also slandering buddhas [as numerous as] the sands of 990 million Ganges Rivers.

如是我聞：: 若於此陀羅尼， 生疑不信者， 當知其人， 永失大利， 百千萬劫，
‘If anyone [gives] rise to doubts and disbelieves this dhāraṇī, then know that such a person has forever lost a great boon and will remain submerged in the evil destinies for a billion kalpas.

如是我聞：: 常淪惡趣， 無有出期， 常不見佛、不聞法、不覩僧。 」一切眾會菩薩摩訶薩、金剛密跡、梵釋四天、龍、鬼、神， 聞佛如來讚歎此陀羅尼，
Never having the opportunity, [they] will never meet the Buddha, never hear the Dharma, and never see the Sangha.’ The whole mass gathering of bodhisattva-mahāsattvas, vajra holders, Brahmā, Śakra, the Four Heavenly [Kings], nāgas, ghosts, and spirits, had heard the Buddha, the Tathāgata, praise this dhāraṇī.

如是我聞：: 皆悉歡喜， 奉教修行。
[They were] all thoroughly delighted [with what they had heard and], obeying his instructions, cultivated its pursuit.

如是我聞：: 爾時佛在舍衛國祇樹給孤獨園。
At one time the Buddha was dwelling in the Anāthapiṇḍika Garden of Jetavana Park in the city kingdom of Śrāvastī.

如是我聞：: 是時世尊思惟觀察， 愍未來諸眾生故，
The World-Honored One meditated, observing sentient beings of the future.

如是我聞：: 說是七俱胝佛母心准提陀羅尼法。 即說呪曰：
Feeling sympathy with them, He expounded the Dharma of the Cundī Dhāraṇī, the heart of the mother of seven koṭi Buddhas.

如是我聞：: 「南謨颯哆南(一)三藐三勃陀俱胝南(二)怛姪他(三)唵折戾(四)主戾(五)准締(六)娑婆訶(七)」「若有比丘、比丘尼、優婆塞、優婆夷， 受持讀誦此陀羅尼滿八十萬遍， 無量劫來所造五無間等一切諸罪皆悉消滅，
The Buddha then pronounced the mantra: namaḥ saptānāṁ samyak-saṁbuddha koṭināṁ | tad-yathā oṁ cale cule cundi svāhā || “If, among bhikṣus, bhikṣuṇīs, upāsakas, and upāsikās, there are those who uphold this dhāraṇī and recite it 800,000 times, their sins, such as the five rebellious sins accumulated over innumerable kalpas, will all be expunged.

如是我聞：: 所在生處皆得值遇諸佛菩薩，
They will be reborn at places where they will meet Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

如是我聞：: 所有資具隨意充足，
They will have all the material goods they wish.

如是我聞：: 生生常得出家， 具持菩薩律儀淨戒，
They can choose to renounce family life in successive future lives, and they will be able to observe the pure Bodhisattva precepts completely.

如是我聞：: 恒生人天不墮惡趣，
They will be reborn either in the human world or in heaven, having ended forever the evil life-journeys.

如是我聞：: 常為諸天之所守護。
They will always be protected by gods.

如是我聞：: 若有在家善男女等誦持之者， 其家無有災橫病苦之所惱害，
If there are good laymen and laywomen who keep reciting this dhāraṇī, their homes will not be ravaged by catastrophes or diseases.

如是我聞：: 諸有所作無不諧偶， 所說言語人皆信受。
Their work will be smooth and harmonious, and others will believe and accept what they say.

如是我聞：: 若有誦此陀羅尼呪滿十萬遍， 夢中得見諸佛、菩薩、聲聞、緣覺， 自見口中吐出黑物。
“If one has recited this dhāraṇī mantra 100,000 times, one will see in one's dreams Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, voice-hearers, or Pratyekabuddhas, and see oneself vomit black things.

如是我聞：: 若有重罪， 誦滿二十萬遍，
For graver sins, one should recite the mantra 200,000 times.

如是我聞：: 夢中亦見諸佛菩薩， 亦復自見吐出黑物。
Then one will also see in one's dreams Buddhas and Bodhisattvas as well as oneself vomit black things.

如是我聞：: 若有五逆罪， 不得如是善夢之者， 宜應更誦滿七十萬遍，
If one is unable to get such good dreams because of having committed any of the five rebellious sins, one should further recite the mantra 700,000 times.

如是我聞：: 是時還得如前之相。 乃至夢見吐出白色如酪飯等，
Then one should have these good dreams and even see oneself vomit white things, such as creamy rice.

如是我聞：: 當知此人即是罪滅清淨之相。
These are signs of purification, indicating that this person's sins have been expunged.

如是我聞：: 「復次我今說此大陀羅尼所作之事。
“Next, I will now explain the procedure for using this great dhāraṇī.

如是我聞：: 若於佛像前、或於塔前、若清淨處， 以瞿摩夷塗地而作方壇，
In front of a Buddha image or a pagoda, smear the ground of a clean area with cow dung, making a large or small square maṇḍala.

如是我聞：: 隨其大小。 復以花、香、幡蓋、飲食、燈、燭， 隨力所辦而供養之。
According to your ability, decorate it with offerings of flowers, incense, banners, canopies, food, drink, lamps, and candles.

如是我聞：: 復呪香水散於四方上下， 以為結界。
To mark the boundary, recite the mantra to perfumed water in a vessel and sprinkle it in all four directions, also up and down.

如是我聞：: 於壇四角及壇中央， 皆各置一香水之瓶。
Then place a vessel of perfumed water in the center and in each of the four corners of the maṇḍala.

如是我聞：: 持呪之者於其壇中， 面向東方胡跪， 誦呪一千八遍，
You, the mantra reciter, staying inside the maṇḍala, should face east, kneel on your right knee, and recite the mantra 1,080 times.

如是我聞：: 其香水瓶即便自轉。
Afterward, the vessels of perfumed water should swivel by themselves.

如是我聞：: 叉手捧雜花， 呪千八遍， 散一鏡面；
Next, hold a bunch of flowers in both hands, recite the mantra 1,080 times, and scatter them all on the face of a mirror.

如是我聞：: 又於鏡前正觀， 誦呪亦千八遍，
Looking straight into the mirror in front of you, recite the mantra 1,080 times.

如是我聞：: 得見佛菩薩像。
Then you should see images of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas in the mirror.

如是我聞：: 應呪花百八遍， 而散供養，
Again, recite the mantra 108 times to another bunch of flowers and scatter them around as offerings to Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

如是我聞：: 隨請問法無不決了。
Then you should receive answers to any questions you ask.

如是我聞：: 若有鬼病， 以呪茅草而拂病人，
“To treat illness caused by a ghost, brush the patient with kuśa grass to which you have recited the mantra.

如是我聞：: 即得除愈。
Then he should be cured.

如是我聞：: 若有幼小為鬼所著， 以五色縷， 應令童女搓以為線，
For a child possessed by a ghost, have a young maiden twist five threads of different colors into a string.

如是我聞：: 一呪一結滿二十一，
Recite the mantra once each time you tie a knot in the string as you tie twenty-one knots.

如是我聞：: 用繫其頸，
Tie the knotted string around the neck of the child.

如是我聞：: 以芥子呪滿七遍， 散其面，
Recite the mantra seven times to a few mustard seeds and sprinkle them at his face.

如是我聞：: 即便除差。
Then the condition should be removed.

如是我聞：: 「復次有法， 於病者前墨畫其形，
“Another dharma is to draw a picture of the patient on a piece of paper.

如是我聞：: 呪楊枝打之，
Strike it in front of the patient with a willow branch to which you have recited the mantra.

如是我聞：: 亦便除差。
This should also remove the condition.

如是我聞：: 「復次有法， 若有病人為鬼所著， 身在遠處，
“Another dharma is for a possessed patient who lives far away.

如是我聞：: 應呪楊枝具滿七遍，
Recite the mantra seven times to a willow branch.

如是我聞：: 寄人持打，
Send the willow branch to someone to strike the picture of the patient in his presence.

如是我聞：: 即亦除差。
This should also remove the condition.

如是我聞：: 「復次有法， 若在路行，
“Another dharma is to recite the mantra as you travel.

如是我聞：: 誦此呪， 無有賊盜惡獸等畏。
Then you should be free from fear of bandits and ferocious animals.

如是我聞：: 「復次有法， 常持此呪， 設有諍訟無不獲勝。
“Another dharma is to keep reciting this mantra in order that you will win any disputes or lawsuits.

如是我聞：: 若欲往渡江河大海， 誦呪而渡， 無有水中惡獸等難。
In crossing a river or an ocean, continuous recitation of the mantra will keep you safe from aquatic animals.

如是我聞：: 「復次有法， 若被繫閉枷鎖禁其身，
“Another dharma is for a person who is in shackles or in prison.

如是我聞：: 誦此呪者， 即得解脫。
If he keeps reciting the mantra, he will be freed.

如是我聞：: 「復次有法， 若諸國土水旱不調、疫毒流行，
“Another dharma is for a country troubled by flood, drought, or ongoing epidemics.

如是我聞：: 應以酥和胡麻、粳米，
You should mix some butter, sesame seeds, and white rice.

如是我聞：: 用手三指取其一撮， 呪之一遍置火中燒。
Take a pinch of the mixture with three fingers, recite the mantra once to it, and throw it in the fire.

如是我聞：: 或經七日七夜， 六時如是相續不絕，
Repeat this procedure continuously day and night in the six periods for seven days and seven nights.

如是我聞：: 一切災疫悉皆消滅。
All catastrophes or epidemics should thus be eliminated.

如是我聞：: 「復次有法， 於河渚間砂潬之上，
“Another dharma is to imprint with a stamp on riverbanks or sandy beaches the image of a pagoda.

如是我聞：: 以印印砂為塔形像， 誦呪一遍印成一塔， 滿六十萬遍，
Recite the mantra 600,000 times, imprinting a pagoda each time.

如是我聞：: 或見觀世音菩薩、或見多羅菩薩、或見金剛主菩薩，
You will then see Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva, Tara Bodhisattva, or Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva.

如是我聞：: 隨心所求皆得滿足， 或見授與仙藥， 或見與受菩提之記。
Any one of them can fulfill your wishes, give you divine medicine, or bestow upon you the prophecy of future enlightenment.

如是我聞：: 「復次有法， 右遶菩提樹像， 誦呪滿千萬遍，
“Another dharma is to circle the picture of the bodhi tree clockwise as you recite the mantra 10,000,000 times.

如是我聞：: 即見菩薩為其說法， 欲隨菩薩即得隨從。
You should then have a vision of a [holy] Bodhisattva teaching you the Dharma, and you may choose to follow him.

如是我聞：: 「復次有法， 若乞食時常持此呪，
“Another dharma is to recite the mantra as you beg for food.

如是我聞：: 不為惡人惡狗等類之所惱害。
Then you will not be harmed or harassed by villains, vicious dogs, or the like.

如是我聞：: 若於塔前或佛像前或舍利塔前， 誦持此呪三十萬遍，
“Another dharma is to recite the mantra 300,000 times in front of a pagoda, a Buddha image, or a pagoda containing holy relics.

如是我聞：: 復於白月十五日設大供養， 一日一夜不食正念誦呪，
Furthermore, on the fifteenth day of a waxing moon, make a large offering and recite the mantra mindfully without eating food for one day and one night.

如是我聞：: 乃至得見金剛手菩薩， 而彼菩薩即將是人往於自宮。
You will even be able to see Vajrapāṇi Bodhisattva, and he can take you to his palace.

如是我聞：: 「復次有法， 若於轉法輪塔前、或佛生處塔前、或從忉利天下寶階塔前、或舍利塔前，
“Another dharma is to go to the pagoda where the Buddha first turned the Dharma wheel, the pagoda at the Buddha's birthplace, or the pagoda where the Buddha descended the jeweled steps from Trayastriṁśa Heaven, or a pagoda containing holy relics.

如是我聞：: 於如是等諸塔之前誦呪右遶， 即見阿鉢羅是多菩薩及訶利底菩薩，
If you recite the mantra as you circle the pagoda clockwise, then you should see Aparājitā Bodhisattva and Hāritī Bodhisattva.

如是我聞：: 隨其所願皆悉滿足， 若須仙藥即便授之， 復為說法示菩薩道。
They can grant your wishes, give you divine medicine if you need it, and show you the Bodhisattva Way by teaching you the Dharma.

如是我聞：: 若有誦此陀羅尼者， 乃至未坐道場， 一切菩薩常為善友。
Whoever recites this dhāraṇī, though he is not yet in a bodhimaṇḍa, will have all Bodhisattvas as his beneficent friends.

如是我聞：: 又此准提大陀羅尼大明呪法， 過去一切諸佛已說、未來一切諸佛當說、現在一切諸佛今說，
“Moreover, this Great Cundī Dhāraṇī, the great illumination mantra, was pronounced by all Buddhas of the past, will be pronounced by all Buddhas of the future, and is pronounced by all Buddhas of the present.

如是我聞：: 我今亦如是說， 為利益一切眾生故、令得無上菩提故。
I too now pronounce it for the benefit of all sentient beings, helping them to attain the unsurpassed bodhi.

如是我聞：: 若有薄福眾生， 無少善根者、無有根器之者、無有菩提分法者，
