If one seeks that of which I have spoken, one must fix one’s mind upon this original vow.

如是我聞：: 向寶壇前作契印念誦。
Standing before and facing the precious platform, form [the following] mudrā and recite [the above mantra].

如是我聞：: 屈左中指無名指， 以大母指押彼二指甲， 舒頭指及小指安心上，
Bend the middle finger and ring finger of the left hand, and with the thumb press these two fingernails [against the palm]. Extend the forefinger and pinky finger and place [the hand] upon the heart.

如是我聞：: 右手把數珠念真言，
With the right hand [count] the recitations of the mantra with a rosary.

如是我聞：: 此名玉環成就一切所願印。
This is called the Jade-Bracelet-All-Vow-Fulfilling mudrā.

如是我聞：: 此契印， 末代愚學之妄， 不可記於文字。
In the age of the Final [Dharma], ignorant [people] of shallow learning will be unable to record this mudrā in written words.

如是我聞：: 萬人中撰十人， 十人之中撰一人， 許可(矣)。
Among ten thousand people ten will be chosen, and among ten people one will be chosen and permitted [to receive the transmission of this teaching].

如是我聞：: 爾時訶利帝藥叉女在佛眾會，
At that time the yakṣiṇī Hārītī, who was in the assembly of the Buddha, rose from her seat.

如是我聞：: 從座而起， 五體投地禮佛雙足，
She went down on the ground on her hands and knees and placed her head at the feet of the Buddha.

如是我聞：: 而白佛言： 「我有心真言， 由如真多摩尼寶能滿一切意願。
Then she addressed the Buddha, saying: “I have a heart (hṛdaya) mantra which, like a cintāmaṇi jewel, can satisfy all wishes.

如是我聞：: 為利益安樂閻浮提諸善男子及善女人， 唯願世尊哀愍聽許， 我今說之。
In order to bring benefit and happiness to all the good sons and daughters of Jambudvīpa, I only ask that the World Honored One will show me compassion and allow me to recite it right now”.

如是我聞：: 「真言曰： 「唵弩弩麼(引)里迦(引)呬帝娑嚩(二合引)訶(引)」「若有女人不宜男女， 或在胎中墮落斷緒不收， 皆由四大不不能調適、或被鬼神作諸障難、或是宿業因緣不宜男女， 應取白㲲或一肘或一搩手或長五寸隨意大小，
The mantra goes like this: oṃ nunu mālikā siddhi svāhā If there is a woman who is not suited for child bearing, or if she has a miscarriage followed by remittent bleeding, all because the four elements (earth, water, wind, fire) are not suitable for bearing children and cannot be balanced, or owing to all sorts of obstacles caused by demons, or because of past karma, such that she cannot bear children, she should obtain a piece of white cotton either the length of a forearm, or one hand span, or 5 cun long, whichever size is preferred.

如是我聞：: 畫訶利帝母， 作天女形， 純金色， 身著天衣， 頭冠瓔珞，
Paint mother Hārītī in the form of a goddess in color of pure gold, her body covered in celestial garments, and her head crowned with jewelry, sitting on a jeweled throne with both legs pendant.

如是我聞：: 坐宣臺上垂下兩足。 於垂足兩邊畫二孩子，
By the sides of both pendant legs paint two children, standing by the jeweled throne, with one sitting on each knee.

如是我聞：: 傍宣臺立。 於二膝上各坐一孩子， 以左手懷中抱一孩子， 於右手中持吉祥菓。
With her left arm she holds an infant at her bosom, on her right hand she holds an auspicious fruit.

如是我聞：: 畫師應受八戒， 其彩色中不用皮膠。
The painter must undertake the eight precepts and cannot use glue made from leather in his colors.

如是我聞：: 畫像成已， 淨治一室嚴儀塗拭， 以香塗作一方壇，
When the painting is finished the [adept should] purify a room. Adorn the room by applying fragrant mud.

如是我聞：: 置像壇中，
Then make a square altar and place the image at the center.

如是我聞：: 以種種華散於壇上。
Scatter all kinds of flowers on the altar.

如是我聞：: 復以甘脆飲食、乳糜酪飯及諸菓子、閼伽香水， 燒沈水香而用供養。
Then make offerings of tasty food and drinks, milk porridge, curd rice, all kinds of fruit and arghya water, and by burning fragrant aloeswood.

如是我聞：: 像面向西， 持誦者面東，
The face of the image looks west, and the reciter faces east.

如是我聞：: 對像念誦， 每日三時， 時別誦一千遍。
Facing the image, chant [the mantra] one thousand times each at morning, at noon, and at night.

如是我聞：: 取月生五日起首，
Begin on the fifth day after a new moon.

如是我聞：: 先誦十萬遍， 然後對像前念誦，
First chant a hundred thousand times, afterwards chant facing the image.

如是我聞：: 所求一切事皆悉圓滿。
Everything that she asks for will be granted.

如是我聞：: 「又法女人欲得男女者，
Another method for women wishing to bear children.

如是我聞：: 月經後澡浴，
After menstruation she must bathe.

如是我聞：: 取黃乳牛母子同色者， 搆乳一升置銀器中。
Taking a yellow milking cow that has given birth to a calf of the same color, milk it, take one sheng [of milk] and put it in a silver bowl.

如是我聞：: 以右手無名指攪乳，
Then stir the milk with the ring finger of the right hand.

如是我聞：: 誦真言加持一千八十遍，
Chant the mantra a thousand and eighty times to empower the milk.

如是我聞：: 然後取服，
Then drink it.

如是我聞：: 至七日內則得有胎。
Within seven days she will conceive.

如是我聞：: 「又法欲令他人歡喜敬愛者，
Another method for obtaining the affection, respect and love of another.

如是我聞：: 或飲食菓子或華或香加持一百八遍，
Acquire food, drinks, fruit, or flowers, or incense. Empower them a hundred and eight times.

如是我聞：: 於真言句中加彼人名，
Add the name of the person in the mantra.

如是我聞：: 將與彼人， 則得歡喜愛敬。
Then offer [these items] to this person and one will succeed in receiving affection, respect and love.

如是我聞：: 「又法若有人作留難口舌者，
Another method if someone is creating difficulties through spreading rumors.

如是我聞：: 畫彼人形， 左脚踏之，
Draw an image of this person and stamp on it with the left foot.

如是我聞：: 誦真言一千八十遍則得無難。
Chant the mantra a thousand and eighty times and one shall be without difficulties.

如是我聞：: 「又法欲令一切人歡喜者，
Another method for those wishing to gain all beings' affection.

如是我聞：: 取牛黃末置銀器中，
Obtain bezoar powder and put it in a silver bowl.

如是我聞：: 准前以無名指攪， 誦真言加持一百八遍，
In the previous manner, stir it with the ring finger and recite the mantra empowering it a hundred and eight times.

如是我聞：: 點於額上， 一切人見皆歡喜順伏。
Make a mark on your forehead [with the powder] and all people who will see it will adore you and be enchanted by you.

如是我聞：: 「又法若得新衣服，
Another method for those who have new clothes.

如是我聞：: 對像前加持一百八遍， 然後取著，
Empower the clothing by reciting the mantra a hundred and eight times facing the image.

如是我聞：: 一切人見亦皆歡喜敬愛。
Then put them on and all who see you will show affection, love and respect for you.

如是我聞：: 「又法若有惡夢，
Another method for nightmares.

如是我聞：: 誦真言一百八遍， 則得惡夢消除。
Chant the mantra a hundred and eight times and all nightmares will disappear.

如是我聞：: 「又法若月蝕時，
Another method when there is a lunar eclipse.

如是我聞：: 取酥五兩置金器中，
Take five liang (ounces) of ghee and place it in a (gold) bowl.

如是我聞：: 以金筯攪，
Stir it with gold chopsticks.

如是我聞：: 無令間斷念誦加持， 乃至月却得圓滿為限。
Then recite the mantra and empower it continuously without any interruption until the eclipsed moon completely reappears.

如是我聞：: 然後取一分供養訶利帝母，
Take part of it and offer it to mother Hārītī.

如是我聞：: 餘者漸喫，
Then slowly drink the remaining liquid.

如是我聞：: 即有胎孕，
She will then conceive.

如是我聞：: 所生男女聰慧福德。
She will give birth to an intelligent and virtuous boy or girl.

如是我聞：: 又法取牛膝根作齒木，
Another method: employ a stick for cleaning the teeth made of ox-knee root.

如是我聞：: 加持一百八遍嚼及揩齒，
Empower it a hundred and eight times and chew the root wiping it on the teeth.

如是我聞：: 所出言詞令人樂聞，
Whatever you say, people will like to hear it.

如是我聞：: 意欲所求他人之事皆得隨意成就。
Everything you wish for in relation to other people will be granted as you desire.

如是我聞：: 又法欲得壽命長遠者，
Another method for those wishing to obtain a long life.

如是我聞：: 取骨屢草嫩苗搵蘇蜜酪護摩七夜，
Take tender sprouts of gulü grass, mix with ghee, honey and curd, and use them in a homa ritual for seven nights.

如是我聞：: 夜別誦真言一千八遍，
Every night chant the mantra a thousand and eighty times.

如是我聞：: 一遍一擲火中則長壽。
Every time toss some of the offering in the fire and you shall obtain longevity.

如是我聞：: 「又法欲得所為所作隨意成就者，
Another method for those wishing for success in all of their undertakings.

如是我聞：: 每月月生五日二十日， 塗拭道場散華， 種種飲食乳糜酪飯及諸菓子、閼伽香水， 燒沈香薰陸以用供養。
Every month on the fifth and twentieth days after a new moon, smear fragrant mud in a sacred space and scatter flowers, all sorts of food and drinks, milk porridge, curd rice, all kinds of fruit and arghya water, burn aloeswood, and resin of frankincense as offerings.

如是我聞：: 先供養一切如來、文殊師利菩薩、普賢等一切菩薩，
First make offerings to all Tathāgatas, the bodhisattvas Mañjuśrī, Samantabhadra and all other bodhisattvas.

如是我聞：: 然後供養我訶利帝母。
Then make offerings to me, mother Hārītī.

如是我聞：: 何以故？
Why?

如是我聞：: 我本藥叉女， 如來授與我三歸五戒菩提心律儀戒，
Because originally I was a yakṣiṇī, and the Tathāgata conferred upon me the three refuges, the five precepts, and the bodhisattva precepts.

如是我聞：: 對諸十地菩薩故， 是先供養諸佛菩薩。
In the presence of all bodhisattvas on the ten stages, first make offerings to all Buddhas and bodhisattvas.

如是我聞：: 供養已， 對此像前誦一萬遍，
When the offerings are finished, chant [the mantra] ten thousand times in facing this image.

如是我聞：: 所求事業皆得滿足。
All undertakings will be successful.

如是我聞：: 「訶利帝母念誦法。
These are the methods to chant the mantra of Mother Hārītī.

如是我聞：: 「愛子心真言曰： 「唵知(上)尾知(上)𩕳娑嚩(二合引)訶」「印， 合掌屈二大拇指入掌中，
The mudrā: press the hands together and bend the two thumbs into the center of the palms.

如是我聞：: 誦心真言供養訖， 於頂上放二大拇指即散去。
When the recitation of the heart mantra and the offerings are finished, place the two thumbs above the head and then separate [the mudrā].

如是我聞：: 請召、發遣皆放此印。
This mudrā is for summoning and dispatching.

如是我聞：: 以白檀香橫量六指作童子形， 具足兩手， 各把菓子與人，
With white sandalwood six fingerbreadths wide, sculpt the image of the boy with two hands, each holding fruits that he offers to people.

如是我聞：: 頭上作三髻角子。
He has three topknots on his head.

如是我聞：: 於閑淨處安置，
Place the image in an empty and quiet place.

如是我聞：: 誦真言萬遍，
Recite the mantra ten thousand times.

如是我聞：: 即現身問言： 『喚我何事？ 』隨心答之。
Then he [Priyaṇkara] will manifest his form and ask: “Why did you summon me?” Answer him according to your wishes.

如是我聞：: 取黃牛肉方寸，
Take the meat of a yellow cow of one square cun.

如是我聞：: 一加持一燒， 日三時，
Empower once and cook it once, every day three times: at morning, at noon, and at night.

如是我聞：: 滿四日得大自在隨意。
On the fourth day one will obtain great power according to one's desires.

如是我聞：: 「又法牛肉、安悉香為丸，
Another method: take some beef and Parthian incense and make pills.

如是我聞：: 月八日三時念誦，
On the eighth day of the month recite the mantra in morning, at noon, and at night.

如是我聞：: 燒上香一八遍。 至十日已，
Burn them and [offer] this fragrance one thousand and eight times up until the tenth day.

如是我聞：: 夜半現大光相， 得大神力。
A great light will manifest in the middle of the night and you will obtain great divine strength.

如是我聞：: 安悉香為丸， 一加持一燒， 日三時，
The pills made with Parthian incense should be empowered once and cooked once, once each in the morning, at noon, and at night.

如是我聞：: 時別一千八遍， 五日調伏一切人。
Every time do it one thousand and eight times for five days and you will subdue all people.

如是我聞：: 「又法百草花一一加持散身上，
Another method: obtain a hundred grasses and flowers, empower each of them, scatter them on your body.

如是我聞：: 得千人衣食。
You will obtain the clothing and food of a thousand people.

如是我聞：: 「又法日誦真言燒蘇合香七日，
Another method: recite the mantra daily and burn turuṣka for seven days.

如是我聞：: 見地下金藏。
Then you will see a cache of gold hidden underground.

如是我聞：: 以種種花菓飲食壇中供養， 日日如是， 得一切財寶。
Offer all kinds of flowers, fruit, food and drinks on the altar every day in this way, and you will obtain all treasures.

如是我聞：: 「又法安悉和乳粥， 一加持一燒七日， 日三時，
Another method: take some Parthian incense and milk porridge, empower and cook it fresh each time for seven days in the morning, at noon, and at night.

如是我聞：: 時別一千八遍，
Each time say the mantra a thousand and eight times.

如是我聞：: 現身共語供意問。
Priyaṅkara will then reveal himself. He will talk to you. Ask him anything you want.

如是我聞：: 「又法被禁閉， 誦一萬遍即解脫。
Another method: if somebody is imprisoned, recite the mantra ten thousand times and that person will be released.

如是我聞：: 治病， 加持菴羅菓，
To heal an illness, empower amala sprouts.

如是我聞：: 芽乳中漬燒加持，
Boil them in milk and empower [the concoction].

如是我聞：: 除一切病。
This eliminates all diseases.

如是我聞：: 爾時那羅延天在於香醉山頂，
At that time the god Nārāyaṇa was on the summit of Mount Gandhamādana.

如是我聞：: 請魔醯首羅於自在宮中供養， 頭面禮足， 白魔醯首羅言： 「我所乘迦樓羅使者， 能成辦世間所求事要，
He made a request of Maheśvara in Īśvara’s palace, making offerings, bowing down at his feet, and saying to Maheśvara, ‘The messenger Garuḍa whom I ride is able to accomplish things sought by worldlings but is unable to do so quickly.

如是我聞：: 且不能速疾。 唯願大天為未來有情說速疾立驗阿尾奢法。 」時魔醯首羅告那羅延言： 「汝當諦聽， 我為汝宣說速疾成辦使者之法，
I but beg you, O Great God (Mahādeva), to explain for future sentient beings the āveśa rite which swiftly establishes its efficacy.’ Thereupon Maheśvara addressed Nārāyaṇa, saying, ‘You should listen attentively as I expound for you the messenger’s rite of swift accomplishment.

如是我聞：: 能作息災、增益、降伏、敬愛，
One is able to perform [thereby the rites for] the cessation of calamities (śāntika), the increase of benefits (pauṣṭika), subjugation (abhicāraka), and [the gaining of] respect and love (vaśīkaraṇa).

如是我聞：: 亦能於夜摩界往來使役， 能知未來善惡吉凶成敗， 旱澇不調、隣國侵擾、惡人叛亂種種災祥。
Again, one can send [the messenger] to and from the realm of Yama and is able to know of future good and evil, fortune and misfortune, success and failure, irregularities in droughts and floods, aggression by neighbouring countries, rebellions by wicked persons, and various favourable and unfavourable omens.

如是我聞：: 若欲知未來事者， 當簡擇四五童男或童女， 可年七八歲， 身上無瘢痕記， 聰慧靈利，
‘If you wish to know future events, you should select four or five (virgin) boys or (virgin) girls, seven or eight years of age, their bodies free of scars and moles, and intelligent and astute.

如是我聞：: 先令一七日服素食或三日食。
First, make them eat plain [vegetarian] food for seven days or alternatively for three days.

如是我聞：: 凡欲作法， 要須吉日或鬼宿或歲宿直， 甘露直直日最勝。
‘Whenever you wish to perform the rite, you should do so on an auspicious day, governed either by the lunar mansion Ghost (Puṣya) or the lunar mansion Year; best of all is a day governed by nectar [days].

如是我聞：: 沐浴遍身塗香， 著淨衣， 口含龍腦、豆䓻。
Bathe [the children], rub unguent all over their bodies, dress them in clean clothes, and have them hold in their mouths camphor and cardamom.

如是我聞：: 持誦者面向東坐，
‘The incantator sits facing east.

如是我聞：: 身前以白檀香塗一小壇， 可一肘量，
In front of him he smears a small altar, about one cubit in size, with white sandalwood paste.

如是我聞：: 令童女等立於壇上， 散花於童女前。 置一閼伽爐，
He has [one of] the girls and [boys] stand on the altar, scatters flowers in front of the girl, and sets down a vessel of argha (water).

如是我聞：: 取安息香以大印真言加持七遍， 燒令童女熏手。
Taking some Parthian incense (benzoin), he empowers it seven times with the mantra of the great seal (mahāmudrā), lights it, and has the girl fumigate her hands with it.

如是我聞：: 又取赤花加持七遍， 安童女掌中， 便以手掩面。
Then he takes some red flowers, empowers them seven times, and places them in the girl’s palms, whereupon she covers her face with her hands.

如是我聞：: 則持誦者結大印， 二手合掌外相交左押右， 虛其掌即成。
The incantator then binds the great seal: it is formed by clasping the two hands together [with the fingers] interlocking on the outside, the left pressing against the right, and leaving the palm hollow.

如是我聞：: 以此印加持自身五處， 所謂額、右肩、左肩、心、喉，
With this seal he empowers five places on his own person, namely, the forehead, right shoulder, left shoulder, heart, and throat.

如是我聞：: 頂上散印， 即誦真言曰： 「曩謨婆誐嚩底摩賀(引)母捺㘈(二合)迦吒攞施棄底哩(二合)施[＊]㘈底哩(二合)路左儞伊捨(引)儞跛輸跛帝娑嚩(二合引)賀(引)」「則以此印按其童女頂， 則想於頭上三角赤色熾盛火輪光， 誦真言七遍。
He disperses the seal on the crown of his head and then recites [this] mantra: namo bhagavati mahāmudre kaṭalaśikhe triśire trilocani īśāni paśupate svāhā ‘Then he rests this seal on the crown of the girl’s head and visualizes on top of her head the radiance of a blazing circle of fire (agnimaṇḍala), triangular and red in colour, and recites the mantra seven times.

如是我聞：: 火輪真言曰： 「唵阿儗儞(二合)施棄娑嚩(二合引)賀」「則以此印按童女口上， 於彼口中想水輪， 白色半月形， 誦真言七遍。
The fire circle mantra is: oṁ agni śikhe svāhā ‘Then he rests this seal on the girl’s mouth and visualizes inside her mouth a circle of water (vārimaṇḍala), white in colour and shaped like a halfmoon, and recites the mantra seven times.

如是我聞：: 真言曰： 「唵惹攞祖哩(二合)拏(引)摩抳娑嚩(二合引)賀」「次應移印按彼心中， 想地輪， 形方黃色， 誦七遍真言曰：
The mantra is: oṁ jala cūḍāmaṇi svāhā ‘Next, he should move the seal and rest it on her heart, visualizing a circle of earth (pṛthivīmaṇḍala), square in shape and yellow in colour, and reciting [the mantra] seven times.

如是我聞：: 「唵摩賀麼攞跛囉訖囉(二合)摩娑嚩(二合引)賀」「次應移印按彼臍中， 想風輪， 其形圓黑色， 誦七遍真言曰： 「唵尾曩多(引)句攞曩那娑嚩(二合引)賀(引)」「次應以大印加持彼兩脚，
The mantra is: oṁ mahābala parākrama svāhā ‘Next, he should move the seal and rest it on her navel, visualizing a circle of wind (vāyumaṇḍala), circular in shape and black in colour, and reciting [the mantra] seven times.

如是我聞：: 想迦樓羅， 誦真言曰： 「唵跛乞史(二合)囉(引)惹跛那娑嚩(二合引)賀(引)」「次應以大印， 誦甲冑真言， 加持童女， 遍身旋轉。

Then he should face the girl and recite the mantra of Maheśvara’s messenger: ḷ[ṁ] ceṭaka matanāga viṣada[r]paṇa samānagara vikramavilāsagati ḷ[ṁ] ceṭaka pratipātraṃ cala cala cali cali paṇa paṇa paṇi paṇi panni panni kaṭṭi kaṭṭi āviśa āviśa ḷ[ṁ] ceṭaka rudro ‘jñāpayati svāhā ‘He should recite this mantra seven times, whereupon the girl will tremble.

如是我聞：: 當知聖者入身，

Then he further snaps his fingers and recites the mantra [again].

如是我聞：: 則言龍宮中取長年藥、如意寶珠， 或使夜摩王處延命增益壽命， 或使上取妙甘露， 或使他國問其善惡，
Then tell him to fetch the elixir of longevity or wishfulfilling gem from the dragon palace, or dispatch him to the place of King Yama to prolong your life and increase your life span, or dispatch him [to heaven] above to fetch wondrous nectar, or dispatch him to other countries to inquire about their good and bad points.

如是我聞：: 亦能助軍陣摧破他敵，
He can also help an army to destroy its enemies.

如是我聞：: 種種使用悉能成辦。
Employ him in various ways, and he will be able to accomplish everything.

如是我聞：: 此法一切迦樓羅法中最殊勝， 祕密難得。
‘This rite is the most excellent among all Garuḍa rites, secret and difficult to obtain.

如是我聞：: 女人欲求男子者， 皆當悔過。
If women wish to be reborn in male form, they should repent of their sins.

如是我聞：: 欲得須陀洹道不復入泥犁薜荔中者， 皆當悔過。
‘Those who wish to enter the holy stream, becoming Srotāpannas and never becoming hell-dwellers, hungry ghosts [or animals], should repent of their sins.

如是我聞：: 欲得斯陀含道上天作人、欲得阿那含道上二十四天、欲得阿羅漢泥洹去者， 欲於世間得阿羅漢道者、欲得辟支佛道者、欲知去來之事者， 皆當悔過， 不當覆藏。 」佛語舍利弗：
Those who wish to become Sakṛdāgāmins and be reborn in a heaven, to become Anāgāmins and be reborn in one of the twenty-four heavens, to become Arhats and enter parinirvāṇa, to abide in the world as Arhats or Pratyekabuddhas, or to know past and future events, should all repent of their sins and should not conceal them.’ The Buddha told Śāriputra, ‘Good men and good women should, during the three periods of the day, make obeisance to present Buddhas [in worlds] in the ten directions, who give the right teachings to all under the sun and the moon, enabling them to do good.

如是我聞：: 「若有善男子、善女人， 各當日三稽首， 為十方現在諸佛作禮。 十方諸佛皆以中正迴教天下人， 日月所照人民使作善。 佛以經道雨於天下， 譬如天雨百穀草木皆茂好。
By analogy, the sky pours down rains for grains, grasses, and trees to flourish.

如是我聞：: 佛以經道雨於天下， 故生侯王、四天王， 上至三十三天上豪貴富樂。
Similarly, Buddhas give teachings in sūtras to enable all to do good, to be reborn as human kings, the four god-kings, or gods in Trayastriṁśa Heaven, and to enjoy wealth and pleasures as requital.

如是我聞：: 佛生須陀洹、斯陀含、阿那含、阿羅漢者，
Buddhas also enable voice-hearers to become Srotāpannas, Sakṛdāgāmins, Anāgāmins, or Arhats.

如是我聞：: 願十方諸佛聽某等所言： 『天下人民蜎飛蠕動之類所作好惡， 若布施者、若持道勤力不毀經戒者、若慈心念人民者、若作善無量者、若施於菩薩及諸比丘僧者、若施凡夫及貧窮者、下至禽獸慈哀者， 某等勸其作善助其歡喜。
‘[Good men and good women] should pray that Buddhas [in worlds] in the ten directions hear their words: 'For sentient beings in the world that do good, including people and flying or wriggly insects, whether they give alms, train diligently for bodhi, observe the precepts, remember others with lovingkindness, do innumerable good deeds, make offerings to Bodhisattvas and bhikṣus, or give charity to ordinary beings and the poor, and even to animals in distress, I persuade them to do good, and I express my sympathetic joy.

如是我聞：: 諸過去佛所可過度人民得泥洹者，
For those who have been taught by past Buddhas to attain nirvāṇa, I express my sympathetic joy.

如是我聞：: 某等皆助其歡喜。 諸當來佛教人作善、遠離五惡生死之道， 至令得阿羅漢辟支佛道者， 某等皆助某等勸樂，
For those who will be taught by future Buddhas to do good, to end the five evils on the path of birth and death, and even to become Arhats or Pratyekabuddhas, I persuade them to do good, and I express my sympathetic joy.

如是我聞：: 使作善令如佛。 今十方現在諸佛所當過度者， 教人布施不犯經戒、慈哀人民蜎飛蠕動之類者，
For those who are taught by present Buddhas [in worlds] in the ten directions to give alms, to observe the precepts, and to have compassion for people and even for flying or wriggly insects, I persuade them to do good, and I express my sympathetic joy.

如是我聞：: 皆令脫於泥犁、禽獸、薜荔、愚癡貧窮， 至令得須陀洹、斯陀含、阿那含、阿羅漢、辟支佛泥洹道， 某等皆勸樂使作善助其歡喜。 諸過去菩薩未成佛者， 奉行六波羅蜜所作善， 行檀波羅蜜布施、行尸波羅蜜不犯道禁、行羼提波羅蜜忍辱、行精進波羅蜜精進、行禪波羅蜜一心、行般若波羅蜜智慧， 成六波羅蜜。 諸過去若菩薩奉行六波羅蜜，
‘'For Bodhisattvas who, in the past, have given alms in practicing dāna-pāramitā, observed precepts in practicing śīla-pāramitā, endured adversity in practicing kṣānti-pāramitā, made energetic progress in practicing vīrya-pāramitā, meditated single-mindedly in practicing dhyāna-pāramitā, and developed wisdom in practicing prajñā-pāramitā, I persuade them to rejoice over their practice of the six pāramitās, and I express my sympathetic joy.

如是我聞：: 某等勸樂助其歡喜。 諸當來菩薩奉行六波羅蜜者， 某等勸樂助其歡喜。
For Bodhisattvas who, in the future, will practice the six pāramitās, I persuade them to rejoice, and I express my sympathetic joy.

如是我聞：: 今現在菩薩奉行六波羅蜜者， 某等勸樂助其歡喜。
For Bodhisattvas who presently practice the six pāramitās, I persuade them to rejoice, and I express my sympathetic joy.

如是我聞：: 某等諸所得福， 皆布施天下十方人民父母、蜎飛蠕動之類、兩足之類、四足之類、多足之類， 皆令得佛。
‘'I give away the merits I have acquired, as alms, to all sentient beings [in worlds] in the ten directions, including people, who have been my parents [throughout my rebirths], and including flying or wriggly insects with two, four, or multiple feet, enabling them all to have the good fortune to become Buddhas or Pratyekabuddhas.

如是我聞：: 』福得辟支人、持四大城金銀寶物持用布施， 百倍千倍萬倍億倍。
Transferring my merits to them is a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand, and a koṭi times greater than giving them, as alms, treasures, such as gold and silver, that fill up four big cities.

如是我聞：: 」佛語舍利弗： 「若有善男子、善女人， 當晝夜各當三過稽首， 為十方佛拜言： 『願聽某等所言。
'‘ The Buddha told Śāriputra, ‘Good men and good women should, day and night in the six periods, make obeisance to Buddhas [in worlds] in the ten directions and say, 'I pray that They hear my words.

如是我聞：: 十方佛已得佛不說經， 今某等勸勉， 使為諸天人民、蜎飛蠕動之類說經， 使脫於泥犁、禽獸、薜荔、愚癡貧窮， 至令得泥洹道。
If Buddhas [in worlds] in the ten directions do not wish to pronounce sūtras, I request them to pronounce sūtras to gods, humans, and even flying or wriggly insects, liberating them all from the life-paths of hell-dwellers, animals, and hungry ghosts, and from stupidity and poverty, and enabling them to attain nirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 諸十方欲般泥洹者， 某等願從求哀且莫般泥洹， 當令諸天人民、蜎飛蠕動之類得其福， 皆令得脫於泥犁、薜荔。
If Buddhas [in worlds] in the ten directions wish to enter parinirvāṇa, I beseech them not to enter parinirvāṇa, but to give benefits to gods, humans, and even flying or wriggly insects, enabling them all to avoid the life-paths of hell-dwellers, animals, and hungry ghosts.

如是我聞：: 』」佛語舍利弗： 「某等宿命為菩薩時， 某等當勸樂諸佛說經， 且莫般泥洹。
'‘ The Buddha told Śāriputra, ‘In my past lives, when I was a Bodhisattva, I always beseeched Buddhas not to enter parinirvāṇa, but to pronounce sūtras.

如是我聞：: 用是故某等為佛。
Therefore, I became a Buddha.

如是我聞：: 第一四天王、第二天王釋來下，
Then the four god-kings of the first desire heaven and the god-king Śakra of the second desire heaven, together with innumerable gods, came down [from their heavens].

如是我聞：: 叉手作禮求哀， 守我諸天人民說經。 無數諸天曉我， 且莫般泥洹。 」佛語舍利弗言：
They joined their palms, made obeisance, and beseeched me not to enter parinirvāṇa, but to pronounce sūtras to gods and humans.’ The Buddha told Śāriputra, ‘People reap what they sow.

如是我聞：: 「如是人民種種各得其類， 作善自得其福、作惡自得其殃。 」舍利弗白佛言： 「若有善男子、善女人， 欲求佛道者， 當何以願為得之？
While those who do good receive good fortune, those who do evil receive misfortune.’ Śāriputra asked the Buddha, ‘If good men and good women aspire to seek Buddha bodhi, how should they pray to attain it?’ The Buddha replied, ‘Good men and good women should, day and night in the six periods, make obeisance to Buddhas [in worlds] in the ten directions and say, 'I pray that Buddhas [in worlds] in the ten directions hear my words.

如是我聞：: 」佛言： 「若有善男子、善女人， 當晝夜各三稽首， 為十方佛拜言： 『願十方諸佛聽。 某等宿命從無數劫以來所作得福， 若布施、若持經道、若持善意、為佛作善、為經作善、為比丘僧作善、為凡人作善、若為禽獸作善作惡自得其殃，
I have acquired merits from my good deeds in my past lives in innumerable kalpas, whether I have given alms, upheld the sūtras, held goodwill, or done good for the Buddha, for the Dharma, for the Saṅgha, for ordinary beings, or for animals.

如是我聞：: 作善自得其福、為惡自悔。
Knowing that one receives misfortune from one's evil and good fortune from one's good, I repent of my evil.

如是我聞：: 持經戒不毀， 若受戒不與女人通， 若勸樂諸佛菩薩萬民作善， 若勸勉諸佛且莫般泥洹。
I uphold the sūtras and the precepts without violation, whether I observe the precept against being intimate with women, whether I request Buddhas and Bodhisattvas to benefit the multitudes, whether I beseech Buddhas not to enter parinirvāṇa.

如是我聞：: 某等取諸學道以來所得福德， 皆集聚合會， 以持好心施與天下十方人民父母、蜎飛蠕動之類， 皆令得其福。 有餘少所令某得之，
I gather all the merits I have acquired since I began to learn the Dharma, and with lovingkindness give them away, as alms, to all sentient beings, including people, who have been my parents [throughout my rebirths], and even flying or wriggly insects, enabling them all to receive good fortune.

如是我聞：: 令某等作佛道行佛經， 諸未度者某當度之， 諸未脫者某等當脫之， 諸未得泥洹者某等當令得泥洹。
I will keep a small leftover part to enable me to carry out the teachings in the sūtras, delivering those who have not been delivered, liberating those who have not been liberated, and enabling those who have not attained nirvāṇa to attain it.

如是我聞：: 』」佛語舍利弗言： 「使天下男子女人皆為得阿羅漢、辟支佛。
'‘ The Buddha told Śāriputra, ‘Suppose all men and women in the world have become Arhats or Pratyekabuddhas.

如是我聞：: 若有人供養天下阿羅漢、辟支佛千歲，
Suppose someone makes offerings to these Arhats and Pratyekabuddhas for one thousand years.

如是我聞：: 其福寧多不？ 」舍利弗言： 「但供養一阿羅漢辟支佛一日， 其福無量， 何況舉天下阿羅漢辟支佛千歲乎？
Is his merit not great?’ Śāriputra answered, ‘The merit acquired from making offerings to even one Arhat or Pratyekabuddha for one day is immeasurable, much more the merit acquired from making offerings to all Arhats and Pratyekabuddhas in the world for one thousand years.’ The Buddha said, ‘Making offerings to all Arhats and Pratyekabuddhas in the world for one thousand years cannot compare with reading this repentance sūtra for one day and one night in the six periods.

如是我聞：: 」佛言： 「其供養天下阿羅漢辟支佛千歲， 不如持悔過經晝夜各三過讀一日， 其得福勝供養天下阿羅漢、辟支佛， 百倍千倍萬倍億倍。 」
The merit acquired from reading this repentance sūtra is a hundred, a thousand, ten thousand, and a koṭi times greater than that from making offerings to all Arhats and Pratyekabuddhas in the world.’

如是我聞：: 說曰： 今當略解摩訶衍義。
Nagarjuna says: Now I shall briefly explain the teachings of Mahāyāna.

如是我聞：: 問曰： 解摩訶衍者， 有何義利？
Question: What are the benefits of explaining Mahāyāna?

如是我聞：: 答曰： 摩訶衍者， 是十方三世諸佛甚深法藏，
Answer: Mahāyāna is the profound dharma-store of the buddhas in the ten directions of space and the three periods of time.

如是我聞：: 為大功德利根者說。
It is spoken for the people of great virtue and intelligence.

如是我聞：: 末世眾生薄福鈍根，
[But] the sentient beings of late times are hardly virtuous and talented.

如是我聞：: 雖尋經文不能通達。
Although they seek [and study] the sutra, they cannot understand.

如是我聞：: 我愍此等欲令開悟，
I sympathize with these people and want to enlighten them.

如是我聞：: 又欲光闡如來無上大法，
And also I want to reveal and make clear the supremely great teachings of the Tathagata.

如是我聞：: 是故略解摩訶衍義。
Therefore, I will briefly explain the teachings of Mahāyāna.

如是我聞：: 問曰： 摩訶衍無量無邊不可稱數，
Question: Mahāyāna teachings are too many to be counted.

如是我聞：: 直是佛語尚不可盡，
Even the sayings of the Buddha alone cannot be exhausted.

如是我聞：: 況復解釋演散其義？
How can you explain and expound them [all]?

如是我聞：: 答曰： 以是義故， 我初言略解。
Answer: Because of this, I said at the beginning [this would be] a brief explanation.

如是我聞：: 問曰： 「何故名為摩訶衍？
Question: Why is it called Mahāyāna?

如是我聞：: 答曰： 摩訶衍者， 於二乘為上， 故名大乘；
Answer: Mahāyāna is the superior of the two vehicles, and hence is called the Great Vehicle.

如是我聞：: 諸佛最大， 是乘能至， 故名為大；
This vehicle can [help people] reach the ideal of the buddhas, and hence is called great.

如是我聞：: 諸佛大人乘是乘故， 故名為大；
This is the vehicle which is ridden by buddhas and great men, and hence is called great.

如是我聞：: 又能滅除眾生大苦、與大利益事， 故名為大；
It can eliminate the great sufferings of sentient beings and give great benefits, and hence is called great.

如是我聞：: 又觀世音、得大勢、文殊師利、彌勒菩薩等， 是諸大士之所乘故， 故名為大；
It is the vehicle ridden by great persons such as bodhisattvas Avalokitesvara, Mahāsthāmaprāpta, Mañjuśrī and Maitreya, and hence is called great.

如是我聞：: 又以此乘能盡一切諸法邊底， 故名為大；
This vehicle can exhaust the bottom of all truths and hence is called great.

如是我聞：: 又如《般若經》中佛自說摩訶衍義無量無邊，
Again, in the prajñā-sūtra, the Buddha himself says that the teachings of Mahāyāna are immeasurable and boundless.

如是我聞：: 以是因緣， 故名為大。
For this reason it is called great.

如是我聞：: 大分深義， 所謂空也。
One of the profoundest teachings of Mahāyāna is called emptiness.

如是我聞：: 若能通達是義， 即通達大乘， 具足六波羅蜜，
If one can understand this doctrine, he can understand Mahāyāna and possess the six pāramitās without hindrance.

如是我聞：: 無所障礙， 是故我今但解釋空。
Therefore, I want only to explain emptiness.

如是我聞：: 解釋空者， 當以十二門入於空義。
To explain emptiness and enter into its meaning one should use the Twelve Gate [Treatise].

如是我聞：: 初是因緣門，
The first gate is concerned with causal conditions.

如是我聞：: 所謂： 眾緣所生法， 是即無自性；
It is said, Things are produced from various conditions, and hence have no self-nature.

如是我聞：: 若無自性者， 云何有是法？
If they have no self-nature, how can there be such things?

如是我聞：: 眾緣所生法有二種： 一者內， 二者外。
All things produced by various conditions are of two kinds, one internal and the other external.

如是我聞：: 眾緣亦有二種： 一者內， 二者外。
All conditions are also of two kinds, one internal and the other external.

如是我聞：: 外因緣者， 如泥團、輪繩、陶師等和合， 故有瓶生；
External causal conditions are, for example, clay, turning string and a craftsman; together they produce a jar.

如是我聞：: 又如縷繩、機杼、織師等和合，
As another example, a rug is produced from the causal conditions of yarn, a loom and a weaver.

如是我聞：: 故有疊生； 又如治地、築基梁、椽、泥、草、人功等和合， 故有舍生；
Similarly, site preparation, foundation, poles, wood, mud, grass and labor are examples of external causal conditions; together they produce a house.

如是我聞：: 又如酪器、鑽搖、人功等和合， 故有酥生；
Still other examples are milk, a curdling vat and labor; they are combined to produce cheese.

如是我聞：: 又如種子、地、水、火、風、虛空、時節、人功等和合， 故有芽生；
Again, seed, earth, water, sunshine, wind, air, seasons and labor are combined to produce the sprout.

如是我聞：: 當知外緣等法皆亦如是。
One should know that the so-called external causal conditions are all like these.

如是我聞：: 內因緣者， 所謂無明、行、識、名色、六入、觸、受、愛、取、有、生、老死， 各各先因而後生。
The so-called internal causal conditions are ignorance, action, consciousness, name-form, the six sense faculties, touch, feeling, desire, clinging, formation of being, birth and old age, death; each has a cause first and then is produced.

如是我聞：: 如是內外諸法皆從眾緣生，
Thus both internal and external things are produced by various conditions.

如是我聞：: 從眾緣生故， 即非是無性耶！
Since they are produced by various conditions, is it not true that they have no self-nature?

如是我聞：: 若法自性無， 他性亦無， 自他亦無。
Now if a thing has no self-nature, it cannot have other-nature nor both self-nature and other-nature.

如是我聞：: 何以故？
Why?

如是我聞：: 因他性故無自性。
Because the so-called other-nature has, in fact, no self-nature.

如是我聞：: 若謂以他性故有者， 則牛以馬性有， 馬以牛性有， 梨以柰性有， [＊]柰以梨性有，
If we say that something exists because of other-nature, then a cow exists because of horse nature; a horse exists because of cow nature; a peach exists because of apple nature; an apple exists because of peach nature, and so on.

如是我聞：: 餘皆應爾， 而實不然。
[They are all] really impossible.

如是我聞：: 若謂不以他性故有， 但因他故有者，
One might say that something exists not because of a certain other-nature, but because of a certain other.

如是我聞：: 是亦不然。
But this cannot be the case either.

如是我聞：: 何以故？
Why?

如是我聞：: 若以蒲故有席者， 則蒲、席一體， 不名為他；
If one says that a mat exists because of a certain grass, then the grass and the mat would be one body, and the grass could not be called other.

如是我聞：: 若謂蒲於席為他者， 不得言以蒲故有席。
If one says that the grass is other with respect to the mat, then he could not claim that the mat exists because of the grass.

如是我聞：: 又蒲亦無自性。
Moreover, the so-called grass has no self-nature either.

如是我聞：: 何以故？
Why?

如是我聞：: 蒲亦從眾緣出，
Because the grass is also produced from various conditions.

如是我聞：: 故無自性。 無自性故， 不得言以蒲性故有席，
Since grass has no self-nature, one cannot say that because of grass nature the mat exists.

如是我聞：: 是故席不應以蒲為體。
Therefore, the mat cannot have grass as its substance.

如是我聞：: 餘瓶、酥等外因緣生法， 皆亦如是不可得。
Thus, for the same reason the production of a jar, cheese and other things from external causal conditions cannot be established.

如是我聞：: 內因緣生法， 皆亦如是不可得，
Similarly, production by internal causal conditions cannot be established.

如是我聞：: 如《七十論》中說： 緣法實無生； 若謂為有生，
As it is stated in the Seventy Treatise, [Twelve chains of] causal conditions really have no production.

如是我聞：: 為在一心中； 為在多心中？
If they have production, do they have it in one mind-moment or in many mindmoments?

如是我聞：: 是十二因緣法實自無生。
The so-called twelve causal conditions really and originally have no production.

如是我聞：: 若謂有生， 為一心中有？ 為眾心中有？
If there is production, does it occur in one mindmoment or in many mind-moments?

如是我聞：: 若一心中有者， 因果即一時共生。 又因果一時有，
If it occurs in one-moment, then a cause and an effect would happen together at the same time.

如是我聞：: 是事不然。
But this is impossible.

如是我聞：: 何以故？
Why?

如是我聞：: 凡物先因後果故。
Because a cause is prior to an effect.

如是我聞：: 若眾心中有者， 十二因緣法則各各別異，
If production occurs in many mind-moments, then the twelve causal conditions would be distinct from one another.

如是我聞：: 先分共心滅已，
Each of the earlier ones would occur within a particular mind-moment and disappear with that mind-moment.

如是我聞：: 後分誰為因緣？
Then, what would be the causal condition of the later ones?

如是我聞：: 滅法無所有， 何得為因？
Since what disappears with a particular mind-moment is non-existent, how can it affect others?

如是我聞：: 十二因緣法若先有者， 應若一心、若多心，
If there are twelve causal conditions, they should either be in one mind-moment or in many mind-moments.

如是我聞：: 二俱不然。
But neither is possible.

如是我聞：: 是故眾緣皆空。
Therefore, all conditions are empty.

如是我聞：: 緣空故， 從緣生法亦空，
Since conditions are empty, things produced by conditions are also empty.

如是我聞：: 是故當知一切有為法皆空。
Thus, one should know all created things are empty.

如是我聞：: 有為法尚空， 何況我耶？
If created things are empty, how much more so with the self?

如是我聞：: 因五陰、十二入、十八界有為法故說有我，
Because of created things such as the five skandhas, the twelve sense fields (ayatana) and the eighteen elements (dhatu), one can say there is the self.

如是我聞：: 如因可然故說有然；
Only if there is something burnable can there be the fact of burning.

如是我聞：: 若陰、入、界空， 更無有法可說為我，
Now since skandhas, sense fields and elements are empty, nothing can be called self.

如是我聞：: 如無可然不可說然。
If there is nothing burnable, there cannot be the fact of burning.

如是我聞：: 如經說： 佛告諸比丘： 因我故有我所，
The sutra says, "The Buddha told bhiksus that because of self there can be self belongings.

如是我聞：: 若無我則無我所。
If there is no self, then there are no self belongings."

如是我聞：: 如是有為法空故， 當知無為涅槃法亦空。
Thus, since created things are empty, we should know that the non-created nirvana is also empty.

如是我聞：: 何以故？
Why?

如是我聞：: 此五陰滅更不生餘五陰， 是名涅槃。
The elimination of the five skandhas without producing another five skandhas is called nirvana.

如是我聞：: 五陰本來自空，
[But] the five skandhas are originally empty.

如是我聞：: 何所滅故說名涅槃？
What is to be eliminated to be called nirvana?

如是我聞：: 又我亦復空，
And the self is also empty.

如是我聞：: 誰得涅槃？
Who can obtain nirvana?

如是我聞：: 復次， 無生法名涅槃，
Moreover, non-produced things are called nirvana.

如是我聞：: 若生法成者， 無生法亦應成；
If produced things can be established, non-produced things can be established.

如是我聞：: 生法不成， 先已說因緣，
As mentioned in the previous examination of causes and conditions, produced things cannot be established.

如是我聞：: 後當復說，
This will be discussed again.

如是我聞：: 是故生法不成。
So produced things cannot be established.

如是我聞：: 因生法故名無生，
Because there are produced things, others can be called non-produced.

如是我聞：: 若生法不成， 無生法云何成？
If produced things cannot be established, how can non-produced things be established?

如是我聞：: 是故有為、無為及我皆空。
Therefore created things, non-created things and the self are all empty.

如是我聞：: 譬如前種能生後穀， 此前後穀不一不二、不有不無。
For example, what formerly is a seed subsequently produces a grain plant.The "former" and "subsequent" stages of this grain are neither one nor two, neither exist (you) nor do not exist (wu).

如是我聞：: 若一者則無前後，
If they were one (i.e., the same), then there would be no "former" and "subsequent."

如是我聞：: 若異者則前穀後豆，
If they were different, then what was originally grain could subsequently be a bean.

如是我聞：: 故無一異。
Therefore, they are neither the same nor different.

如是我聞：: 自性不有不無者， 因滅果生故， 因滅故不有、果生故不無。
Due to [the confluence of] the destruction of the cause and the production of the effect, own-nature neither exists nor does not exist. That is, because the cause perishes, own-nature does not exist, but because the effect is produced, it does not not exist.

如是我聞：: 因時未有果故不可說有，
Because at the time of the cause there is not yet an effect, you cannot say own-nature exists.

如是我聞：: 果生時必由因故不可說無。
Because the production of the effect is certainly due to the cause, you cannot say it docs not exist.

如是我聞：: 以是義故， 因果憶知並得成就， 故說無自性。
In this sense, cause and effect, reflection and understanding reach completion together, and therefore we say there is no own-nature.

如是我聞：: 何等一切法？ 云何為無我？
What are all dharmas, and what is meant by having no self?

如是我聞：: 一切法者略有五種：
All dharmas may be generally grouped into five categories: One, Mind Dharmas.

如是我聞：: 一者心法、二者心所有法、三者色法、四者心不相應行法、五者無為法。
Two, Dharmas interactive with the Mind. Three, Form Dharmas. Four, Dharmas Not interactive with the mind. Five, unconditioned Dharmas.

如是我聞：: 一切最勝故， 與此相應故， 二所現影故， 三分位差別故， 四所顯示故。 如是次第。
They are in this sequence because the first are supreme, the second interact with the first, the third are the shadows manifest by the previous two, the fourth are the positions in which the previous three are not found, and the last are revealed by the previous four.

如是我聞：: 第一心法， 略有八種：
The first, Mind Dharmas, include in general eight: 1.

如是我聞：: 一眼識、二耳識、三鼻識、四舌識、五身識、六意識、七末那識、八阿賴耶識。 第二心所有法，
The Eye consciousness, II. The Ear consciousness, III. The Nose consciousness, IV. The Tongue consciousness, V. The body consciousness, VI. The mind consciousness, VII. The Manas consciousness, VIII. The Alaya consciousness. The second, dharmas interactive with the mind, include, in general, fifty-one. They are divided into six categories: 1, The Five universally interactive, II. The five particular states, III. The eleven wholesome, IV.

如是我聞：: 略有五十一種， 分為六位： 一遍行有五、二別境有五、三善有十一、四煩惱有六、五隨煩惱有二十、六不定有四。
The six fundamental afflictions, V. The twenty derivative afflictions, and VI. The four unfixed. 1. The Five universally interactive are: 1. attention, 2.

如是我聞：: 一遍行五者， 一作意、二觸、三受、四想、五思。
Contact, 3. feeling, 4, conceptualization, and 5, deliberation.

如是我聞：: 二別境五者， 一欲、二勝解、三念、四定、五慧。
The Five particular states are: 1, Desire, 2. resolution, 3. recollection, 4. Concentration, and 5, judgment.

如是我聞：: 三善十一者，
III, The eleven wholesome Dharmas are: 1.

如是我聞：: 一信、二精進、三慚、四愧、五無貪、六無嗔、七無癡、八輕安、九不放逸、十行捨、十一不害。
Faith, 2. Vigor, 3. Shame, 4. Remorse, 5. Absence of greed, 6. Absence of anger, 7. Absence of Stupidity, 8. Light Ease, 9. Non-Laxness, 10. renunciation, 11.

如是我聞：: 四煩惱六者，
Non-Harming. IV, The Six fundamental afflictions are: 1, Greed, 2.

如是我聞：: 一貪、二嗔、三慢、四無明、五疑、六不正見。
Anger, 3. Stupidity, 4. Arrogance, 5. Doubt, and 6, Improper Views.

如是我聞：: 五隨煩惱二十者， 一忿、二恨、三惱、四覆、五誑、六諂、七憍、八害、九嫉、十慳、十一無慚、十二無愧、十三不信、十四懈怠、十五放逸、十六惛沈、十七掉舉、十八失念、十九不正知、二十散亂。
v. The twenty afflictions are: 1. wrath, 2. hatred, 3. rage, 4. covering, 5. deceit, 6. flattery, 7. conceit, 8. harming, 9. jealousy, 10. stinginess, 11. Lack of shame, 12. Lack of Remorse, 13. Lack of Faith, 14. Laziness, 15.

如是我聞：: 六不定四者，
Laxness, 16. Torpor, 17. restlessness, 18. Distraction, 19. Improper knowledge, and 20. scatteredness. vi. The Four unfixed are: 1.

如是我聞：: 一睡眠、二惡作、三尋、四伺。
Sleep, 2. regret, 3. examination, and 4. investigation.

如是我聞：: 第三色法，
The third is the Form Dharmas.

如是我聞：: 略有十一種：
In general, there are eleven kinds: I.

如是我聞：: 一眼、二耳、三鼻、四舌、五身、六色、七聲、八香、九味、十觸、十一法處所攝色。
Eyes, II. Ears, III. Nose, IV. Tongue, v. Body, vi. Forms, VII. Sounds, VIII. Smells, IX. Flavors, X. Objects of Touch, XI. Dharmas pertaining to form.

如是我聞：: 第四心不相應行法，
The fourth is the Dharmas not interactive with the mind.

如是我聞：: 略有二十四種：
In general, there are twenty-four: II.

如是我聞：: 一得、二命根、三眾同分、四異生性、五無想定、六滅盡定、七無想報、八名身、九句身、十文身、十一生、十二老、十三住、十四無常、十五流轉、十六定異、十七相應、十八勢速、十九次第、二十方、二十一時、二十二數、二十三和合性、二十四不和合性。
Attainment (aquisition). II. Llfe-Faculty, III, Generic Similarity, IV. dissimilarity, V. The No-Thought Samadhi, VI. The Samadhi of extinction, VII.

如是我聞：: 第五無為法者，
The Reward of No Thought, VIII.

如是我聞：: 略有六種：
Bodies of Nouns, IX. Bodies of sentences, X. Bodies of phonemes, XI. Birth, XII. dwelling, XIII. Aging, XIV. impermanence, XV. revolution, XVI. distinction, XVII. interaction, XVIII. Speed, XIX. sequence, XX. Time, XXI. direction, XXII. numeration, XXIII. combination, XXIV.

如是我聞：: 一虛空無為、二擇滅無為、三非擇滅無為、四不動滅無為、五想受滅無為、六真如無為。
discontinuity. The fifth is the unconditioned Dharmas, of which there are, in general, six: I, unconditioned Empty space, II. unconditioned extinction which is Attained by selection, III. unconditioned extinction which is unselected, IV. Unconditioned unmoving extinction, V. unconditioned extinction of Feeling and thinking, VI. unconditioned true suchness.

如是我聞：: 言無我者，
What is meant by there being no self?

如是我聞：: 略有二種： 一補特伽羅無我、二法無我。
There are, in general, Two Kinds of Non-self: 1. the Non-self of Pudgala, and 2. the Non-self of Dharmas.

如是我聞：: 今於諸佛所， 合掌而頂敬，
Now, in the presence of all the Buddhas, With palms pressed together, I bow down my head in reverence.

如是我聞：: 我當如教說，
I shall explain here in accordance with the teachings.

如是我聞：: 佛菩提資糧。
The provisions essential for the bodhi of the Buddhas.

如是我聞：: 佛者， 於一切所應知中得覺，
“Buddhas,” are those who have awakened to all which should be known.

如是我聞：: 此為佛義， 如所應知而知故。 又於無智睡眠中覺故。
This is the meaning of “buddha.” A “buddha” is so-called because his awareness accords with the manner in which things should be known and also because he has awakened from the sleep of ignorance.

如是我聞：: 覺者， 覺寤為義，
“Awakening,” has the meaning of coming into a state of awareness from the condition of sleep.

如是我聞：: 以離無智睡故。
Its application here is based on their abandonment of the slumber of ignorance.

如是我聞：: 又諸釋梵等不覺此覺，
Moreover, it is in contrast to Śakra, Brahmā, and the others who have not succeeded in waking to this awakening.

如是我聞：: 唯是名聲普遍三界者所能覺故。
It is an awakening such as only those whose fame has spread universally throughout the three realms have been able to awaken to.

如是我聞：: 一切諸佛乃覺此覺，
It is only all of the Buddhas then who have qualified to awaken to this awakening.

如是我聞：: 以一切種遍智唯佛所知。
This is because the universal knowledge inhering in the knowledge of all modes is known only to the Buddhas.

如是我聞：: 非諸聲聞獨覺菩薩， 以不共法具足故。
This is not the domain of the Śrāvaka-disciples, the Pratyekabuddhas, or the Bodhisattvas, this because it requires that one be equipped with the dharmas exclusive to a buddha.

如是我聞：: 初說因緣分。 問曰： 「有何因緣而造此論？
First, I will explain the“reasons [for composing the treatise].”Question: What are the reasons for composing this treatise?

如是我聞：: 」答曰： 「是因緣有八種。
Answer: There are eight reasons.

如是我聞：: 云何為八？
What are they?

如是我聞：: 一者、因緣總相， 所謂為令眾生離一切苦得究竟樂， 非求世間名利恭敬故。
The first is the main reason—that is to say, to free sentient beings from all suffering in order to attain ultimate happiness, and not to seek fame, profit, respect, or honor in the mundane world.

如是我聞：: 二者、為欲解釋如來根本之義， 令諸眾生正解不謬故。
The second is that I wish to elucidate the Tathāgata’s fundamental meaning in order to enable sentient beings to have a true understanding of it and not to make mistakes.

如是我聞：: 三者、為令善根成熟眾生於摩訶衍法堪任不退信故。
The third is to cause sentient beings whose virtuous roots have reached maturity to remain firm in the Mahāyāna Dharma, without relapsing in their faith.

如是我聞：: 四者、為令善根微少眾生修習信心故。
The fourth is to cause sentient beings of few virtuous roots to cultivate a commitment to faith.

如是我聞：: 五者、為示方便消惡業障善護其心， 遠離癡慢出邪網故。
The fifth is to show skillful means to eliminate the hindrances of evil karmic actions, to protect the mind well, to set misconception and arrogance at a far remove, and to escape from the net of wrong doctrines.

如是我聞：: 六者、為示修習止觀， 對治凡夫二乘心過故。
The sixth is to show how to practice calming and discernment, which are antidotes to the mental faults of ordinary people and adherents of the Two Vehicles.

如是我聞：: 七者、為示專念方便， 生於佛前必定不退信心故。
The seventh is to show the skillful means of concentrated mindfulness so that one will be born in the presence of a buddha and inevitably establish a non-relapsing commitment to faith.

如是我聞：: 八者、為示利益勸修行故。
The eighth is to show the benefits of practice and to encourage it.

如是我聞：: 有如是等因緣， 所以造論。
It is for such reasons that I have composed this treatise.

如是我聞：: 」問曰： 「修多羅中具有此法，
Question: The sutras are replete with these dharmas.

如是我聞：: 何須重說？
Why must you expound them again?

如是我聞：: 」答曰： 「修多羅中雖有此法， 以眾生根行不等、受解緣別。
Answer: Although the sutras contain these dharmas, [I expound them again here] since sentient beings are not equal in their capacities and cultivation, and vary in their predispositions for receiving and understanding.

如是我聞：: 所謂如來在世眾生利根， 能說之人色心業勝，
That is to say, when the Tathāgata was in the world,sentient beings had keen faculties and the Teacher excelled in actions of body and mind.

如是我聞：: 圓音一演異類等解， 則不須論。
There was no need for a treatise since his perfect voice had only to sound once for the different kinds of beings to have an equal understanding.

如是我聞：: 若如來滅後， 或有眾生能以自力廣聞而取解者；
Ever since the Tathāgata’s decease, there have been some sentient beings who, entirely through their own powers, have been able to gain an understanding by listening extensively [to sutras].

如是我聞：: 或有眾生亦以自力少聞而多解者；
There have been some sentient beings who, also through their own powers, have heard a little yet understood much.

如是我聞：: 或有眾生無自心力因於廣論而得解者；
And there have been some sentient beings who, without any intrinsic mental powers, have attained an understanding from expanded treatises.

如是我聞：: 自有眾生復以廣論文多為煩， 心樂總持少文而攝多義能取解者。
Of course, there have also been sentient beings who, finding the wordiness of expanded treatises frustrating, have been able to gain understanding because their minds have taken pleasure in drawing out much meaning from aide-memoires and succinct texts.

如是我聞：: 如是此論， 為欲總攝如來廣大深法無邊義故， 應說此論。
Because a treatise such as this aims to summarize the idea that the Tathāgata’s extensive, great, and profound dharma is boundless, I ought to expound it.

如是我聞：: 」已說因緣分。 次說立義分。 摩訶衍者， 總說有二種。
Having explained the “reasons [for composing the treatise],” I will next explain “establishing the meaning.” In general terms, there are two aspects of Mahāyāna.

如是我聞：: 云何為二？
What are they?

如是我聞：: 一者、法，
The first is Dharma.

如是我聞：: 二者、義。
The second is the meanings.

如是我聞：: 所言法者， 謂眾生心，
“Dharma” refers to the mind of sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 是心則攝一切世間法、出世間法。
This mind includes all mundane and supramundane dharmas.

如是我聞：: 依於此心顯示摩訶衍義。
The meaning of Mahāyāna is disclosed on the basis of this mind.

如是我聞：: 何以故？
Why?

如是我聞：: 是心真如相， 即示摩訶衍體故； 是心生滅因緣相， 能示摩訶衍自體相用故。
Because the aspect of this mind as suchness directly reveals Mahāyāna’s intrinsic reality; and because the aspect of this mind as the cause and condition of arising and ceasing is the revealer of Mahāyāna’s own intrinsic reality (ziti), characteristics (xiang), and function (yong).

如是我聞：: 所言義者， 則有三種。
There are three “meanings” [of mahā-, “great,” in the word Mahāyāna, “Great Vehicle”].

如是我聞：: 云何為三？
What are they?

如是我聞：: 一者、體大， 謂一切法真如平等不增減故。
The first is that Mahāyāna’s intrinsic reality is great because the suchness of all dharmas is uniform, neither increasing nor decreasing.

如是我聞：: 二者、相大， 謂如來藏具足無量性功德故。
The second is that its characteristics are great because the tathāgatagarbha is replete with countless merits.

如是我聞：: 三者、用大， 能生一切世間、出世間善因果故。
The third is that its functions are great because it is the producer of all good causes and effects, both mundane and supramundane.

如是我聞：: 一切諸佛本所乘故， 一切菩薩皆乘此法到如來地故。
That is why Mahāyāna [the “Great Vehicle”] is that on which all buddhas have always ridden and why all bodhisattvas ride on this Dharma until they arrive at the level of tathāgatas.

如是我聞：: 已說立義分。 次說解釋分。 解釋分有三種。
Having explained “establishing the meaning,” I will next explain the “elucidation.” The elucidation is threefold.

如是我聞：: 云何為三？
What are its three sections?

如是我聞：: 一者、顯示正義，
The first discloses the correct meaning.

如是我聞：: 二者、對治邪執，
The second is on the antidotes to wrongly held views.

如是我聞：: 三者、分別發趣道相。
The third discriminates characteristics for embarking on the Way.

如是我聞：: 顯示正義者， 依一心法， 有二種門。
With disclosing the correct meaning, there are two gateways based on the dharma of the One Mind.

如是我聞：: 云何為二？
What are they?

如是我聞：: 一者、心真如門，
The first is the gateway of the mind as suchness.

如是我聞：: 二者、心生滅門。
The second is the gateway of the mind as arising and ceasing.

如是我聞：: 是二種門， 皆各總攝一切法。
Each of these two gateways contains all dharmas.

如是我聞：: 此義云何？
Why?

如是我聞：: 以是二門不相離故。
Because these two gateways are not separate from one another.

如是我聞：: 心真如者， 即是一法界大總相法門體。
The mind as suchness is precisely the dharma-gate reality, which is the overarching characteristic of the unified dharma realm.

如是我聞：: 所謂心性不生不滅，
That is to say, the nature of the mind neither arises nor ceases.

如是我聞：: 一切諸法唯依妄念而有差別， 若離妄念則無一切境界之相。
It is solely due to false thoughts that there are distinctions between every dharma; if one is free from false thoughts, then there are none of the characteristics of perceptual fields.

如是我聞：: 是故一切法從本已來， 離言說相、離名字相、離心緣相，
Therefore, all dharmas have always been free from the characteristics of language, naming, and mental perceptions.

如是我聞：: 畢竟平等、無有變異、不可破壞。
They are ultimately uniform, invariant, and indestructible.

如是我聞：: 唯是一心故名真如， 以一切言說假名無實， 但隨妄念不可得故。 言真如者，
They are nothing but this One Mind and are therefore called “suchness.” [By contrast,] all [dharmas] designated by language lack real referents because they follow only from false thoughts and cannot be apprehended.

如是我聞：: 亦無有相。
“Suchness” (zhenru) is also devoid of characteristics.

如是我聞：: 謂言說之極因言遣言，
That is to say, it is at the point where language runs out.

如是我聞：: 此真如體無有可遣， 以一切法悉皆真故；
We use words to refute words, but there is nothing in suchness itself that might be refuted because all dharmas are entirely “real” (zhen).

如是我聞：: 亦無可立， 以一切法皆同如故。
There is also nothing in suchness itself that might be posited because all dharmas are equally “as such” (ru).

如是我聞：: 當知一切法不可說、不可念故， 名為真如。
One should know that all dharmas are called “suchness” because it is impossible to speak of or conceive of them.

如是我聞：: 問曰： 「若如是義者， 諸眾生等云何隨順而能得入？
Question: This is the meaning of “suchness.” To what should sentient beings conform in order to be able to obtain entry [through this gateway]?

如是我聞：: 」答曰： 「若知一切法雖說， 無有能說可說， 雖念， 亦無能念可念， 是名隨順。
Answer: If one knows that, although all dharmas are spoken of and conceived, there are in fact no speakers and nothing that might be spoken of, and no conceivers and nothing that might be conceived, it is called “conforming.” And if one is free from conceiving, it is called “obtaining entry.”

如是我聞：: 將欲解釋此經， 略開六門分別(初述大意、次辨經宗、三明詮用、四釋題名、五顯教攝、六消文義)。
I will explain this sūtra from six perspectives: (1) the conveyance of its general sense, (2) the articulation of its doctrinal essentials, (3) the clarification of the function of the explainer of its discourse, (4) the explication of its title, (5) the disclosure of its doctrinal categories, and (6) the exegesis of the main text.

如是我聞：: 初述大意者， 《妙法蓮華經》者， 斯乃十方三世諸佛出世之大意，
The Sūtra of the Lotus Blossom of the Marvelous Dharma reflects the broad purpose of all the buddhas in the ten directions and three divisions of time appearing in the world.

如是我聞：: 九道四生咸入一道之弘門也。
It is the vast gate through which all those of the nine paths and the four kinds of birth enter into the single way.

如是我聞：: 文巧義深、無妙不極，
The text is artful and the meaning profound, such that there is no level of subtlety to which it does not reach.

如是我聞：: 辭敷理泰、無法不宣。
Its words are well arranged and its principle all-embracing, and thus no teaching is not explained.

如是我聞：: 文辭巧敷， 花而含實；
With the text and words being artful and well arranged, the text is attractive, yet contains the real.

如是我聞：: 義理深泰， 實而帶權。
With the meaning and principle being profound and all-embracing, there is reality, yet it contains the provisional.

如是我聞：: 理深泰者， 無二無別也；
“The principle being profound and all-embracing” implies non-duality and non-distinction.

如是我聞：: 辭巧敷者， 開權示實也。
“The words being artful and well arranged” implies opening the provisional to show the real.

如是我聞：: 開權者， 開門外三車是權、中途寶城是化、樹下成道非始、林間滅度非終。
“Opening the provisional” is similar to [the father’s] revealing that the three carriages outside the gate are provisional—and that the jeweled city [seen] during the trip is conjured. His enlightenment under the bodhi tree was not the beginning, and his passing into nirvāna between the śāla trees was not the end.

如是我聞：: 示實者， 示四生並是吾子、二乘皆當作佛：
“Showing the real” is similar to the Buddha’s showing that the beings born in four ways are all his children and that the adherents of the two vehicles will all become buddhas.

如是我聞：: 塵數不足量其命、劫火不能燒其土，
Numerical calculation is not adequate to express the length of his life. The eon-ending conflagration cannot scorch the ground of his Pure Land.

如是我聞：: 是謂文辭之巧妙也。 言無二者， 唯一大事，
This is what is meant by the “artfulness of the prose.” The meaning of “not-two” is that there is only one great matter, in the Buddha’s view, which is to reveal [the truth for sentient beings], show them, awaken them, and make them enter.

如是我聞：: 於佛知見開示悟入、無上無異令知令證故。
[The Buddha’s teaching being] unsurpassed and unaltered, he has caused them to understand it and realize it.

如是我聞：: 言無別者， 三種平等， 諸乘諸身皆同一揆世間涅槃， 永離二際故，
The meaning of “no distinction” is like the three kinds of equality where all vehicles and all bodies follow the same method, and the mundane world and nirvāna have never been two different realities.

如是我聞：: 是謂義理之深妙也。
This is the subtle mystery of the meaning of the principle.

如是我聞：: 斯則文理咸妙，
Thus, the text and its principles are both wondrous.

如是我聞：: 無非玄則離麁之軌， 乃稱妙法；
It is the principle that lacks no profundity, the standard free from crudity, and is thus called the marvelous dharma.

如是我聞：: 權華開敷實菓泰彰，
The provisional flowers are scattered broadly, and the real fruit is amply manifested.

如是我聞：: 無染之美假喻蓮花。
With unsullied beauty, it is described as being like the lotus flower.

如是我聞：: 然妙法妙絕， 何三何一？
Yet why is the marvelous dharma which is perfectly excellent sometimes three, and sometimes one?

如是我聞：: 至久至冥， 誰短誰長？ 茲處怳惚，
This perfected person [the Tathāgata] is most mysterious: how could [his life span] be determined as short or long?

如是我聞：: 入之不易，
Initially, one is dull-minded, and entering is not easy.

如是我聞：: 諸子瀾漫出之良難，
The children are all running around, so getting them out is extremely difficult.

如是我聞：: 於是如來引之以權，
It is here that the Tathāgata draws them out with expedients.

如是我聞：: 羨羊車於鹿苑， 示有待之危身； 駕白牛於鷲岳， 顯無限之長命。
Enticing them with the goat carriage in the Deer Park, he shows them his coarse body that is dependent on physical existence. Hitching up the white ox at Vulture Peak, he reveals his limitlessly long life.

如是我聞：: 斯迺借一以破三， 三除一捨；
“From here, he borrows the one to refute the three, and with the three removed, the one is also abandoned.

如是我聞：: 假修以斥短， 短息而修忘。 是法不可示， 言辭相寂滅，
He provisionally uses the long to remove the short, and once the short is removed, the long is forgotten.” Since this dharma cannot be shown, signs of the words and text are annihilated.

如是我聞：: 蕩然靡據， 肅焉離寄，
Vanishing, it can’t be grasped; totally serene, it abandons all dependencies.

如是我聞：: 不知何以言之， 強稱妙法蓮花。 是以分坐令聞之者， 尚受輪王釋梵之座；
Not knowing what to call it, I am forced to name it the “flower of the marvelous dharma.” This being the case, those who share a seat and are allowed to listen will some day take the seat of the wheel-turning kings, Indra and Brahma.

如是我聞：: 經耳一句之人， 並得無上菩提之記。 況乎受持演說之福，
Those who hear a single phrase all attain the guarantee of the attainment of perfect enlightenment—not to mention that the merits of receiving and transmitting the teaching lie far beyond calculation.

如是我聞：: 豈可思議所量乎哉？ 舉是大意以標題目， 故言「妙法蓮花經」也。
The broad purport of the sūtra is shown in its title; thus it is called the Sūtra of the Lotus Blossom of the Marvelous Dharma.

如是我聞：: 第二辨經宗者，
B. Articulating the Doctrinal Essentials.

如是我聞：: 此經正以廣大甚深一乘實相為所詮宗。
This sūtra properly takes the vast and extremely profound true aspect of the One Vehicle as its point of doctrinal concern.

如是我聞：: 總說雖然， 於中分別者，
Yet though this is the general objective, there are specific issues addressed under this topic.

如是我聞：: 一乘實相略說有二， 謂能乘人及所乘法。
The true aspect of the One Vehicle can be summarized in two general categories—the person who avails himself of the teaching and the teaching that is resorted to.

如是我聞：: 此經所說一乘人者， 三乘行人、四種聲聞、三界所有四生眾生，
The One Vehicle adherents introduced in the sūtra include the practitioners of the three vehicles, the four kinds of śrāvakas, and the sentient beings of the four kinds of birth throughout the three realms—all are people who avail themselves of the One Vehicle.

如是我聞：: 並是能乘一佛乘人， 皆為佛子、悉是菩薩，
All are children of the Buddha, and all are bodhisattvas.

如是我聞：: 以皆有佛性、當紹佛位故。
Since they all possess the Buddha-nature, they will attain to the rank of Buddhahood.

如是我聞：: 乃至無性有情， 亦皆當作佛故。
In addition, those sentient beings lacking in Buddhanature (icchantikas) will all become buddhas.

如是我聞：: 第一釋名者，
First, there is the title of the sutra to explain.

如是我聞：: 此經以能說、所說人為名。
This sutra takes its title from the one who expounds it and from the one of whom he speaks.

如是我聞：: 佛者， 此土能說之教主， 即釋迦牟尼如來，
Buddha is the master teacher, the one who expounds the scripture in this world, that is, Sakyamuni.

如是我聞：: 乘大悲願力生五濁惡世，
By the power of his vows of great compassion, he was born here in the world of the Five Turbidities.

如是我聞：: 以先覺而覺後覺， 無法不知無法不見故名佛也。
As the one who was first to awaken, his mission was to bring enlightenment to those who were to awaken later. Buddha is the one who knows all and sees all.

如是我聞：: 說者， 悅所懷也， 佛以度生為懷，
Buddha speaks the sutra with joy in his heart. Buddha's intention is to liberate sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 眾生機熟， 佛為應時說法令得度脫，
Since the potential of sentient beings to achieve enlightenment is ripe, Buddha expounds for them these Pure Land teachings which are difficult to believe, and enables his listeners to reach ultimate liberation.

如是我聞：: 故悅也。
That's why he is filled with joy.

如是我聞：: 阿彌陀者， 即所說彼土之導師，
Amitabha Buddha is the one Sakyamuni refers to in the sutra. Amitabha is the guide of the Pure Land.

如是我聞：: 以四十八願接信願念佛眾生， 令生極樂世界永階不退者也。 梵語阿彌陀，
By the power of his forty-eight vows, he receives the sentient beings who have vowed to practice Buddha-remembrance by invoking the Buddha-name and enables them to be born in the Land of Ultimate Bliss, and never fall back from there.

如是我聞：: 此云無量壽， 亦云無量光。
The Sanskrit name "Amitabha" means "Infinite Life" and also "Infinite Light".

如是我聞：: 以要言之， 功德智慧， 神通道力， 依正莊嚴， 說法化度， 一一無量，
The essential point is that everything about him is infinite: his merits and his wisdom, his supernatural powers and his power in the Path, his embodiment and his environment, his work in expounding the Buddhist teachings and liberating sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 聊舉壽命、光明二事以為言端耳。 經者、訓法訓常， 一切金口所宣通名為經，
A sutra is any teaching from the golden mouth of a Buddha?

如是我聞：: 今對佛說阿彌陀五字、即是通別合為題也。
These terms taken together make up the title of the scripture: The Amitabha Sutra Spoken by Buddha.

如是我聞：: 教。 行。 理三各論通別， 廣如台藏所明， 自應尋之，
The three categories -- teachings, practices, and inner truth (noumenon), which each sutra should have -- can each be explained in both general and particular senses, as set out in the T'ien-t'ai system.

如是我聞：: 茲不繁述。 第二辨體者，
Second, there is the essence of the sutra to discern.

如是我聞：: 諸大乘經皆以實相為正體。
The true essence of all the Great Vehicle (Mahayana) scriptures is Absolute Reality (Real Mark) itself.

如是我聞：: 何謂實相？
What is Absolute Reality?

如是我聞：: 即現前一念心之自性是也。 吾人現前一念心性，
It is the Pure Mind of sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 不在內、不在外、不在中間，
This mind is not inside, not outside, and not in-between.

如是我聞：: 非過去、非現在、非未來，
It is not past, not present, and not future.

如是我聞：: 非青黃赤白、非長短方圓、非香、非味、非觸、非法，
It is not green or yellow or red or white, long or short or square or round. It is not a scent, not a flavor, not a texture, not a mental object.

如是我聞：: 覓之了不可得而不可言其無，
When we search for it we cannot find it, but we cannot say it does not exist.

如是我聞：: 具造百界千如而不可言其有，
It creates all worlds and all realms, but we cannot say it exists.

如是我聞：: 離一切緣慮分別相， 而緣慮分別亦非離此實相別有自性， 離一切語言文字相， 而語言文字亦非離此實相別有自性。
It is detached from conditioned thoughts and discriminations, from all words and characteristics, but conditioned thoughts and discriminations and worlds and characteristics do not have any separate identity apart from it. Essentially, absolute reality is detached from all characteristics, but merged with all phenomena.

如是我聞：: 以要言之， 離一切相、即一切法， 唯其離一切相故無相，
Being detached from characteristics, it is formless, and being merged with all phenomena, it gives them all their forms.

如是我聞：: 惟其即一切法故無不相， 無相無不相故不得已強名實相。
For lack of an alternative, we impose on it the name "absolute reality" [i.e., Mind, Real Mark, Buddha Nature].

如是我聞：: 實相之體非寂非照， 而復寂而恒照、照而恒寂，
The essence of Absolute Reality is neither quiescent nor aware, but it is both quiescent and yet ever shining with awareness, both shining with awareness and yet ever quiescent.

如是我聞：: 照而恒寂強名為常寂光土，
In that it is shining with awareness but quiescent, it is called the Land of Eternally Quiescent Light.

如是我聞：: 寂而恒照強名清淨法身。 又照而恒寂強名法身，
In that it is quiescent but shining with awareness, it is called the pure Dharmakaya (Dharma Body). Aware quiescence is called the Dharmakaya, the Dharma Body of all the Buddhas.

如是我聞：: 寂而恒照強名報身。 又性德寂照強名法身， 修德寂照名報身。
Quiescent awareness is called the Sambhogakaya, the Reward Body.

如是我聞：: 又修德照而恒寂名為受用身， 修德寂而恒照強名應化身。 當知寂照不二、性修不二、身土不二無非實相，
[For the Buddhas] quiescence and awareness are not two, bodies and lands are not two, what is inherent and what is cultivated are not two, true essence and responsive function are not two -- everything is absolute reality.

如是我聞：: 實相無二亦無不二，
Reality and appearances are neither two nor not two.

如是我聞：: 是故舉體作依、作正、作法、作報、作自、作他，
Therefore, the essence of reality as a whole acts as both the environment that surrounds sentient beings and as their very bodies.

如是我聞：: 乃至能說所說、能度所度、能信所信、能願所願、能持所持、能生所生、能讚所讚，
It acts as both the Dharma Body and the Reward Body of the Buddhas. It acts as both self and others. Thus the one who speaks the sutra and the one who is spoken of, the Buddhas that can deliver sentient beings and the sentient beings who are delivered, the ability to believe and that which is believed in, the ability to take vows and that which is vowed, the ability to concentrate on the Buddha-name and the Buddha-name which is concentrated upon, the ability to be born in the Pure Land and birth in the Pure Land itself, the ability to praise the Buddhas and the Buddhas who are praised -- all of these are the imprint of the "true seal" of Absolute Reality.

如是我聞：: 無非實相正印之所印也。
In other words, the True Mind (Bodhi Mind) of sentient beings is the essence of all Mahayana sutras.

如是我聞：: 第三明宗者，
Third, there is the guiding principle to explain.

如是我聞：: 宗是修行之要徑、會體之樞機， 而萬行之綱領也。
The guiding principle is the essential route for cultivating practice, the key link for understanding the essence [of our mind], the guiding framework for the myriad practices.

如是我聞：: 提其綱則眾目皆張， 挈其領則襟袖隨至，
When you hold up a net, the mesh opens up. When you lift the collar of a shirt, the breast and sleeves come too.

如是我聞：: 故次體之後應須辨宗。
Thus, after explaining the essence of the sutra, we must discern the guiding principle.

如是我聞：: 此經以信願持名為修行之宗要。
The essential principle for cultivation in this sutra is to develop faith and vows and to recite the Buddha-name.

如是我聞：: 非信不足以啟願，
Without faith, we are not sufficiently equipped to take vows.

如是我聞：: 非願不足以導行，
Without vows, we are not sufficiently equipped to guide our practice.

如是我聞：: 非持名妙行不足以滿其所願而證所信，
Without the wondrous practice of reciting the Buddha-name, we are not sufficiently equipped to fulfill our vows and to bring our faith to fruition.

如是我聞：: 是故經中先演極樂依正以生信，
The sutra first sets forth the pure environment of the Land and the exalted bodies of its inhabitants in order to engender faith in us.

如是我聞：: 次勸應當發願以導行，
Next it urges us to take vows to give guidance to our practice.

如是我聞：: 次示七日持名以徑登不退。
Then it teaches the practice of reciting the Buddha-name as the route of direct ascent with no falling back (non-retrogression).

如是我聞：: 信則信自、信他、信因、信果、信事、信理，
Faith means having faith in oneself and faith in others (Buddha and Bodhisattvas). It means being sure about cause and effect, about phenomena and inner truth (noumenon).

如是我聞：: 願則厭離娑婆欣求極樂，
Vows mean feeling aversion to the mundane world and detaching from it. Vows mean gladly seeking the Pure Land of Ultimate Bliss.

如是我聞：: 行則執持名號一心不亂。
Practice means persisting in the practice of reciting the Buddha-name singlemindedly and without confusion (with one-pointedness of mind).

如是我聞：: 信自者， 信我現前一念之心本非肉團亦非緣影， 竪無初後、橫絕邊涯，
[Faith]. Believing in ourselves means believing that the True Mind is not a physical manifestation, and not the reflection of entangling objects, that it extends through time without any before or after and through space without any boundaries.

如是我聞：: 終日隨緣、終日不變。
Though it follows causal conditions all day long, it never changes.

如是我聞：: 十方虛空微塵國土， 元我一念心中所現之物，
All of space in the Ten Directions and all the worlds countless as atoms are originally things created by this Mind of ours.

如是我聞：: 我今雖復昏迷倒惑， 苟能一念回心， 決定得生自己心中本具極樂， 更無疑慮，
Although we are deluded and confused, if for a single moment we return to this Mind, we are sure to be born in the Land of Ultimate Bliss originally inherent in our own mind, and be troubled no more by worry and doubt.

如是我聞：: 是名信自。
This is called "believing in ourselves".

如是我聞：: 信他者， 信彼釋迦如來決無誑語， 彌陀世尊決無虛願，
Believing in others means having faith that the Tathagata Sakyamuni certainly did not lie, and that the World Honored One Amitabha certainly did not take his vows in vain.

如是我聞：: 六方諸佛廣長舌決無二言， 隨順諸佛真實教誨，
It means being certain that all the Buddhas of all the directions never equivocated, and it means following the true teachings of all the enlightened ones.

如是我聞：: 決志求生更無疑惑，
It means establishing our will to seek birth in the Pure Land, and being prey no more to doubt and confusion.

如是我聞：: 是名信他。
This is called "believing in others".

如是我聞：: 第二、藏部攝者， 聲聞、菩薩二藏之中， 菩薩藏攝；
II. The Text's Place in the Canon. As for the second (major point for explanation, the place of the text's) inclusion in the sections of the canon, within the (categorization of a) two (part) canon, (i.e., a canon with) Hearer and Bodhisattva (sections), the Bodhisattva canon includes (this text).

如是我聞：: 脩多羅等三藏之內， 對法藏；
In the (categorization of a) three (part) canon, (i.e, the canon with) sutra, (vinaya, and abhidharma sections), the abhidharma (section of the) canon receives (this text).

如是我聞：: 收十二部中， 論議經攝。
In the (categorization of a) twelve section (canon, the section with) "discursive" texts includes (this work).

如是我聞：: 問： 既非佛說， 何得然耶？
Question: Since (the text) is not a discourse of the Buddha, how is it that it comes to be so (included in the canon)?

如是我聞：: 答： 由二義故：
Answer: (That is) because of two (points of) significance.

如是我聞：: 一、由是彼類， 是故彼攝。
First, due (to the fact) it is that type (of text indicated by the corresponding sections), therefore those (sections have come to) include (it).

如是我聞：: 二、但諸佛說法， 有其三種：
Second, (it is) simply (because) there are three varieties of the Dharma that Buddhas expound.

如是我聞：: 一、佛自說；
(That is to say, 1. there is the Dharma) Buddhas personally expound, 2.

如是我聞：: 二、加他說；
(there is the Dharma) others (so) empowered expound, and 3.

如是我聞：: 三、懸許說。
(there is the Dharma of) expositions permitted by prophecy.

如是我聞：: 此論則當懸許之類，
This Treatise matches the permitted by prophecy type.

如是我聞：: 以《入[＊]楞伽經》及《摩耶經》中， 佛記龍樹然正法炬，
By means of (content) in the Lankavatara sutra and Maya sutra (we see) the Buddha foretold Nagarjuna would light the torch of the True Dharma.

如是我聞：: 故知懸記許可說也，
Therefore (we) know (this Dharma) promised (by) prophecy is expoundable.

如是我聞：: 是故亦入至教量收， 達磨藏攝。
Because of this it is also entered into the collection of the canon (that includes) collected Dharmas on doctrinal reasoning.

如是我聞：: 第三、定教分齊者， 此方南北諸師異說紛紜，
III. The Text's Place Among Divisions of the Doctrine. As for the third (major point for explanation), determining (the text's place among) the divisions of the doctrine, (in) this (matter when we) compare the various masters of the south and north, (their) different explanations are confusing.

如是我聞：: 無勞敘記， 且辨西國諸德所傳親問大原寺翻經中天竺三藏法師地婆訶羅，
Without laboring (over) the record of their rankings, but to still distinguish (among the views) transmitted by the virtuous (teachers of) India, I asked (for help from) the Temple of the Great Vow's translator, central Indian Tripitaka Master Divakara.

如是我聞：: 唐言日照， 說云：
The T'ang (Chinese) pronunciation (of his name is) "Re-chao."

如是我聞：: 「近代中天竺那爛陀寺， 同時有二大德論師：
He said presently two sastra masters of great virtue are both at India's Nalanda monestary.

如是我聞：: 一名戒賢， 一名智光，
One is named Silabhadra and one is named Inanaprabha?

如是我聞：: 並神解超倫、聲高五印，
Both (have) a spiritual understanding that transcends the ordinary (and their) reputations are high (throughout the) five (regions) of India.

如是我聞：: 六師稽顙、異部歸依， 大乘學人仰之日月，
(He said that) the six teachers (of heterodoxies all) bow (to them) Different sects return to and rely on (their understanding and even) Mahayana scholars look up (to them) as to the sun and moon.

如是我聞：: 如天竺獨步，
(Nevertheless) in India they walk alone (on separate paths.

如是我聞：: 軌範成規， 遂各守一宗， 互為矛盾。 」謂戒賢則遠承彌勒、無著， 近踵護法、難陀，
Their observance of) the regulations constitutes (a moral) compass (for others) even though each maintains a school (of tenets) that putally are (like) a spear and shield fi.e., mutually opposed] (If we) speak of Silabhadra, then he inherited (the teachings of) Maitreya and Asanga from long ago (while more) recently following the footsteps of Dharmapala and Nanda.

如是我聞：: 依《深密》等經、《瑜伽》等論，
(He) relies upon sutras like the Sandhinirmocana and sastras like the Yogacarabhumi (to) clarify the Fa-hsiang (school of) Mahayana.

如是我聞：: 明法相大乘， 廣分名數， 用三教開宗， 顯自所依為真了義，
The broad divisions that designate (his) enumeration (of the periods of the Dharma) uses three teachings to explain the (various) schools and reveal that which they individually rely upon as the true meaning (of the Dharma).

如是我聞：: 謂佛初鹿園轉於四諦小乘法輪，
That is to say, (according to thìs view) initially at Deer Park the Buddha turned the Dharma wheel in regards to the Hinayana of the Four Noble Truths.

如是我聞：: 雖說人空翻諸外道， 然於緣生定說實有；
Although he expounded the emptiness of persons to overturn various heterodoxies, even so in regards to dependently arising (dharmas), he definitively expounded (their) real existence.

如是我聞：: 第二時中， 雖依遍計所執， 而說諸法自性皆空翻彼小乘，
In the second period though, relying upon (objects) which are grasped at by the understanding that universally reckons (all objects have an essential nature), and explaining that the self nature of the various dharmas are all empty (of own being, he thereby) overturned those Hinayana (views).

如是我聞：: 然於依他、圓成猶未說有；
Even so, in regards to the dependent (nature) and the perfected (nature he) still as yet expounded their (essential) existence.

如是我聞：: 第三時中， 就大乘正理， 具說三性、三無性等， 方為盡理。
In the third period then (he reached) the correct principle of the Mahayana and completely expounded the Three Natures and the Three Non (self-) natures that then actually constitute the exhaustive principle (of true emptiness).

如是我聞：: 是故於因緣生法， 初時唯說有， 則墮有邊；
Therefore, regarding dharmas produced by causes and conditions, in the initial period he only expounded (their real) existence and accordingly fell to the existence side (of extreme views).

如是我聞：: 次說於空， 則墮空邊；
Next he expounded on (their) emptiness and accordingly fell to the emptiness side (of extreme views).

如是我聞：: 既各墮邊、俱非了義，
Since each (of these two options) falls (to an extreme) side, neither is the final meaning (of the Dharma.

如是我聞：: 後時具說所執性空、餘二為有，
So) in the subsequent period (he) completely expounded the emptiness of the natures that are grasped at.

如是我聞：: 契會中道方為了義。
The other two (earlier views) constitute (views of essentia) existence (while this view) unites (them with) the Middle Path and actually constitutes the final meaning (of the Dharma).

如是我聞：: 是故依此所說， 判般若等經多說空宗， 是第二教攝，
Therefore, based on (classifications) that this (view) expounds, (we can) judge sutras like the Prajnaparamita (and texts like the present one that) mostly expound emptiness tenets as included in the Second (period) Teachings.

如是我聞：: 非為了義。
(These texts then) do not constitute the final meaning (of the Dharma.

如是我聞：: 此依《解深密經》判也。
Of course) this depends upon the decisions (and views) of the Sandhinirmocana (sutra).

如是我聞：: 二、智光論師遠承文殊、龍樹， 近稟青目、清辨，
(As for) the second (view, that of) Sastra Master Jnanaprabha, he inherited the (views) of Manjusri and Nagarjuna from old (and more) recently received (the teachings of) Aryadeva and Bhavaviveka.

如是我聞：: 依《般若》等經、《中觀》等論， 顯無相大乘， 廣辨真空， 亦以三教開宗， 顯自所依真為了義。
Based on sutras like the Prajnaparamita sutra and sastras like the Madhyamaka-sastra (he) reveals the Mahayana of no characteristics, broadly distinguishes (the teaching of) true emptiness, and also uses three (periods of) teaching to express tenets (and) reveal that which he personally depends upon as constituting the final meaning (of the Dharma).

如是我聞：: 謂佛初鹿園為諸小根， 轉於四諦小乘法輪，
That is to say (according to this view) initially at Deer Park the Buddha turned the Hinayana Dharma wheel in regards to the Four (Noble) Truths for individuals of less (well developed) faculties.

如是我聞：: 說心境俱有；
(At that time he) expounded (the teaching that) the mind and its objects both exist.

如是我聞：: 次於第二時， 為中根說法相大乘境空心有則唯識義等，
Next, in the second period, for those of moderately (developed) faculties, (he) expounded the Mahayana of Dharma-characteristics (namely, the view that) objects are empty while the mind exists. Accordingly (this teaching includes various) ideas like consciousness only.

如是我聞：: 以根猶劣故， 未能全入平等真空，
Because (at that time people's) faculties were still (relatively) inferior, (they) were as yet unable to completely enter (an understanding of) universal true emptiness.

如是我聞：: 故作是說；
Therefore he created these (sorts of provisional) explanations.

如是我聞：: 於第三時， 方為上根說此無相大乘，
In the third period then (he) expounded this Mahayana of no-characteristics for (those of) superior faculties.

如是我聞：: 顯心境俱空、平等一味， 為真了義。
(At that time he) revealed that the mind and its objects are both empty, (and that the) universal, single "flavor" (of emptiness) constitutes the true, complete meaning (of the Dharma).

如是我聞：: 又初則為破外道自性等，
Furthermore, (according to this view) the initial (teaching) then was in order to break heterodox (notions like) a self-nature and such.

如是我聞：: 故說因緣生法決定是有；
Therefore he expounded (the idea that) dharmas produced by causes and conditions certainly are existent.

如是我聞：: 次則為破小乘實有， 說此緣生但是假有，
Subsequently then in order to break Hinayana (notions of essentially) real existence he expounded (the idea that) these dependently produced (dharmas) are only provisionally existent.

如是我聞：: 以恐彼怖畏此真空， 故猶存有而接引之；
Because they feared and dreaded this true emptiness he therefore still preserved (the notion of) existence while guiding them (to true emptiness).

如是我聞：: 第三方就究竟大乘， 說此緣生即是性空、平等一相，
The third period then concerns the final Mahayana (and at that time he) expounded (the idea that) these dependently produced (dharmas) are exactly the emptiness of a (self) nature, a universal single characteristic.

如是我聞：: 此亦是入法之漸次也。
This (progression of the teachings) is also a gradual sequence of entering (final understanding of) the Dharma.

如是我聞：: 則依此說， 判法相大乘有所得等為第二教， 非了義也。
Accordingly, based on this explanation Unanaprabha) judges Fa-hsiang Mahayana (school ideas) such as an existent (consciousness and the empty dharmas it) appropriates as constituting second period teachings, and not as the complete purport (of the Dharma.

如是我聞：: 此三教次第， 智光法師《般若燈論釋》中引《大乘妙智經》所說，
As for) this progression pf three teachings, (it is) that which Dharma Master Jnanaprabha explained in his Prajnapradipa-mulamadhyamaka-vritti, drawing on the Ta-ch’eng miao-chih ching.

如是我聞：: 是故依此教理， 《般若》等經是真了義，
Therefore, based on these doctrinal principles, Prajnaparamita type sutras are the true, complete purport (of the Dharma.

如是我聞：: 餘法相名數是方便說耳。
All) the other designations and Enumerations of dharma characteristics are expedient explanations and nothing more.

如是我聞：: 空可空非真空。
Emptiness that can be deemed empty is not true emptiness.

如是我聞：: 色可色非真色。
Form that can be deemed form is not true form.

如是我聞：: 真色無形。 真空無名。
True form is without shape; true emptiness has no name.

如是我聞：: 無名名之父。 無色色之母。
That which has no name is the father of [all] names, and that which has no form, the mother of [all] forms.

如是我聞：: 為萬物之根源。 作天地之太祖。
They are the source of the myriad things, the Great Ancestor of heaven and earth.

如是我聞：: 上施玄象。 下列冥庭。
Extended above are the mysterious [stellar] schemata, and arrayed below lie the courts of darkness.

如是我聞：: 元氣含於大象。 大象隱於無形。 為識物之靈。
The primordial pneuma is contained within the great schemata, and the great schemata lie concealed in the formless as the numen of sentient things.

如是我聞：: 靈中有神。 神中有身。
[Dormant] within the numen are spirits, and within the spirits are bodies.

如是我聞：: 無為變化。 各稟乎自然。
No action, yet change and transformation—each endowed with spontaneity.

如是我聞：: 微有事用。 漸有形名。
Subtly there arise phenomena and functions, and gradually there develop forms and names.

如是我聞：: 形興未質。 名起未名。
Forms emerge from that which has no substance, and names arise from that which has no name.

如是我聞：: 形各既兆。 遊氣亂清。
As forms and names multiply, the roaming pneumas confuse [what was] pure.

如是我聞：: 寂兮寥兮。 寬兮廓兮。 分兮別兮。
[First] quiescent and still; [then] spacious and open; [finally] divided and differentiated.

如是我聞：: 上則有君。 下則有臣。
Above are the lords and below the ministers.

如是我聞：: 父子親其居。 尊卑異其位。
Fathers and sons draw close in their dwellings, while the noble and the base distinguish their ranks.

如是我聞：: 起教敘其因。
They give rise to teachings and assess their consequences.

如是我聞：: 然後國分其界。 人部其家。 各守其位。
Thereupon the state divides into realms and people into clans, each protecting their own positions.

如是我聞：: 禮義興行。 有善可稱。 有惡可名。 善人所重。 惡人所輕。
The practice of rites and righteousness flourishes; there is “good” that can be lauded and “evil” that can be named, and the good is respected by people and evil disdained.

如是我聞：: 於是即是非而競生。
Thereupon there is affirmation and negation, and strife is born.

如是我聞：: 其智有解。 其愚有縛。
In understanding lies freedom, but ignorance brings bondage.

如是我聞：: 上施煩形。 下無寂樂。
Those above hand down proscriptions such that those below know neither peace nor joy.

如是我聞：: 失自然之志。 拘物外之約。
They lose their spontaneous will and impede their connection to the transcendent.

如是我聞：: 迷無為之為。 動有作之作。
They stray from the efficacy of nonaction, and their movements have the makings of purpose.

如是我聞：: 其名教既行。
Acting in accord with the doctrine of names, they force everything together into patterns of correspondence.

如是我聞：: 使上下之應諾爾乃聲立五音。 色立五色。 行立五行。 德立五德。
In this manner sounds are organized according to the five modes, color according to the five colors, the phases according to the five phases, and virtue according to five virtues.

如是我聞：: 差之毫釐。 過犯山嶽。
Thus, if one errs by so much as a hair’s breadth, the transgression is as great as a lofty mountain.

如是我聞：: 律禁未然。 令防未欲。
Laws arise to prohibit that which has yet to occur, and orders are issued against urges people are yet to have.

如是我聞：: 無放蕩之寬。 有多方之局。
