Without the vastness of the disordered and free, there is naught but a host of distinctions.

如是我聞：: 所以然者。 為人而不知足。
All this because people do not know when enough is enough.

如是我聞：: 斯為濁亂之時。 有弟有師。
In these corrupt and disordered times, there are students and there are teachers.

如是我聞：: 師有所訓。 弟有所依。
The teachers cling to their traditions, and the students remain obedient to them.

如是我聞：: 天地寥落。 宇宙寬廓。
Heaven and earth are endless; the cosmos is vast and wide.

如是我聞：: 中有煙塵。 清虛翳膜。
Within there is smoke and dust, veiling the pure void.

如是我聞：: 巍巍之形。 內神外靈。
Forms loom large; spirit lies within and the numen without.

如是我聞：: 妄有想慮。 真一闇冥。
Delusion gives rise to discursive thought, obscuring the True One in darkness.

如是我聞：: 其妄有識。 其真有惑。
From delusion arises sentience, and truth becomes muddled.

如是我聞：: 非取而取。 非得而得。
In the absence of [anything to] grasp, there is yet grasping; in the absence of [anything to] attain, there is yet attaining.

如是我聞：: 是故理則無窮。 物則無極。
Therefore, the principle is inexhaustible, and things are without limit.

如是我聞：: 動兮亂兮。
Movement! Confusion!

如是我聞：: 內發三毒。
The three poisons arise from within.

如是我聞：: 視兮聽兮。
Seeing! Hearing!

如是我聞：: 外受五欲。
The five passions are stirred from without.

如是我聞：: 其心慌慌。 其身忙忙。 觸物動作。 如火煌煌。
As the mind is agitated and the body bustles about, contact with objects moves one to action like the frenzied dance of fire.

如是我聞：: 故聖人立正教。 置真謨。 使無知之侶。 上下相依。 修無為。
Therefore, the sages have established the correct teachings and laid out the true course so that those who lack in understanding—both superiors and inferiors—will rely on each other, cultivate nonaction, refrain from excess, and gradually reach suchness.

如是我聞：: 息有餘。 漸至乎如如。 如如之理。 同本真軌。
The principle of suchness is identical with the original and true path.

如是我聞：: 不可以修證。 不可以希冀。 惟寂滅性耳。
It cannot be cultivated, nor should it be the object of longing, for its nature is wholly quiescent and extinct.

如是我聞：: 夫真也者。 無洲無渚。 無伴無侶。 無涯無際。 無處無所。
As for Truth, it is [a singular expanse] without island or shoal, without friend or peer, without limit or boundary, devoid of place or location, yet it acts as the progenitor of the myriad things.

如是我聞：: 能為萬物之祖宗。 非目視。 非耳聞。
It cannot be seen by the eye nor heard by the ear.

如是我聞：: 非形色。 非幻魂。 能為三界之根門。
It has neither shape nor form, nor is it a ghost, yet it acts as the fundamental gate to the three realms.

如是我聞：: 其正者先離形。 次泯情。 不依物。 不拘生。
To correctly [grasp Truth] one must first part from form, then empty the emotions, become independent of things, and cease clinging to life.

如是我聞：: 可以合大道通神明。
Then one can merge with the Great Way and penetrate the light of the spirit.

如是我聞：: 有用曰神。 有形曰身。 無為曰道。 無相曰真。
That which functions is called spirit, and that which has form is called the body, while that which is without action is called the Way, and that which has no attributes is called Truth.

如是我聞：: 應物而號。 隨物而造。
In response to things there is designation, and in accord with things there is creation.

如是我聞：: 常住常存。 不生不老。
But that which abides eternally and exists eternally neither is born nor grows old.

如是我聞：: 理合萬德。 事出千巧。
Principle merges with the ten thousand virtues, and phenomena emerge from the thousand arts.

如是我聞：: 事雖無窮。 理終一道。
Although phenomena are inexhaustible, the Single Way ultimately lies in principle.

如是我聞：: 無有證者。 無有得者。 然不證不得。 恒處心惑。
There is nothing to be realized, nothing to be attained, and yet if there is no realization or attainment, the mind will be forever confused.

如是我聞：: 其心不真。 惑亂餘人。
This mind is false and brings confusion and turmoil to others.

如是我聞：: 恍然惚然。 如有魍魎。 似有思想。
Nebulous and indistinct, it is like a shadowy phantom with only a semblance of intelligence.

如是我聞：: 究兮推兮。 了無指掌。
Examine and ponder it; understanding is not [as simple as] pointing to the palm of your hand.

如是我聞：: 如空忽雲。 如鏡忽塵。 彼此緣起。 而以妄存。
Like clouds appearing suddenly in the empty sky or dust appearing on the mirror—“this” and “that” arise only in dependence on conditions; they exist because of our delusion.

如是我聞：: 有妄曰愚。 無妄曰真。
To be deluded is called ignorance, to be free of delusion is called Truth.

如是我聞：: 真氷釋水。 妄水結氷。
Truth is like ice melting into water, and delusion like water freezing into ice.

如是我聞：: 氷水之二。 其體不異。
In essence there is no difference between water and ice.

如是我聞：: 迷妄曰愚。 惺真曰智。
To be confused and deluded is called ignorance, and to be awakened to Truth is called wisdom.

如是我聞：: 其氷也冬不可釋。 其水也春不可結。 故愚不可即改。 智不可即待。
Just as ice cannot melt in winter and water cannot freeze in spring, so too ignorance cannot be ameliorated instantly, nor can wisdom be attained instantly.

如是我聞：: 漸釋漸消。 以通乎大海。
Release comes gradually, as one slowly melts and dissolves into the great sea.

如是我聞：: 斯可謂自然之道。
This can be called the natural way.

如是我聞：: 運用玄玄。 非念慮所測。
Its activity is the mystery of mysteries; it cannot be fathomed by thought.

如是我聞：: 當可以綿綿。 不可以勤勤。
And while it may be subtle, it can never be exhausted.

如是我聞：: 夫進道之由。 中有萬途。
In advancing along the Way, one comes across a myriad stray paths.

如是我聞：: 困魚止瀝。
A fish in distress will pause in a small puddle.

如是我聞：: 病鳥棲蘆。
A sick bird will rest on a reed.

如是我聞：: 其二者不識於大海。
These two know not of the great sea nor of the dense forests.

如是我聞：: 不識於叢林。 人趨乎小道其義亦然。
People hastening about their petty tasks are just the same.

如是我聞：: 此可謂久功中止。
This could be called stopping midway through a long task.

如是我聞：: 不達如理。 捨大求小。
Without ever reaching the principle of suchness, they throw out what is great and pursue what is small.

如是我聞：: 半路依止。 以小安而自安。
Halfway along the road they stop and rest, mistaking this small respite for the peace they seek.

如是我聞：: 不及大安而安矣。
They do not reach the peace that is the Great Peace.

如是我聞：: 其大也愰蕩無涯。 含識一體。 萬物同懷。
Its greatness is vast and boundless; it is the single substance of all sentient life, equally embracing the myriad things.

如是我聞：: 應則千變。 化則眾現。
It responds, giving rise to a thousand transformations; it changes, producing a multitude of manifestations.

如是我聞：: 不出不沒。 用無有間。
It neither comes forth nor passes away, yet it functions without pause.

如是我聞：: 有心無形。 有用無人。
There is mind but no form, functioning but no human agency.

如是我聞：: 示生無生。 示身無身。
It manifests as birth, yet there is no birth; it manifests as a body, yet there is no body.

如是我聞：: 常測不測。 常識不識。 為而無為。 得而無得。
Always reckoning but never reckoned, always perceiving but never perceived, there is action without intention, and attainment without anything attained.

如是我聞：: 鏡象千端。 水質萬色。 影分塵界。
The images in a mirror have a thousand facets, and the substance of water [reflects] a myriad colors.

如是我聞：: 應用無極。
These sundered reflections are the objective world, wherein the workings of [sympathetic] resonance are without limit.

如是我聞：: 無形而形。 無名而名。
Devoid of form there is yet form; devoid of name there is yet name.

如是我聞：: 物類相感。 和合而生。
Things of like kind affect one another; harmoniously they come together and give birth.

如是我聞：: 生而不生。 其無有情。
There is birth, and yet there is no birth, as it is without feeling.

如是我聞：: 眾謂之聖。 眾謂之明。 種種稱號。 各任其名。
Some call it holy, some call it brilliant; there are many ways to refer to it, as each employs its own name.

如是我聞：: 然其實也。 以無為為宗。 無相為容。
But in reality its essential principle is nonaction, and its appearance is the absence of attributes.

如是我聞：: 等清虛。 同太空。 究無處所。 用在其中。
It is as uniform, pure, and empty as space itself, and ultimately without loci, yet functions abide within it.

如是我聞：: 其得者一。 其證者密。 得則不一。 證則不密。
Its attainment is singular, and its realization is secret, yet once attained it is no longer singular, and once realized it is no longer secret.

如是我聞：: 然非不一。 然非不密。
Thus it is not the case that it is not singular and not the case that it is not secret.

如是我聞：: 其體陰離。 其用陽微。
Its essence is the transcendence of yin; its function is the subtlety of yang.

如是我聞：: 言不盡理。 行不盡儀。
Words do not exhaust the principle, nor does activity exhaust the principles of conduct.

如是我聞：: 斯可謂太微。
This can be called Grand Subtlety.

如是我聞：: 夫山草無窮。 泉水無竭。
The mountain grasses are without end, and spring water is inexhaustible.

如是我聞：: 谷風無休。 鐘聲無歇。
The breeze of the valley never rests, and the sound of the gong never ceases.

如是我聞：: 物尚如斯。 何況道乎。
If things of the world are like this, how much more so is the Way.

如是我聞：: 有必速亡。 無必久長。
With necessity there is haste and loss; but when there is no necessity, there is ample time.

如是我聞：: 天地雖變。 虛空獨常。
Although heaven and earth may change, space itself is eternal.

如是我聞：: 夫學道者習無餘。 不學道者習有餘。
As for those who study the Way, their practice is without excess, but the practice of those who do not study the Way is excessive.

如是我聞：: 無餘道近。 有餘道疎。
When there is no excess, the Way is near, but when there is excess, the Way is distant.

如是我聞：: 知有有壞。 知無無敗。
Know existence and there will be ruin, but know nonexistence and there will be no defeat.

如是我聞：: 真知之知。 有無不計。
But the knowing that is true knowing does not reckon between the two.

如是我聞：: 於有不有。 於無不無。
Do not impute existence to existence or nonexistence to nonexistence.

如是我聞：: 有無不見。 性相如如。 閴然無物。
Neither existence nor nonexistence is perceived; their essential nature is thusness.

如是我聞：: 而乃用出。
Barren and empty, yet activity issues forth.

如是我聞：: 若不如是。 多妄多失。 中有夢慮。
When such is not the case, there is much confusion, much loss, and through it all capricious speculation.

如是我聞：: 主習眾疾。
To emphasize practice [only leads to a] host of afflictions.

如是我聞：: 非凶為凶。 非吉為吉。
Misfortune is confused with fortune, and fortune is confused with misfortune.

如是我聞：: 吉凶之事。 翳障真一。
The affairs of fortune and misfortune are but a diversion, a barrier to the True One.

如是我聞：: 故為道者。 不可以同迷。
Therefore, one devoted to the Way must not be misled like this.

如是我聞：: 立此慈悲道場四字乃因夢感。
The words “Kindness and Compassion in the Bodhimanda” were chosen for the title of this repentance due to a response in a dream.

如是我聞：: 彌勒世尊。 既慈隆即世。 悲臻後劫。
Maitreya, the World-Honored, replete with great kindness and compassion extending to the end of time, bequeathed the title of this repentance.

如是我聞：: 依事題名。
This was how the title was established.

如是我聞：: 弗敢移易。
We do not dare change the title.

如是我聞：: 承此念力。 欲守護三寶。 令魔隱蔽。 摧伏自大增上慢者。
Relying on the strength of the kindness of the World-Honored One, we resolve to protect the Three Treasures, eclipse the power of demons, and humble those with arrogance and overweening pride.

如是我聞：: 未種善根者。 今當令種。 已種善根者。 今令增長。
We also resolve to cause those who have not planted roots of goodness to do so, and cause the roots of goodness already planted to flourish.

如是我聞：: 若計有所得住諸見者。 皆悉令發捨離之心。
We further resolve to cause those who cling to the notion of attainment and who dwell in various views to aspire for transcendence.

如是我聞：: 樂小法者。 令不疑大法。 樂大法者。 令生歡喜。
Finally, we resolve to enable those who delight in the Small Vehicle not to doubt the Mahayana, and to cause those who delight in the Mahayana to be joyous.

如是我聞：: 又此慈悲諸善中王。 一切眾生所歸依處。
Furthermore, compassion reigns supreme among all goodness and serves as the sanctuary for all living beings.

如是我聞：: 如日照晝。 如月照夜。 為人眼目。 為人導師。 為人父母。
Like the sun which lights up the day and the moon which illuminates the night, it guides us like eyes or teachers, and cares for us like parents or siblings.

如是我聞：: 為人兄弟。 同歸道場。 為真知識。
Drawing all of us back to the Bodhimanda, it serves as a true spiritual mentor.

如是我聞：: 慈悲之親重於血肉。
Kindness and compassion connect with us in a way deeper than that of the relationship with our blood relatives.

如是我聞：: 世世相隨雖死不離。
It accompanies us life after life and never leaves us even after death.

如是我聞：: 故目等心。 標號如上。
Therefore, we take it to heart and use “Kindness and Compassion” as the title of this Repentance.

如是我聞：: 今日道場。 幽顯大眾立此懺法。 并發大心。
Today in this Bodhimanda, we, both visible and invisible beings, gather to establish this Repentance and bring forth the resolve for bodhi.

如是我聞：: 有十二大因緣。
There are twelve major reasons for this.

如是我聞：: 何等十二。
What are the twelve? 1.

如是我聞：: 一者願化六道心無限齊。
With limitless resolve, we vow to transform all beings in the six paths.

如是我聞：: 二者為報慈恩功無限齊。
2. With limitless vigor, we vow to repay kindness and compassion.

如是我聞：: 三者願以此善力。 令諸眾生受佛禁戒不起犯心。
3. We vow this power of goodness will enable all beings to uphold the Buddhas’ precepts without thoughts of violating them.

如是我聞：: 四者以此善力。 令諸眾生於諸尊長不起慢心。
4. By the power of this goodness, we vow that all beings will not give rise to thoughts of arrogance towards teachers and elders.

如是我聞：: 五者以此善力。 令諸眾生在所生處不起恚心。
5. By the power of this goodness, we vow that all beings will not give rise to thoughts of anger or hatred with regard to their position in life.

如是我聞：: 六者以此善力。 令諸眾生於他身色不起嫉心。
6. By the power of this goodness, we vow all beings will not envy others’ fine appearance.

如是我聞：: 七者以此善力。 令諸眾生於內外法不起慳心。
7. We vow this power of goodness will enable us not to be stingy with the giving of wealth, both internal and external.

如是我聞：: 八者以此善力。 令諸眾生凡所修福不為自身。
8. By this power of goodness, we vow all beings will cultivate blessings, not for themselves, but for all those lacking support and protection.

如是我聞：: 悉為一切無覆護者。
九者以此善力。 令諸眾生不為自身行四攝法。
With this power of goodness, we vow all beings practice the for themselves, but for others.

如是我聞：: 十者以此善力。 令諸眾生見有孤獨幽繫疾病起救濟心。 令得安樂。
10. With this power of goodness, we vow all beings resolve to care for the orphaned, the solitary, the sick, and the imprisoned so they can attain peace and happiness.

如是我聞：: 十一者以此善力。 若有眾生。 應折伏者而折伏之。
11. With this power of goodness, we vow to subdue and gather in whoever needs to be subdued and gathered.

如是我聞：: 應攝受者而攝受之。
十二者以此善力。 令諸眾生在所生處恒自憶念發菩提心。
With this power of goodness, we vow all beings everywhere will constantly be mindful to bring forth and sustain the resolve for bodhi.

如是我聞：: 令菩提心相續不斷。 仰願幽顯凡聖大眾。 同加覆護同加攝受。 令(某甲)等(某甲字請各自稱名後皆例此)所悔清淨所願成就。 等諸佛心同諸佛願。
May all sages and ordinary beings, both visible and invisible, come to protect and help us return to purity through our repentance and fulfill all our wishes, so that our minds will be the same as all Buddhas’, and that we make the same vows as all Buddhas.

如是我聞：: 六道四生皆悉隨從滿菩提願淨三業法(淨身當洗浴淨口讚佛功德淨意運心懺悔三業既淨。
May all beings of the four births and the six paths accomplish bodhi.

如是我聞：: 乃可標心歸依三寶大慈悲父)。 《慈悲道場懺法》卷1：
Section 1. Taking Refuge with the Three Treasures.

如是我聞：: 「今日道場同業大眾。
Today, we are here in this Bodhimanda due to our shared karma.

如是我聞：: 宜各人人起覺悟意念世無常。
We should bring forth the resolve for awakening. Always be mindful of impermanence.

如是我聞：: 形不久住。 少壯必衰。
Our bodies do not last long, our youthful vitality slowly but definitely fades.

如是我聞：: 勿恃容姿自處污行。
Thus we should refrain from indulging in defiled conduct and realize that our fine appearance or graceful demeanor has no lasting reliability.

如是我聞：: 萬物無常皆當歸死。
Nothing is permanent; everything eventually drifts towards ruin.

如是我聞：: 天上天下誰能留者。
Be it in heaven or on earth, who can live forever?

如是我聞：: 年少顏色肌膚鮮澤。
When we are young, our muscles may be supple and our skin lustrous, with an aura of vitality.

如是我聞：: 氣息香潔是非身保。
However, the body can retain none of this.

如是我聞：: 人生合會必歸磨滅。
This body that comes into being due to conditions will surely wither and perish.

如是我聞：: 生老病死至來無期。
It goes through birth, aging, sickness, and death, which comes anytime unannounced!

如是我聞：: 誰當為我却除之者。
Who can rid us of these miseries?

如是我聞：: 災害卒至不可得脫。 一切貴賤因而死已。
When calamities suddenly hit, we are unable to escape, and we perish, regardless of our status or rank.

如是我聞：: 身體胮脹臭不可聞。
Our bodies bloat and stink, and the stench is unbearable.

如是我聞：: 空愛惜之於事何益。
So what is the purpose of lavishing so much care on our bodies?

如是我聞：: 自非勤行勝業。 無由出離[＊](某甲)等自惟。 形同朝露命速西光。 生世貧乏無德可稱。
If we do not vigorously cultivate meritorious deeds, how can we escape this suffering? The Dharma Host makes the following exhortation to the great assembly: I now contemplate that life is as impermanent as the morning dew; as fleeting as the setting sun.

如是我聞：: 智無神聖大人之明。 識無聖人洞徹之照。
Having lived a life of meager virtue, I have neither the brilliant wisdom of the great ones, nor the insightful knowledge of the sages.

如是我聞：: 言無忠和仁善之美。
My speech lacks gentleness, humaneness, trustworthiness, and kindness.

如是我聞：: 行無進退高下之節。
I do not know when to advance and when to retreat, when to lead and when to follow.

如是我聞：: 謬立斯志勞倦仁者。
However, with great apprehension, I humbly take on this task of leading the repentance and exhort everyone to vigorously apply effort in this repentance. This session is finite.

如是我聞：: 仰屈大眾慚懼交心既法席有期追戀無及。
When it ends, no amount of longing can bring it back. You will no longer encounter this session again.

如是我聞：: 從此一別願各努力。 勤意朝夕親奉供養。 人加精進。
It is my earnest wish that after the conclusion, each of you will continue to work diligently with a focused mind to personally make daily offerings to the Three Treasures and spur yourself on with vigor.

如是我聞：: 唯是為快。
You ought to joyfully follow this virtuous path.

如是我聞：: 仰願大眾各秉其心。 披忍辱鎧入深法門。
I also wish that you will wear the armor of patience and deeply enter this Dharma-door.

如是我聞：: 今日道場同業大眾。
Today, we are here in this Bodhimanda due to our shared karma.

如是我聞：: 宜各慇重起勇猛心。 不放逸心安住心。 大心。 勝心。 大慈悲心。
We should, with utmost earnestness and reverence, bring forth a courageous mind, a mind that never becomes lax, a mind of dwelling peacefully, an expansive mind, a supreme mind, a mind of great kindness and compassion, a mind of joyful benevolence, a joyful mind, a mind of gratefully repaying kindness, a mind of liberating beings, a mind of protecting all beings, a mind of rescuing all beings, and a mind equal to that of Bodhisattvas and the Tathagatas.

如是我聞：: 樂善心。 歡喜心。 報恩心。 度一切心。 守護一切心。 救護一切心。 同菩薩心。 等如來心。 一心志意五體投地。 奉為國王帝主土地人民父母師長。 上中下座善惡知識。 諸天諸仙護世四王主善罰惡。 守護持呪五方龍王龍神八部。
With single-minded concentration, we respectfully bow in full prostration on behalf of the heads of state, leaders, people of all nations, parents, elders, teachers, monastics of the three seniorities, good and bad advisors, heavenly beings, ascetic masters, the four world-protecting heavenly kings, spiritual beings who bless the good and punish the evil, spiritual beings who guard and protect those who uphold mantras, the dragon kings of the five directions, dragons and the rest of the eightfold division, as well as the limitless sentient beings in water, air, or on land throughout the ten directions.

如是我聞：: 廣及十方無窮無盡含靈抱識水陸。 空界一切眾生。 歸依十方盡虛空界一切諸佛(一拜)。
I take refuge with all the Buddhas of the ten directions to the ends of empty space. (bow)

如是我聞：: 第一疑。
Question 1.

如是我聞：: 問曰： 諸佛、菩薩以大悲為業，
Great Compassion is the life calling of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

如是我聞：: 若欲救度眾生， 秖應願生三界， 於五濁三塗中救苦眾生。
Thus, those who have developed the Bodhi Mind, wishing to rescue and ferry other sentient beings across, should simply vow to be reborn in the Triple Realm, among the five turbidities and the three evil paths.

如是我聞：: 因何求生淨土自安其身，
Why should we abandon sentient beings to lead a selfish life of tranquility?

如是我聞：: 捨離眾生則是無大慈悲， 專為自利， 障菩提道。
Is this not a lack of compassion, a preoccupation with egoistic needs, contrary to the path of enlightenment?

如是我聞：: 」答曰：
Answer.

如是我聞：: 「菩薩有二種：
There are two types of Bodhisattvas.

如是我聞：: 一者、久修行菩薩道， 得無生忍者，
The first type are those who have followed the Bodhisattva path for a long time and attained the Tolerance of Non-Birth (insight into the non-origination of phenomena).

如是我聞：: 實當所責；
This reproach applies to them.

如是我聞：: 二者、未得已還， 及初發心凡夫。 凡夫菩薩者，
The second type are Bodhisattvas who have not attained the Tolerance of Non-Birth, as well as ordinary beings who have just developed the Bodhi Mind.

如是我聞：: 要須常不離佛， 忍力成就方堪處三界內， 於惡世中救苦眾生。
If they aspire to perfect that Tolerance and enter the evil life of the Triple Realm to save sentient beings, they should remain in constant proximity to the Buddhas.

如是我聞：: 故《智度論》云： 『具縛凡夫， 有大悲心願生惡世， 救苦眾生者， 無有是處。
As stated in the Perfection of Wisdom Treatise: "It is unwise for human beings who are still bound by all kinds of afflictions, even if they possess a great compassionate Mind, to seek a premature rebirth in this evil realm to rescue sentient beings.

如是我聞：: 』何以故？
“Why is this so?

如是我聞：: 惡世界煩惱強，
It is because in this evil, defiled world, afflictions are powerful and widespread.

如是我聞：: 自無忍力， 心隨境轉，
Those who lack the power of Tolerance of Non-birth are bound to be swayed by external circumstances.

如是我聞：: 聲、色所縛， 自墮三塗，
They then become slaves to form and sound, fame and fortune, with the resulting karma of greed, anger and delusion.

如是我聞：: 焉能救眾生？
Once this occurs, they cannot even save themselves, much less others!

如是我聞：: 假令得生人中， 聖道難得，
If, for example, they are born in the human realm, in this evil environment full of non-believers and externalists, it is difficult to encounter genuine sages.

如是我聞：: 或因施、戒、修福， 得生人中， 得作國王、大臣， 富貴自在。
Therefore, it is not easy to hear the Buddha Dharma nor achieve the goals of the sages. “Of those who planted the seeds of generosity, morality and blessings in previous lives and are thus now enjoying power and fame, how many are not infatuated with a life of wealth and honor, wallowing in endless greed and lust?

如是我聞：: 縱遇善知識， 不肯信用，
“Therefore, even when they are counselled by enlightened teachers, they do not believe them nor act accordingly.

如是我聞：: 貪迷放逸， 廣造眾罪， 乘此惡業，
Moreover, to satisfy their passions, they take advantage of their existing power and influence, creating a great deal of bad karma.

如是我聞：: 一入三塗， 經無量劫， 從地獄出，
Thus, when their present life comes to an end, they descend upon the three evil paths for countless eons.

如是我聞：: 受貧賤身；
After that, they are reborn as humans of low social and economic status.

如是我聞：: 若不逢善知識， 還墮地獄。 如此輪迴，
If they do not then meet good spiritual advisors, they will continue to be deluded, creating more bad karma and descending once again into the lower realms.

如是我聞：: 至於今日， 人人皆如是，
From time immemorial, sentient beings caught in the cycle of Birth and Death have been in this predicament.

如是我聞：: 此名難行道也。 故《維摩經》云： 『自疾不能救， 而能救諸疾人？ 』又《智度論》云：
This is called the ‘Difficult Path of Practice.’” The Vimalakirti Sutra also states, “If you cannot even cure your own illness, how can you cure the illnesses of others?” The Perfection of Wisdom Treatise further states: "Take the case of two persons, each of whom watches a relative drowning in the river.

如是我聞：: 『譬如二人各有親眷， 為水所溺， 一人情急，
The first person, acting on impulse, hastily jumps into the water.

如是我聞：: 直入水救， 為無方便力故， 彼此俱沒；
However, because he lacks the necessary skills, in the end, both of them drown.

如是我聞：: 一人有方便， 往取船筏， 乘之救接，
The second person, more intelligent and resourceful, hurries off to fetch a boat and sails to the rescue.

如是我聞：: 悉皆得脫水溺之難。
Thus, both persons escape drowning.

如是我聞：: 』新發意菩薩， 亦復如是。 如是， 未得忍力， 不能救眾生。
Newly aspiring Bodhisattvas are like the first individual, who still lacks the power of Tolerance [of Non-Birth] and cannot save sentient beings.
為此常須近佛， 得無生忍已， 方能救眾生， 如得船者。	Only those Bodhisattvas who remain close to the Buddhas and attain that Tolerance can substitute for the Buddhas and ferry countless sentient beings across, just like the person who has the boat.

如是我聞：: 又論云： 『譬如嬰兒不得離母， 若也離母， 或墮坑井， 渴乳而死； 又如鳥子翅羽未成，
The Perfection of Wisdom Treatise goes on to state: "This is not unlike a young child who should not leave his mother, lest he tall into a well, drown in the river or die of starvation; or a young bird whose wings are not fully developed.

如是我聞：: 秖得依樹傅枝， 不能遠去， 翅翮成就， 方能飛空， 自在無礙。
It must bide its time, hopping from branch to branch, until it can fly afar, leisurely and unimpeded.

如是我聞：: 』凡夫無力， 唯得專念阿彌陀佛， 使成三昧，
Ordinary persons who lack the Tolerance of Non-Birth should limit themselves to Buddha Recitation, to achieve one-pointedness of Mind.
以業成故， 臨終斂念得生， 決定不疑。	Once that goal is reached, at the time of death, they will certainly be reborn in the Pure Land.
見彌陀佛， 證無生忍已， 還來三界， 乘無生忍船， 救苦眾生， 廣施佛事， 任意自在。	Having seen Amitabha Buddha and reached the Tolerance of Non-Birth, they can steer the boat of that Tolerance into the sea of Birth and Death, to ferry sentient beings across and accomplish countless Buddha deeds at will.

如是我聞：: 故論云： 『遊戲地獄， 行者生彼國， 得無生忍已， 還入生死國， 教化地獄， 救苦眾生。 』以是因緣， 求生淨土，
For these reasons, compassionate practitioners who wish to teach and convert sentient beings in hell, or enter the sea of Birth and Death, should bear in mind the causes and conditions for rebirth in the Pure Land.

如是我聞：: 願識其教。 故《十住婆沙論》， 名易行道也。
This is referred to as the "Easy Path of Practice" in the Commentary on the Ten Stages of the Bodhisattvas.

如是我聞：: 第二疑。
Question 2.

如是我聞：: 問： 「諸法體空， 本來無生， 平等寂滅。
All phenomena are by nature empty, always unborn [Non-Birth], equal and still.

如是我聞：: 今乃捨此求彼， 生西方彌陀淨土， 豈不乖理哉？
Are we not going against this truth when we abandon this world, seeking rebirth in the Land of Ultimate Bliss?

如是我聞：: 又經云： 『若求淨土， 先淨其心， 心淨故即佛土淨。 』此云何通？
The [vimalakirti] Sutra teaches that “to be reborn in the Pure Land, you should first purify your own Mind; only when the Mind is pure, will the Buddha lands be pure.” Are not Pure Land followers going against this truth?
Answer.

如是我聞：: 「釋有二義： 一者、總答；
This question involves two principles and can be answered on two levels.

如是我聞：: 二者、別答。 總答者， 汝若言： 『求生西方彌陀淨土， 則是捨此求彼， 不中理。
A) On the level of generality, if you think that seeking rebirth in the Pure Land means "leaving here and seeking there," and is therefore incompatible with the Truth of Equal Thusness, are you not committing the same mistake by grasping at this Saha World and not seeking rebirth in the Pure Land, i.e., "leaving there and grasping here"?

如是我聞：: 』者， 汝執住此， 不求西方， 則是捨彼著此， 此還成病， 不中理也。 又轉計云： 『我亦不求生彼， 亦不求生此。
If, on the other hand, you say, "I am neither seeking rebirth there, nor do I wish to remain here," you fall into the error of nihilism.

如是我聞：: 』者， 則斷滅見。 故《金剛般若經》云：
The Diamond Sutra states in this connection: "Subhuti, ... do not have such a thought.

如是我聞：: 『須菩提！ 汝若作是念， 發阿耨菩提者， 說諸法斷滅相。 莫作是念！ 何以故？
Why?

如是我聞：: 發菩提心者， 於法不說斷滅相。 』「二、別答者，
Because one who develops the Supreme Enlightened Mind does not advocate the [total] annihilation [of the marks of the dharmas.]"

如是我聞：: 夫不生、不滅者，
B) On the level of Specifics, since you have brought up the truth of Non-Birth and the Pure Mind, I would like to give the following explanation. Non-Birth is precisely the truth of No-Birth and No-Death.

如是我聞：: 於生緣中， 諸法和合， 不守自性， 求於生體，
No-Birth means that all dharmas are false aggregates, born of causes and conditions, with no Self-Nature.

如是我聞：: 亦不可得， 此生生時無所從來，
Therefore, they have no real "birth nature" or "time of birth."

如是我聞：: 故名不生。
Upon analysis, they do not really come from anywhere. Therefore, they are said to have No-Birth.

如是我聞：: 不滅者， 諸法散時， 不守自性，
No-Death means that, since phenomena have no Self-Nature, when they are extinguished, they cannot be considered dead.

如是我聞：: 言我散滅， 此散滅時去無所至，
Because they have no real place to return to, they are said to be not extinct (No-Death).

如是我聞：: 故言不滅。 非謂因緣生外， 別有不生、不滅。
For this reason, the truth of Non-Birth (or No-Birth No-Death) cannot exist outside of ordinary phenomena, which are subject to birth and death.

如是我聞：: 亦非不求生淨土， 喚作無生。
Therefore, Non-Birth does not mean not seeking rebirth in the Pure Land.

如是我聞：: 為此， 《中論》偈云： 『因緣所生法，
The Treatise on the Middle Way states: "Dharmas (phenomena) are born of causes and conditions.

如是我聞：: 我說即是空，
I say they are thus empty.

如是我聞：: 亦名為假名， 亦名中道義。
They are also called false and fictitious, and that is also the truth of the Middle Way."

如是我聞：: 』又云： 『諸法不自生，
It also states: "Dharmas are neither born spontaneously nor do they arise from others.

如是我聞：: 亦不從他生， 不共不無因，
They are born neither together with nor apart from causes and conditions.

如是我聞：: 是故知無生。
They are therefore said to have Non-Birth."

如是我聞：: 』又《維摩經》云： 『雖知諸佛國， 及與眾生空， 而常修淨土，
The Vimalakirti Sutra states: "Although he knows that Buddha lands / Are void like living beings / He goes on practicing the Pure Land (Dharma) / to teach and convert men."

如是我聞：: 教化諸群生。 』又云： 『譬如有人， 造立宮室， 若依空地， 隨意無礙； 若依虛空， 終不能成。
It also states: "We can build mansions at will on empty land, but it is impossible to build in the middle of empty space."

如是我聞：: 』諸佛說法， 常依二諦，
When the Buddhas preach, they usually rely on the Two Truths [ultimate and conventional].

如是我聞：: 不壞假名而說諸法實相。
They do not destroy the fictitious, provisional identities phenomena while revealing their true characteristics.

如是我聞：: 智者熾然求生淨土， 達生體不可得，
That is why the wise, while earnestly striving for rebirth in the Pure Land, also understand that the nature of rebirth is intrinsically empty.

如是我聞：: 即是真無生， 此謂心淨故即佛土淨。 愚者為生所縛，
This is true Non-Birth, and also the meaning of "only when the Mind is pure, will the Buddha lands be pure.” The dull and ignorant, on the other hand, are caught up in the concept of birth.

如是我聞：: 聞生即作生解， 聞無生即作無生解，
Upon hearing the term "Birth", they understand it as actual birth; hearing of "Non-Birth," they [cling to its literal meaning] and think that there is no rebirth anywhere.

如是我聞：: 不知生者即是無生， 無生即是生。
Little do they realize that "Birth is precisely Non-Birth, and Non-Birth does not hinder Birth."

如是我聞：: 不達此理， 橫相是非， 嗔他求生淨土，
Because they do not understand this principle, they provoke arguments, slandering and deprecating those who seek rebirth in the Western Pure Land.

如是我聞：: 幾許誤哉！
What a great mistake!

如是我聞：: 此則是謗法罪人， 邪見外道也。
They are guilty of vilifying the Dharma and belong to the ranks of deluded externalists (non-Buddhists).

如是我聞：: 示眾云。
The World-Honored One Ascends the Platform. PREFACE TO THE ASSEMBLY.

如是我聞：: 閉門打睡接上上機。
Close the gate and snooze—that’s how to treat a superior person.

如是我聞：: 顧鑑頻申。 曲為中下。
Reflection, abbreviation, and elaboration are used for middling and inferior ones.

如是我聞：: 那堪上曲䚄木弄鬼眼睛。
How can you stand for someone to ascend the high seat and scowl?

如是我聞：: 有箇傍不肯底。 出來。
If anyone around here doesn’t agree, step forward.

如是我聞：: 也怪伊不得。
I have no doubts about him.

如是我聞：: 舉。
Attention!

如是我聞：: 世尊一日陞座。
One day the World-Honored One ascended the platform and took his seat.

如是我聞：: 文殊白槌云。 諦觀法王法。 法王法如是(知佗是何心行)。 世尊便下座。
Manjushri struck the sounding post and said: “When you realize the Dharma-King’s Dharma, the Dharma-King’s Dharma is just as is.” At that, the World-Honored One descended from the platform.

如是我聞：: 頌云。
APPRECIATORY VERSE.

如是我聞：: 一段真風見也麼，
Do you see the true manner of the primal stage?

如是我聞：: 綿綿化母理機梭， 織成古錦含春象， 無柰東君漏泄何。
Mother Nature goes on weaving warp and woof; the woven old brocade contains the images of spring—nothing can be done about the Spring God’s (Manjushri) outflowing.

如是我聞：: 達磨廓然。
Bodhidharma’s Vast Emptiness.

如是我聞：: 示眾云。
PREFACE TO THE ASSEMBLY.

如是我聞：: 卞和三獻。 未免遭刑。 夜光投人。 鮮不按劍。
Benka’s three offerings did not prevent his being punished: If a luminous jewel were thrown at them, few are the men who would not draw their swords.

如是我聞：: 卒客無卒主。 宜假不宜真。
For an impromptu guest, there is not an impromptu host; he’s provisionally acceptable but not absolutely acceptable.

如是我聞：: 差珍異寶用不著。 死猫兒頭拈出。 看。
If you can’t grasp rare, valuable treasure, let’s toss in a dead cat’s head and see.

如是我聞：: 舉。
Attention!

如是我聞：: 梁武帝問達磨大師如何是聖諦第一義磨云。
Emperor Wu of Ryo asked the great master Bodhidharma, “What is the ultimate meaning of the holy truth of Buddhism?” Bodhidharma replied, “Vast emptiness.

如是我聞：: 廓然無聖。 帝云。 對朕者誰磨云。 不識。 帝不契。
No holiness.” The Emperor asked, “Who stands here before me?” Bodhidharma replied, “I don’t know.” The Emperor was baffled.

如是我聞：: 遂渡江至少林面壁九年。
Thereafter, Bodhidharma crossed the river, arrived at Shorin and faced the wall for nine years.

如是我聞：: 頌云。
APPRECIATORY VERSE.

如是我聞：: 廓然無聖，
Emptiness, no holiness—the questioner’s far off.

如是我聞：: 來機逕庭， 得非犯鼻而揮斤。 失不迴頭而墮甑，
Gain is to swing the axe and not harm the nose; loss is to drop the pot and not look back.

如是我聞：: 寥寥冷坐少林。 默默全提正令，
In solitude he sits cool at Shorin; in silence the Right Decree’s fully revealed.

如是我聞：: 秋清月轉霜輪， 河淡斗垂夜柄，
The autumn’s lucid and the moon’s a turning frosty wheel; the Milky Way’s pale, and the Big Dipper’s handle hangs low.

如是我聞：: 繩繩衣鉢付兒孫， 從此人天成藥病。
In line the robe and bowl handed on to descendents henceforth are medicine to men and devas.

如是我聞：: 東印請祖。
An Invitation for the Patriarch.

如是我聞：: 示眾云。
PREFACE TO THE ASSEMBLY.

如是我聞：: 劫前未兆之機。 烏龜向火。
By the activity existing before even a hint of this kalpa, a blind turtle faces the fire.

如是我聞：: 教外別傳一句。 碓嘴生花。
By the phrase that’s transmitted outside the scriptures, a mortar’s rim spouts a flower.

如是我聞：: 且道。 還有受持讀誦分也無。
Tell me: is there something to receive, maintain, read, and recite?

如是我聞：: 舉。
Attention!

如是我聞：: 東印土國王。 請二十七祖般若多羅齊。
The ruler of a country in Eastern India invited the Twenty-Seventh Ancestor, Hannyatara, for a midmorning meal.

如是我聞：: 王問曰。 何不看經。 祖云。 貧道入息不居陰界。 出息不涉眾緣。
The ruler asked him, “Why don’t you read the sutras?” The Ancestor replied, “This poor follower of the Way, when breathing in does not dwell in the realm of skandhas, and when breathing out is not caught up in the many externals.

如是我聞：: 常轉如是經。 百千萬億卷。 頌云。
Always do I thus turn a hundred thousand million billion rolls of sutras.” APPRECIATORY VERSE.

如是我聞：: 雲犀玩月璨含輝， 木馬游春駿不羈，
Cloud rhino sports with the moon and glows embracing its beams; wooden horse plays in the spring, unfettered and fleet.

如是我聞：: 眉底一雙寒碧眼， 看經那到透牛皮，
Beneath his brows, two chill blue eyes—what need to read sutras as though piercing oxhide!

如是我聞：: 明白心起曠劫， 英雄力破重圍，
Bright white mind transcends vast kalpas, a hero’s strength tears through nested enclosures.

如是我聞：: 妙圓樞口轉靈機。
The subtle round hub-hole turns marvelous activities.

如是我聞：: 寒山忘却來時路。 拾得相將携手歸。
When Kanzan forgets the road whence he came, Jittoku will lead him by hand to return.

如是我聞：: 世尊指地示眾云。
The World-Honored One Points to the Earth.

如是我聞：: 一塵纔舉。 大地全收。
PREFACE TO THE ASSEMBLY. When a speck of dust is raised, the great earth is fully contained in it.

如是我聞：: 疋馬單槍。 開疆展土。
It’s very well to open new territory and extend your lands with horse and spear.

如是我聞：: 便可隨處作主。 遇緣即宗底。 是甚麼人。
Who is this person who can be master in any place and meet the source in everything?

如是我聞：: 舉。
Attention!

如是我聞：: 世尊與眾行次， 以手指地云。 此處宜建梵剎。 帝釋將一莖草。 插於地上云。
When the World-Honored One was walking with his disciples he pointed to the ground and said, “It would be good to erect a temple here.” The god Indra took a blade of grass and stuck it in the ground and said, “The temple has been erected.” The World-Honored One smiled faintly.

如是我聞：: 建梵剎已竟。 世尊微笑。 頌云。
APPRECIATORY VERSE.

如是我聞：: 百草頭上無邊春， 信手拈來用得親，
On the hundred grass-tips, boundless spring—taking what’s at hand, use it freely.

如是我聞：: 丈六金身功德聚， 等閑携手入紅塵， 塵中能作主， 化外自來賓，
Buddha’s sixteen foot golden body of manifold merit spontaneously extending a hand, enters the red dust—within the dust he can be host coming from another world, naturally he’s a guest.

如是我聞：: 觸處生涯隨分足， 未嫌伎倆不如人。
Wherever you are be content with your role—dislike not those more adept than you.
